title: Charybdis
text:
Trouve un Charybdis Core dans une Charybdis Cave. Pose-le et tue des monstres autour pour le charger en EP, puis clic droit pour invoquer Charybdis.
Astuce : invoque-la dans une grotte pour qu'elle ne s'envole pas, ou utilise une attaque à distance puissante.
Butin : schéma de Charybdis Scalemail, écailles et viande de Charybdis.

title: Gazel Dwargo
text:
Le roi des nains. Il faut 100 de réputation positive (commerce, protéger les nains) ou négative (les attaquer).
La réputation négative est plus rapide mais ne permet qu'un seul combat et bloque le commerce. La positive permet de l'affronter à volonté et baisse les prix.
Entre dans son arène par le Royal Warp Pad des villages nains. Butin : son arme Rhuk et un Battlewill exclusif.

title: Hinata Sakaguchi
text:
Boss de fin de partie qui invoque tous les Greater Spirits. Fault Field la rend intouchable sauf dégâts spirituels, spatiaux ou mentaux.
Attention à Disintegration : tue instantanément si elle touche. Elle a énormément de résistances, privilégie les compétences Bypass/Degrade.
Butin possible : ses armes et l'armure Holy Armorments.

title: Orc Lord
text:
Boss du début du milieu de partie. Invoque des orcs et ses attaques infligent Corrosion, qui détruit l'armure.
Butin : Royal Blood et viande. Tu peux y apprendre la compétence Corrosion.
Orc Disaster
Si un Orc Lord gagne 200 000 EP (en lui faisant tuer des subordonnés à fort EP), il évolue en Orc Disaster, un boss de fin de partie.

title: Shizu et Ifrit
text:
Boss de fin de milieu de partie. La 1re phase est simple ; en « mourant », Shizu libère Ifrit, très résistant aux attaques physiques.
Utilise des compétences qui contournent ou dégradent les résistances, ou de la magie.
Butin : drops d'Ifrit, puis Shizu donne l'Anti-Magic Mask et son schéma.

title: Supermassive Slime
text:
Peut apparaître à la place d'un slime normal. Inflige des dégâts de corrosion : une résistance ou nullification à la corrosion le rend inoffensif.
Il a Ultraspeed Regen : attaque ses PV spirituels ou applique Severance.
Butin : Slime Core et Slime Chunk. Nourris un slime avec des Slime Cores pour avoir ton propre Supermassive Slime !

title: Battlewills
text:
Les Battlewills sont des arts de combat qui utilisent l'aura. On les apprend avec des Battlewill Manuals, trouvés dans les coffres qui contiennent des pommes dorées (temples du désert, donjons à spawner...).
Mêlée : Aura Slash, Aura Sword, Heavy Slash, Roaring Lion Punch...
Projectiles : Magic Bullet, Ogre Flame, Ogre-sword Cannon...
Utilitaires : Air Flight, Aura Shield, Instant-move, Formhide...

title: Magie
text:
Magie aspectuelle
Écoles : Feu, Eau, Terre, Vent, Espace, Explosion, Foudre, Glace, Gravité, Renforcement, Soin, Illusion, Mental, Barrière et divers (Reincarnation, Analyze, Flight...).
Magie spirituelle
Obtenue grâce aux esprits. Rangs : Lesser, Intermediate, Greater. Exemples : Fire Bolt, Hellfire, Megiddo, Darkness Cannon.
Invocation
Summon Medium Elemental, Summon Greater Elemental, Summon Hound Dog.

title: Types de compétences
text:
Les compétences sont des formules gravées dans l'âme. Il en existe plusieurs rangs :
- Intrinsèques : liées à ta race
- Common : coût 100 MP max
- Extra : coût 1 000 MP max
- Unique : très puissantes (Great Sage, Predator...)
- Ultimate : le sommet
- Résistances : deviennent des Nullifications à l'éveil
Compétences utiles
- Magic Sense : vision nocturne et voir les monstres à travers les murs
- Corrosion : manger 100 chairs putréfiées
- Poison : manger 100 yeux d'araignée
- Sage : maîtriser 20 magies/Battlewills

title: Premier équipement
text:
En tuant des monstres, tu obtiens du Monster Leather (cuir de monstre). Il sert à fabriquer une armure qui évolue quand tu gagnes de l'EP.
Pour la fabriquer, il faut un Smithing Bench : 2 fers, 3 papiers, 1 table de craft et 2 planches.
Voir aussi l'entrée Évolution de l'équipement dans la catégorie Mécaniques.

title: Minerai magique
text:
Après le diamant, l'étape suivante est le Magic Ore. Il se trouve entre les couches -25 et -31 (le mieux : -29).
Il faut une pioche en netherite pour le miner (ou une pioche en os de dragon avec Ice and Fire). Fortune est vivement conseillé.
Prévois environ 19 obsidiennes : 10 pour le portail du Nether, 4 pour la table d'enchantement et 5 pour le Kiln.
Fonds le minerai magique dans le Kiln pour obtenir des lingots de Low Magisteel, la base de l'équipement de milieu de jeu.

title: Premiers pas
text:
À ta première connexion, un menu te propose de choisir ta race. Chaque race rend la progression plus ou moins difficile (voir la catégorie Races).
Tu reçois aussi une compétence unique (Unique Skill) au hasard dès le départ.
Pour devenir plus fort, il faut tuer des monstres : chaque kill te donne de l'EP et augmente tes magicules maximum. Plus le monstre est fort, plus tu gagnes d'EP.
Ouvre ton menu de personnage avec la touche B pour voir tes stats, ta race et tes compétences.

title: Progression
text:
Milieu de partie
Monte ton équipement en Magisteel et vise tes évolutions. Les piglins, piglins zombies et wither squelettes du Nether donnent un bon EP.
Récupère des esprits à l'Arbre du Labyrinthe et apprends la compétence Sage (maîtriser 20 magies ou Battlewills) pour progresser plus vite.
Fin de partie
Fais ton éveil après 1 million d'EP ou plus. Pour les boss de fin, vise environ 2 millions d'EP et des compétences maîtrisées.
Farm d'EP
- Farm d'endermen dans l'End (AFK)
- Chasse aux Sissie dans les océans
- Combats de boss

title: L'Arbre du Labyrinthe
text:
L'Arbre du Labyrinthe apparaît rarement dans les Ancient Forest. Un nain cartographe de niveau maître vend une carte qui y mène.
Il faut au moins 8 000 EP pour entrer, sinon l'empoisonnement aux magicules te tue et t'expulse (sans perte d'EP). Les magicules s'y régénèrent plus vite.
À l'intérieur, le Colosse Élémentaire garde le passage. Que tu le battes ou que tu meures, tu pourras ensuite aller prier. Le vaincre donne un bloc de Pure Magisteel (qui permet de le réinvoquer).

title: Prier pour un esprit
text:
Monte jusqu'au cercle de prière et reste accroupi 20 secondes sur le chemin de prière.
Chances
- Lesser : 40 %
- Medium : 20 %
- Greater : 10 %
- Lord : 1 % (si tu as déjà un Medium ou Greater de l'élément)
Ensuite, 20 minutes de recharge. Prier trop tôt te renvoie à l'entrée. Commande : /tensura get spirit cooldown.
Bonus raciaux (Lesser garanti, Medium et Greater x2) : Nain → Terre, Elfe → Vent, Homme-poisson → Eau, Gobelin et Ogre → Feu.

title: Rangs et éléments
text:
- Lesser : la manipulation de l'élément + un sort
- Medium : plusieurs sorts, invocable
- Greater : tous les sorts, invocable, requis pour le Vrai Héros
- Lord : très rare, équivalent au Greater
Sorts Medium / Greater
- Feu : Fire Bolt, Fire Breath / Flare Circle, Hellfire
- Eau : Acid Rain, Water Cutter / Blizzard, Megiddo
- Terre : Earth Spikes, Earth Storm / Earth Jail, Magma Surge
- Vent :
Lightning Lance, Wind Blade / Aerial Blade, Electro Blast

- Espace : Gate, Shrink, Teleport / Swipe
- Lumière : Solar Beam, Solar Wave / Solar Flare, Solar Rain
- Ténèbres : Dark Cube, Shadow Bind / Darkness Cannon, True Darkness
Voir tes esprits : /tensura get spirit.

title: Harvest Festival
text:
L'éveil en Vrai Seigneur Démon déclenche un Harvest Festival de 3 minutes, qui touche les subordonnés dans un rayon de 30 blocs.
- 1re minute : pas de compétences, vision et mouvements limités
- 2e minute : tu tombes en sommeil
- 3e minute : tes subordonnés dorment aussi
Mourir pendant le Festival fait perdre toutes tes âmes ! Mets-toi en sécurité avant.

title: Vrai Seigneur Démon
text:
Graine
Un Majin avec 200 000 EP obtient la Demon Lord Seed.
Âmes
Avec la graine, tuer des créatures donne des âmes : 2 000 EP = 1 âme.
Éveil
À 10 000 âmes, un bouton apparaît dans le menu de statut. À 20 000 âmes, l'éveil est forcé.
Effets
- EP x3
- Stats des subordonnés PNJ doublées
- Évolution de ta race
- Résistances → Nullifications

title: Vrai Héros
text:
L'Œuf du Héros
Obtiens les 5 Greater Spirits de base (Feu, Eau, Vent, Terre, Espace) + un Greater de Lumière ou de Ténèbres. Tu ne dois pas être Majin de naissance. Tu gagnes aussi Eye Of Truth.
5 % de chances d'être Béni en se réincarnant avec une race non Majin : l'œuf est alors obtenu immédiatement.
Éclosion
Régénère des PV en étant sous 25 % de tes PV max, contre un boss valide avec au moins 400 000 EP et sous 50 % de ses PV.
Boss valides
- Wither, Ender Dragon
- Elemental Colossus, Charybdis, Akash
- Ifrit, Sylphide, Undine, War Gnome
- Orc Lord, Orc Disaster, Supermassive Slime
- Dragons, Gorgon, Hydra, Dread Lich (Ice and Fire)
Effets
- EP x3
- Résistances → Nullifications
- Unpredictability : ignore esquives et critiques

title: Alignement : Saint et Majin
text:
Saint (Holy)
Obtenu en atteignant la 3e évolution d'une race non Majin (Human Saint, Elf Saint, Mystic Oni, Spirit Boar, True Dragonewt...). Nom de race en jaune.
Un Saint ne peut plus devenir Majin, ni Vrai Seigneur Démon (sauf alignement Chaos via la compétence Reverser).
Majin
Monstre intelligent. Nom de race en violet. On le devient en commençant avec une race Majin, avec un Marionette Heart, en mourant d'empoisonnement aux magicules ou (5 %) au Demon Lord Haki.
Certaines évolutions rendent Majin : Vampire, Wicked Oni, Orc Lord. Un Majin de naissance ne peut pas devenir Vrai Héros.
Bonus communs
- Plus besoin d'air sous l'eau
- La faim ne descend pas sous 18

title: Utiliser ses compétences
text:
Apprendre
Une compétence non apprise est grisée dans le menu. Équipe-la dans un emplacement et active-la avec sa touche : chaque essai rapproche de l'apprentissage. À 100 points, elle est apprise.
Chaque essai a 10 % de chances d'échouer : tu perds 1 à 3 points et subis Cécité, Paralysie ou Folie.
Apprendre coûte des MP max : 100 pour une Common Skill, 1 000 pour une Extra Skill. Sage, Great Sage, Mathematician et Cook accélèrent l'apprentissage.
Maîtrise
Utiliser une compétence donne des points de maîtrise (sans échec). Toucher une cible donne x3, tuer x5. Certains modes demandent la maîtrise complète.
Presets
9 presets de 3 compétences (27 au total). Change de preset avec Alt + molette ou Alt + numéro.
Modes
Change le mode d'une compétence avec Alt + touche de l'emplacement.
Dans le menu
- Clic gauche : équiper
- Clic droit : voir les infos
- Clic molette : retirer
Filtres de recherche
- f:learned / f:learning
- f:mastered / f:unmastered
- f:toggleable / f:toggledon
- f:oncooldown / f:offcooldown
- f:active / f:passive

title: EP, Magicules et Aura
text:
L'EP (Existence Points) mesure la puissance d'une créature : c'est la somme de tes Magicules (MP) et de ton Aura (AP). L'EP sert à évoluer, s'éveiller et apprendre certaines compétences.
Gain
Par défaut, tu gagnes 3 % de l'EP du monstre tué. Si tu es bien plus fort que lui, le gain baisse de 1 % par multiple d'écart (réduction max 90 %).
Répartition
- Non-Majin : 2/3 en Aura, 1/3 en Magicules
- Majin : 2/3 en Magicules, 1/3 en Aura
Mort
Chaque mort te fait perdre 5 % de ton EP (réglable par gamerule).

title: Évolution de l'équipement
text:
Le Monster Leather et le Magisteel évoluent : utilise-les ou porte-les en tuant des créatures pour leur donner de l'EP.
Monster Leather
- D → C : 2 500 EP
- C → B : 5 000 EP
- B → A : 8 000 EP
- A → Special A : 80 000 EP
Magisteel
- Low → High : 18 000 EP
- High → Pure : 52 000 EP
- Pure → Adamantite : 225 000 EP
- Adamantite → Hihi'irokane : 750 000 EP
Le Mithril passe en Adamantite (225 000 EP) puis Hihi'irokane. L'Orichalcum passe directement en Hihi'irokane (750 000 EP).

title: Régénérer ses magicules
text:
La régénération de magicules est fixe par défaut. Elle augmente avec la gravure (engraving) Magicule Absorption sur l'armure, ou dans certains lieux :
- Dimensions : Enfer (Hell) et Labyrinthe
- Biomes : Barren Lands et Ancient Forest
Recharge complète instantanée
- Manger un Magic Crystal avec Absorb & Dissolve ou Predator
- Activer Beast Transformation
- Mourir (déconseillé : perte d'EP)

title: Parchemins de réinitialisation
text:
Skill Reset Scroll
Papier + lingot de Pure Magisteel + lingot d'Orichalcum + Magic Stone + Monster Leather (A). Réinitialise toutes tes compétences sauf les intrinsèques de ta race. Attention : il ne redonne pas de compétence unique !
Race Reset Scroll
Papier + lingot de Mithril + Monster Leather (A) + Magic Stone. Réinitialise stats, nom, éveil, esprits, résistances et race.
Character Reset Scroll
Papier + lingot de Pure Magisteel + Magic Stone + Monster Leather (A). Remet tout à zéro, comme une nouvelle réincarnation.
Magie Reincarnation
Permet de rechoisir sa race en gardant compétences non intrinsèques, esprits, éveil et 75 % de ses MP/AP max. Maîtrisée, elle débloque les races non standard.

title: Biomes
text:
Tensura ajoute 8 biomes. Chacun demande un minimum de magicules pour y entrer sans empoisonnement aux magicules.
Surface
- Ancient Forest : forêt dense, abrite l'Arbre du Labyrinthe
- Miasmic Plains : marais brumeux, les morts-vivants n'y brûlent pas
- Barren Lands
- Desert of Death
Enfer (Hell)
- Underworld Barrens
- Underworld Red Sands
- Underworld Sands
- Underworld Spikes

title: Races hardcore
text:
Si la gamerule des races hardcore est activée :
- Slime : aveugle au départ, il faut Magic Sense
- Homme-lézard : affaibli dans le froid
- Homme-poisson : suffoque hors de l'eau
- Wight, Goule, Vampire : brûlent au soleil même avec un casque
- Orc Lord / Disaster : Faim III / V
Un joueur nommé ne peut alors plus s'éveiller.

title: Aperçu des races
text:
Chaque race a ses stats de départ (PV, MP, AP), une difficulté et une ligne d'évolutions. Les races marquées Majin gagnent surtout des magicules.
Lignées d'évolution
- Humain → Éclairé → Saint → Divin
- Gobelin → Hobgobelin → ...
→ Oni Divin
- Homme-lézard → Dragonewt → Vrai Dragonewt → Dragon Divin
- Orc → Orc Supérieur → Orc Lord → Orc Disaster
- Slime → Slime de Métal → Slime Démon → Dieu Slime
- Goule → Vampire → ...
→ Vampire Divin
- Démon Mineur → Supérieur → Archi → Seigneur Démon
Beaucoup d'évolutions peuvent aussi être obtenues pendant un Harvest Festival (voir Éveils).

title: Homme-bête
text:
Peut passer librement de sa forme animale à une forme humaine. Physique et régénération hors normes.

- Difficulté : Facile
- PV : 22
- MP : 300 - 600
- AP : 1 500 - 2 500
- Alignement : Aucun
Capacité raciale
Transformation bestiale.
Évolution
- Seigneur Bête : 100 000 EP ou Harvest Festival

Le plus bas rang des démons, né dans le Royaume Démoniaque.

Évolution

title: Ancient Soul
text:
Type: Extra Skill
Toggle on to bathe nearby allies in an ancient aura - Strength III, Regeneration III, and Resistance I - while you gain Soul Sight to read the souls around you.
Drains magicule while active. Learning it demands great EP and 25 resets.
How to Unlock
Reach 5,000 EP and have reset at least 25 times.

title: Money & Banking
text:
If your server runs the banking mod, Elite Tensura ties into it.
Money becomes a real part of progression - it funds your nation's treasury, its levels and perks, war declarations, and the contract board.
Without the banking mod none of this appears, and the rest of the addon works exactly as normal.
Cash from Mobs
Certain mobs drop extra cash when killed, on top of their usual loot.
Your own subordinates are exempt - you cannot farm your own summons for money.
Which mobs pay out is set by your server.
Auto-Pickup
Cash you pick up can be routed straight into your accounts instead of filling your inventory:

- Off - cash stays as items
- Wallet - goes to your wallet
- Bank - goes to your bank account
Your server chooses the mode. The usual pickup popup can also be suppressed, so a long grind does not flood your screen.
The Nation Tax
If you belong to a nation with an active treasury, a slice of every cash pickup is taxed:

- 5% to your nation's treasury
- 10% into the central bank reserve
The second is a money sink - it leaves the economy entirely, keeping server-wide currency from inflating.
Both halves are suspended while your nation runs a Tax Holiday perk.

title: Basilisk Skin
text:
Type: Ultimate Skill
A living suit of armor that hardens with your power. As your EP rises, the plating evolves through three tiers:
- Magisteel
- Adamantite
- Hihiirokane
Toggle it on to wear the armor. It drains magicule while active and shields you from magicule poison.
How to Unlock
Master Crocodile Skin, become a True Demon Lord or True Hero, and reach 10,000,000 EP.
Learning Basilisk Skin consumes Crocodile Skin.
Servers may relax these requirements via config.

title: Beelzebuth, Lord of Gluttony
text:
Type: Ultimate Skill
The Lord of Gluttony's absorption economy. A six-mode skill built around devouring, storing, and redistributing power:
- Predation
- Stomach
- Isolate
- Food Chain: Provide
- Food Chain: Receive
- Soul Consume
Where Ouroboros wields Gluttony through raw combat, Beelzebuth channels it through consumption, storage, and conversion.
Predation & Stomach
Hold to unleash a devouring mist that drains magicule, steals skills, and finishes off weakened prey - killed targets and their dropped items are swept straight into your Stomach, a spatial storage far larger than Ouroboros' own.
Isolate
A one-way quarantine: sealed items and cleansed debuffs can't be retrieved, only converted. Sneak-press to convert everything held in Isolate into magicule on demand.
Food Chain
Provide grants one of your mastered skills to a subordinate. Receive permanently copies a mastered skill from a subordinate in return - a two-way bond, unlike Ouroboros' one-way Provide.
Soul Consume
Hold to unleash a Soul Steal aura, instantly reaping the souls of nearby foes whose will has broken. Any hit landed while this mode is active also inflicts Soul Drain.
How to Unlock
Master Gluttony, become a True Demon Lord or True Hero, and reach 10,000,000 EP.
Learning Beelzebuth consumes Merciless as its price.
Servers may relax these requirements via config.

title: Brain
text:
Type: Unique Skill
Brain gives a creature a working mind. Any mob holding this skill starts using everything it knows the way a player would - keeping its defensive skills switched on, pressing its combat skills when threatened, and casting its learned spells in battle.
How It Fights
Every few seconds the mob sizes up its situation. In a fight it hurls its strongest direct-damage magic at its target - fire, ice, lightning and the like come first, trickier control spells second. When it drops below half health, it switches to healing magic instead.
Spells cost the mob real magicule - when it runs dry, the casting stops.
Reading the Signs
A casting mob telegraphs: a magic circle appears above its head, colored to match the element it is about to unleash, and the spell launches from the circle itself. That flash is your window - interrupt it, shield up, or get out of the line of fire.
How to Unlock
Granted by an operator only, and meant for mobs, not players - a player who somehow acquires Brain loses it again immediately. Use it to turn a named guard, boss, or pet into a genuine spellcaster: teach the mob skills and magic, then grant it Brain and let it think for itself.

title: World Calamity
text:
A World Calamity is a rare disaster - a Tensura monster awakens swollen with power (x3 health, x2 damage), glowing and named Calamity. A purple boss bar marks the threat.
Off by default - a server enables it with the ETCalamityEnabled gamerule. Admins can also trigger one with /etadmin calamity start.
When & Where
Left enabled, a calamity strikes on its own every 2-6 hours.
It rises within a nation's Walpurgis-claimed territory if any exist, otherwise near an unlucky player.
If it is not slain within 30 minutes - or every player logs off - it recedes with no reward.
The Quiet World
A calamity will not rise for the weak or the absent.

- At least two players must be online with 100,000 EP or more
- Nothing spawns within 125 blocks of 0, 0 - the world spawn is protected
Fail either and the world waits, trying again a few minutes later. An admin who summons one by hand ignores the first rule, never the second.
Endings Without Glory
A calamity is bound to the living world, and cannot outlast it.
If the last player logs off, the beast is unmade. If the server restarts mid-fight, the calamity is gone when the world returns - no stray monster is ever left roaming.
No reward is paid for either. The clock simply begins again.
Joining the Fight
The boss bar appears to everyone within 96 blocks. Rush in and deal damage - the game records how much each player contributes.
Calamities hit hard, so bring allies. Every blow counts toward your share of the spoils.
The Shield

title: World Calamity (suite)
text:
With enough players online, a calamity wears a Resonance Shield that shrugs off solo damage - while it holds, your hits deal 0.
To shatter it, several different players must each strike within a short window. The boss then turns vulnerable for a spell before the shield reforms.
The boss bar shows the state and a breaker count like 2/3. With only one player needed, there is no shield.
Rewards
Deal at least 10% of the boss's health to qualify. On its defeat, qualifiers receive:
- A Rare Key
- The Calamity Slayer title
- A calamities-slain credit
The top damage dealer also earns an Elite Key. You must be online at the kill to collect.
Nations that joined gain a world-event credit and reputation.
The Fall
When the calamity dies, the World narrates the victory and a chat banner names the fight's duration and its top three damage dealers.
Your rewards drop at the death site as glowing items only you can pick up - claim them before they fade. A pillar of light and a crack of lightning mark the spot.

title: Chat Trivia & Plushies
text:
Every so often the server asks a question in chat.
You have about 30 seconds to answer by typing. The first correct answer wins - everyone else gets nothing that round.
Answers match as a substring, so a sentence containing the answer counts. Nobody has to type it exactly.
Speed Decides
Your reward depends entirely on how fast you answered:

- Within 5s - Elite Key
- Within 15s - Rare Key
- Any time after - Common Key
That five-second window is the whole game. Speed matters far more than being the one who knew the answer.
Plushies
Every win also gives one random plushie, drawn from the pool your lifetime win count has unlocked:

- Common - 13 passive mobs
- Uncommon - 21, dolphins to iron golems
- Rare - 17 hostiles
- Epic - 15 nether and End mobs
- Legendary - 9, including the Ender Dragon and Warden
You always draw from your highest tier, so they get rarer as you win more.
Collecting
Plushies are decorative blocks - around 60 variants.
Winning trivia is the only way to get them. They are not craftable and never appear in crates or loot.
If your inventory is full the plushie drops at your feet and can be picked up straight away.
Your win count is permanent and never resets.

title: The Codex
text:
The Codex is this addon's one screen. Titles, records, synergies, your nation, its missions and the season all live in it as tabs, so there is only ever one button to remember.
Open Tensura's main menu and click Codex in the upper right. It opens on Titles.
The Tabs
- Titles - what you have unlocked and what you wear
- Records - your permanent milestones, by category
- Synergy - completed combinations and near misses
- Nations - level, treasury, achievements
- Missions - the current nation cycle
- Season - Chronicle, Legacy and the nation ladder
Tabs your server has switched off never appear at all.
Searching
Titles, Records and Synergy each carry a search box above the list. Type to narrow it by name or by rarity.
What you type stays when you switch tabs or resize the window - you never lose a search by clicking away.
On Records, the search looks only inside the category you are in. If something you expect is missing, check the category first.

title: Crates & Keys
text:
Crates are loot boxes in three tiers - Common, Rare, and Elite. Each tier needs a matching key: a Common Crate only opens with a Common Key, and so on.
Right-click a crate while holding its key to open it. The key is consumed and you get a reward on the spot.
Checking the Odds
Not sure what you might win? Hit a crate, or right-click it with an empty hand - either one opens a preview of every possible reward and its exact drop chance. No key needed, nothing spent.
Rewards
Crates can drop items, skills, or Soul Points - and sometimes even more keys for a higher tier. Elite Crates hold the rarest loot in the game.
Where Keys Come From
Keys are not craftable. They come from other crates, Calamity payouts scaled by your contribution, winning a war (every member of the winner gets a key, the top scorer a better one), completing a nation mission (better still for clearing the whole cycle), chat trivia, and server events or admin grants.
Each of the war, mission and calamity faucets can be toggled off by your server.

title: Crocodile Skin
text:
Type: Unique Skill
Scaled hide that toughens as your EP grows, granting tiered armor while toggled on.
Evolves from Dragon Skin, and can itself grow toward greater skins.
How to Unlock
Master Dragon Skin and reach 1,000 EP.
Learning Crocodile Skin consumes Dragon Skin.

title: Death Recap
text:
With engravings, synergies, nation perks, season twists and transformations all pulling on the same blow, what actually killed me stops being an easy question.
The Death Recap answers it. When you die, a panel appears in the corner of the death screen listing your last 8 hits, oldest first.
Reading It
Each line names what struck you, what kind of harm it was, and what the blow did:
- 5.0 - landed as it was
- 7.0 up 9.0 - something raised it
- 7.0 down 4.0 - something blunted it
- negated - it was turned aside entirely
Falling, drowning and fire show no attacker.
What The Arrows Mean
The arrow is the whole story of that blow - your resistances, your engravings, your synergies, the attacker's own gifts, whatever the season's twist is doing. It does not try to name which of them did what.
That is still enough. A hit landing at triple what you expected means something is feeding it. A defensive build showing no reduction at all is not working.
Notes
- It covers everything - mobs, bosses, other players, the world itself
- Turned-aside blows still show, marked negated - useful proof a defence fired
- It clears itself when you leave the screen, so it never shows you an old death
- There is no button and no key. It simply happens, unless your server has switched it off.

title: Discord Bridge
text:
When the server links a Discord, a bridge carries news between game and chat. It can post:
- World events - Calamities, awakenings
- Nation & diplomacy news
- Player milestones - records, achievements
- In-game chat
- Death messages
Two-Way Chat
With the optional gateway bot running, messages typed in the linked Discord channel also appear in-game - a true two-way chat.
Everything here is controlled by the server and is off by default.

title: Engravings
text:
Twenty-two custom engravings join the base engraving pool. Gear earns them two ways:
- EP growth - when a piece crosses a major EP threshold and a Rare or Epic engraving would roll, there is a 25% chance it becomes a custom one instead
- Forge crafting - quality crafts come pre-engraved from a much larger pool
EP Rolls: Armor
Rare rolls on armor can become:
- Magicule Conduit - +25% magicule regen per level (max 4)
- Aura Conduit - +25% aura regen per level (max 4)
- Featherfall - -25% fall damage per level, boots (max 2)
EP Rolls: Weapons
Epic rolls on weapons can become:
- Frostbrand - slows on hit (max 4)
- Vampiric - heal 8% of damage per level (max 5)
- Voidpiercer - bonus damage scaling with the target's armor (max 5)
- Executioner - +10%/level vs targets under 30% health (max 3)
- Rending - shreds 2 armor per level for a few seconds (max 3)
Forge-Only
Fourteen more only come from the forge: Keen Edge, Featherweight, Reinforced, Toughened, Vitality, Swiftness, Regeneration (self-repair), Critical Strike, Soulbound (kept on death), Soul Render (vs spiritual), Stormbrand (lightning arcs), Predator's Mark (+kill EP), Cleave (splash hits), and Prospector (duplicate drops).
From the Forge
Quality forge work fills its engraving slots automatically - Superior 1, Masterwork 2, Legendary 3, Mythical 4 - matched to the item: weapons get weapon engravings, armor gets armor engravings. Better minigame scores mean higher engraving levels.

title: Engravings (suite)
text: Craft engravings survive gear evolution and stack with ones earned later through EP.

title: The Minigame
text:
Forging is a minigame. Each recipe runs you through challenges you must clear well to craft a quality result:
- Hammer - strike on rhythm
- Temperature - hold the heat in the right band
- Rune Alignment - line up the runes
- Magicule Flow - steady the flow of power
The better you perform across each challenge, the higher the quality of the gear you forge. Rush it and the result suffers.

title: The Forge
text:
The Forge lets you craft powerful, one-of-a-kind gear by hand rather than on a crafting table.
Interact with a Forge Station block to open the forge and choose a recipe.
Enabled by the ETForgeEnabled gamerule (on by default).
Craft a Basic Forge Station from 8 iron ingots around an anvil. Place it, then right-click to open the forge.
Station Upgrades
A station levels up on its own as you complete crafts on it:
- Basic - 20 crafts -> Magisteel
- Magisteel - 40 crafts -> Mythril
- Mythril - 80 crafts -> Dragonforge
On reaching the count, the station upgrades in place with a flourish and its craft counter resets.
Higher tiers can craft everything the lower tiers can, and they raise the minigame difficulty for tougher gear.
Server-configurable - a threshold of 0 disables that upgrade step.
Nation Bonuses
A station in your nation's own territory needs fewer crafts to upgrade, the discount growing with your nation's level.
The Forge Boon nation perk goes further, raising the quality and crit chance of every craft made inside that territory.

title: Recipes & Enhancements
text:
Each forge recipe defines its ingredients, the minimum station tier it needs, which minigames you must clear, and what it produces.
Recipes are data-driven: packs can add or tweak them, and they hot-reload with /reload. Some stay hidden until discovered.
Quality
Every craft earns a Quality rank from how well you forge:
- Poor, Common, Fine, Superior, Masterwork
- Legendary & Mythical - only via lucky critical upgrades
Higher quality means stronger stats, more durability, and more engraving slots (Superior 1 -> Mythical 4).
Engravings
Each engraving slot is filled with an engraving matched to the item - weapons draw from the weapon pool, armor from the armor pool. See the Engravings entry for the full list.
Slot count comes from quality, plus extras from your skills and titles. Better minigame scores mean higher engraving levels.
Gear forged before this system converts automatically and keeps its power.
Boosting Your Craft
Your quality, slot count, and levels improve with:
- A high minigame score
- Crafting skills like Godly Craftsman
- Titles, synergies, and a forge specialization (weaponsmith, armorsmith...)
Admins manage recipes with /etadmin forge.

title: Gaia, Lord of Earth
text:
Type: Ultimate Skill
The land itself answers. Every other Ultimate travels with you unchanged; Gaia is only as strong as the ground beneath your feet is yours.
Evolves from Earth Wall and Stone Shot (both mastered), and asks that your nation already hold something worth defending. Neither magic is consumed, and learning it costs no magicule.
Whose Ground
Before anything else, Gaia asks where you stand.

- On your own nation's claim, everything strikes at 160%.
- On unclaimed land, 60%.
- Inside another nation's claim, 30% - unless you are at war with them, and then the land forgets its loyalty and gives you 100%.
Only the force, reach and duration bend this way. What you pay never changes.
Tectonic Spikes
A widening cone of crystal spikes tears up out of the ground ahead of you, throwing whatever they catch into the air.
45 damage and 12 blocks of reach on your own soil, less elsewhere. The spikes stand for 10 seconds and then sink away on their own.
Cast over water or open air and nothing rises - and nothing is spent. Costs 3,000 magicule. 8s cooldown.
Stone Grasp
Stone closes on one quarry within 32 blocks and holds it where it stands for 5 seconds, grinding for 12 damage a second - up to 60 on your own soil, less elsewhere - as spikes ring its feet.
It cannot walk away. It can still turn, still strike, still work its own arts - this binds the legs, not the will.
Costs 12,000 magicule. 35s cooldown.
Sculpt

title: Gaia, Lord of Earth (suite)
text:
Raises or lowers a 3x3 patch of earth by one layer where you look - sneak to lower it. Unlike the spikes, this change is permanent.
It works only inside your own nation's claim, and only on plain earth and stone. It will not touch a chest, a machine, or anything another builder set down.
Costs 800 magicule. 2s cooldown.
Vein Bloom
Coaxes ore out of the bare stone already beneath you - iron, copper and coal most often, gold rarer still, and diamond rarest of all.
This is a trade, not a gift. Each vein drawn out costs 400 of the chunk's own magicule, and a single patch of ground will yield no more than 12 veins in a day. Bleed the land dry and it gives nothing until it recovers.
Costs 5,000 magicule. 60s cooldown.
Geomancy: Seeding
Pours up to 2,000 of your own magicule into the ground you stand on.
On your own claim it does more than fill: it deepens the land, raising how much that ground can ever hold by 250. That deepening stays. Seed the same fields long enough and your nation stands on richer earth than anyone else's.
Elsewhere it merely tops the ground up and is forgotten. Nothing takes root near world spawn.
10s cooldown.
Geomancy: Stripping
Sneak instead, and you tear 250 of that depth back out and pocket what the land can no longer keep.
This works on anyone's ground, including a rival's carefully tended fields - but ruining what someone else built burns a fifth of your maximum magicule every time. You will almost always end poorer than you began.
10s cooldown.

title: Gaia, Lord of Earth (suite)
text:
Bulwark of Gaia
A toggle apart from the modes. Standing on your own claim, you and every countryman within 12 blocks are shielded by Resistance II.
Step off your land and the shield sleeps - but the earth keeps taking its 1,000 magicule each tick regardless. Lighting it is a decision, not a habit. It snuffs itself out the moment you cannot pay.
Weight of the World
The ground never harms its lord. You take no falling damage, ever, from any height.
What you rule cannot wound you.

title: The Gravebound Colossus
text:
The Gravebound Colossus is a mountain of grave-stone and chain, rooted where it wakes. It carries 8000 health, heavy armor and a yellow boss bar.
It never takes a step. It cannot follow you, cannot reach your walls, and cannot break so much as a single block. Everything it does, it does from where it stands - and its reach is 48 blocks.
Where It Rises
The Colossus can arrive as a World Calamity - enabled with the ETCalamityEnabled gamerule - or be called deliberately by an admin.
It ignores the weak, stirring only for those of real strength or for anyone foolish enough to strike it first.
Do not try to move it. Pistons, teleports, every trick you know - it simply returns to its footing. There is no cliff to push it from.
The Three Sigils
Three sigils burn on its shield, and they are the whole battle.

- While any sigil stands, only one fifth of your damage reaches the Colossus. The rest is drunk by the sigil you are breaking.
- Shatter all three and it stands Exposed for 12 seconds, taking double damage.
- Then they reform, and it begins again.
Watch the boss bar - it shows how many sigils remain.
Its Reach
It answers every distance, so there is no safe one:

- A shockwave rolls out to 12 blocks, hurling back all it passes.
- A spire marks the ground beneath you, then erupts a heartbeat later - range will not save you.

title: The Gravebound Colossus (suite)
text:
Break it below 66% health and it awakens two more torments: a gravity well that drags everything within 24 blocks toward it, and sundered ground that burns underfoot for 12 seconds where it scatters it. Fleeing will not save you from either.
Breaking It
Hold your strongest blows for the Exposed window - damage spent outside it is worth a fifth as much.
Never disengage. Left alone for 30 seconds it begins knitting itself back together at 2% of its health every second, and your work is undone.
It is stone, not undead: Smite means nothing here, and poison, wither and hunger slide off it entirely.
Ground Down
Its blows grind through what should stop them. Where you carry a nullification, the Colossus drags it down to a mere resistance - you no longer take nothing, you take less. Barriers fare no better.
Those who have built for resistance still suffer least. They are simply no longer untouchable.
Spoils
It leaves no loot upon the ground.
Fell it as a Calamity and every soul who fought it earns crate keys and catalysts, with the greatest share going to whoever struck hardest - the same as any world disaster.

title: Gravity Well
text:
Type: Aspectual Magic (Gravity)
Hold to warp space where you are aiming - a gravity circle forms as you charge for 3 seconds (2s once mastered) - then release to collapse it into a crushing sphere, up to 24 blocks away.
The Well
For 8 seconds, everything living inside the 6-block sphere is dragged toward its centre - hardest at the rim, so clawing away only tightens the grip. Flight and dashes die at the edge.
Once a second the well crushes everyone inside for 3% of their maximum health.
Costs
Costs 500 magicule per cast. Cooldown: 25s, or 18s once mastered.
By default the well does not pull or crush players of your own nation.
Charged Collapse
Once mastered, keep holding past the normal charge time: 900 magicule for a 9-block sphere lasting 10 seconds that crushes for 5% of max health per second.
How to Unlock
Requires Burden magic mastered and at least 50,000 EP - only a magician who has made weight itself a weapon can fold space into a well.

title: Hecate, Goddess of Magic
text:
Type: Unique Skill
Hecate, goddess of magic. In your skill slot, nearly every spell you cast costs only 10% of its normal magicule - Reincarnation is the one exception, kept at full price.
Toggle
Toggling Hecate on grants instant casting with no chant needed, faster skill learning and mastery gain, and +30 bonus damage to all your spell damage (+75 once mastered).
Draws 50 magicule per tick while active - toggles off on its own if you run dry.
How to Unlock
Granted by an operator only - Hecate is not learned through normal growth.

title: Hephaestus, Lord of Creation
text:
Type: Ultimate Skill
The forge answers its lord. Where other Ultimates make you stronger in a fight, Hephaestus makes you stronger at the anvil - and then lets you carry the anvil into the fight.
Evolves from Creator and Godly Craftsman (both mastered). Neither is consumed, and learning it costs no magicule.
Reforge
Mends the item in your hand to whole. If you forged it yourself, its quality is rerolled from nothing - a fresh score between 35 and 95. The old worth is not remembered, for good or ill.
Costs 8,000 magicule, plus 4 more for every point of damage mended. 120s cooldown.
Engrave
Opens the engraving choice for the held item and burns one mark into it.
Costs 6,000 magicule per level of the engraving you pick - a deep mark costs deeply. 90s cooldown.
Conjure Arms
Draws a blade out of nothing, bound to your soul. It lasts 5 minutes and unmakes itself the moment you drop it.
Its quality climbs with your forging mastery - one rank per 8 levels. A novice conjures a novice's sword.
Costs 25,000 magicule. 10 minute cooldown.
Hammer of Creation
A hammerfall in a 5 block cone, striking everything before you.
Damage is 12 base, +0.8 for each level of forging mastery, and +6 for every quality rank of the finest thing you have ever made.
The smith's whole life swings with the hammer. Costs 4,000 magicule. 4s cooldown.
Chains of Hephaestus
Binds the nearest quarry within a 12 block cone where it stands, for 6 seconds.
Costs 10,000 magicule. 30s cooldown.
Ore Sense

title: Hephaestus, Lord of Creation (suite)
text:
A toggle apart from the modes. Every ore within 24 blocks glows through solid stone - including magic ore mother rock.
It drains 150 magicule each tick and snuffs itself out with a warning the moment you cannot pay.
Divine Hand
Once per day, the first forge stage you play scores a flawless 100/100. You still swing the hammer; the result was decided before you did.
The forge guides your hand.
Nation Forge Boon
While you are online and sworn to a nation, every online member of that nation forges better - a flat +3 forge quality, all of them, all the time.
It costs you nothing and has no daily limit. A nation with a Lord of Creation in it simply makes finer things than one without.

title: Iron Resolve
text:
Type: Extra Skill
A four-mode discipline of body and will:
- Vein Sense - Haste
- Iron Aegis - damage reduction scaled to EP
- Resolute Surge - Strength
- Last Stand - endure a killing blow
How to Unlock
Reach 20,000 EP.

title: Kaioken
text:
Type: Intrinsic Skill
A Saiyan's defiant technique - burn your life force to multiply your power in a blazing crimson aura. While it holds, your magicule and aura swell far past their limit and your strength, armor and speed surge with them. The red aura wraps your whole body in flame.
Ranks
Kaioken has four ranks, each a greater multiplier:
- Kaioken - double energy
- Kaioken x3
- Kaioken x10
- Kaioken x20
Higher ranks open as your EP grows: x3 at 100,000, x10 at 1,000,000, and x20 at 10,000,000 - and only once the skill is mastered. Cycle to the rank you can bear before you ignite.
The aura itself tells the tale: deep blood red at first, then orange, then gold, and white-hot at x20 - anyone watching can read how far you have pushed.
The Toll
Power like this devours you. While Kaioken burns it drains your health and energy every moment, though never enough on its own to kill you. It lasts up to 3 minutes - 6 once mastered - then burns out.
Exhaustion
When the aura fades your body pays: Weakness, Fragility and Paralysis for about 10 minutes. You cannot ignite Kaioken again until that exhaustion clears, and it will not stack with any other transformation.
How to Unlock
Kaioken is not learned - it is born into you. It comes to Medium Saiyans and the greater Saiyan forms beyond, with no cost to acquire.

title: Kamehameha
text:
Type: Aspectual Magic (Misc)
Hold to gather energy - a magic circle forms as you charge for 3 seconds (2s once mastered) - then release to fire a sustained blue-white energy wave. The beam follows your aim for 3 seconds, reaching up to 40 blocks.
Costs & Damage
Costs 2,500 magicule per cast. The wave deals 20 damage per hit and strikes repeatedly while a target stays inside it - sweep it across enemies or hold it on one for devastating total damage. Where it meets terrain it explodes.
Cooldown: 10s, or 3s once mastered.
Charged Wave
Once mastered, keep holding past the normal charge time to unleash the full Kamehameha: 5,000 magicule, 35 damage per hit, a much thicker beam that burns for 5 seconds with a far bigger explosion.
How to Unlock
Requires Thunder Lance magic mastered first - only a magician who has already shaped raw energy into a lance can hold a wave of this magnitude.

title: Leaderboard
text:
The Leaderboard ranks players by their feats and writes the results onto the vanilla scoreboard, so standings are always on display.
Tracked boards include Awakened/EP, prestige Resets, Titles, Records, Nations, and Forge mastery.
Checking Standings
Use /etleaderboard:
- awakened - who has awakened, and their EP
- resets - prestige rankings
- titles / records / nations
- forge - crafting score & rarity
- gui - open the leaderboard screen
Staying Listed
Leaderboards only show active players: you must have been online at least 5 hours (server-configurable) during this week or the last to appear.
Time counts automatically while you play. Fall below the requirement and you drop off the boards until you're active again - your scores are never lost, only hidden.

title: The Hollow Sovereign
text:
Vaelthorn, the Hollow Sovereign is an undead knight-lich - a fallen paladin fused with necromancy, magicule leaking from the cracks in its broken plate. It is far tougher than an ordinary foe: 5000 health, heavy armor, and a purple boss bar.
It only stirs for the powerful. Weak souls it ignores; it rouses for anyone of great strength - or anyone who strikes it first.
Where It Rises
The Hollow Sovereign can arrive as a World Calamity - enabled with the ETCalamityEnabled gamerule - or be called deliberately by an admin.
When it wakes it climbs from the ground in a burst of soul-fire and announces itself to the world. Then it hunts. It fights on foot, blinking across the battlefield to close distance.
Breaking It Down
The Sovereign is built to outlast a beating. No single blow can ever strip more than 4% of its health at once, so raw burst will not fell it.

- It raises the dead - while its servants live it shrugs off most damage. Cut them down first.
- It drains the land - where magicule pools thick, it heals fast. Fight it where the air is thin.
- It feeds on wounds - the harder it strikes you, the more it heals. Do not trade recklessly.
Weaknesses
It is undead: holy and fire sear it for extra harm, and Smite bites deep.
Beware its final trick - the first time you would kill it, it refuses to die, clawing back to life with fresh servants. Only the second death is true.
Its spirit can still be ground down directly - attacks that wound the soul slip past its guard.
Spoils

title: The Hollow Sovereign (suite)
text:
Lay it to rest and claim:
- The Lichbane title
- The Lich Slayer record
When it falls as a Calamity, everyone who fought it also earns crate keys, the same as any world disaster.

title: Area Magicule
text:
Every chunk in the world holds area magicule - a living resource that rises where strong beings gather and fades where they don't. High-magicule chunks regenerate everyone's magicule faster, grow rare crystals, and can spawn tougher monsters.
Off by default - a server enables it with the ETMagiculeWorldSystem gamerule.
Entity Influence
Any living being with enough magicule (50,000+) raises the area magicule of the chunk it's standing in over time, up to a cap.
That bonus spreads into neighboring chunks and slowly fades once nothing strong lingers - a chunk's magicule rises and falls with who's actually there.
Crystal Growth
In high-magicule chunks, Magic Ore has a chance to slowly convert into Mother Rock. Mother Rock then sprouts Magic Ore crystal buds that grow through four stages - Small, Medium, Large, then Cluster - each stage drawing more from the chunk's magicule.
Stronger Spawns
Natural mob spawns in very high-magicule chunks have a chance to be replaced by a tougher variant of the same monster.
Press F8 to see a debug readout of the magicule in the chunk you're standing in.

title: Mechanical Eyes
text:
Type: Intrinsic Skill
Requires the Create mod to be installed.
Your eyes gain the sight of Create's engineer's goggles, revealing stress and contraption information.
How to Unlock
Requires the Create mod to be installed.
With Create present, reach 25,000 EP.

title: Mechanical Hands
text:
Type: Intrinsic Skill
Requires the Create mod to be installed.
Your hands act as a Create wrench. Two modes let you rotate or remove any wrenchable contraption block.
How to Unlock
Requires the Create mod to be installed.
With Create present, reach 25,000 EP.

title: Meditation
text:
Type: Extra Skill
Center yourself to accelerate the regeneration of aura, magicule, and spiritual health.
Toggle on to begin; it slowly drains magicule while active.
How to Unlock
Reach 500 EP.

title: Contracts & Bounties
text:
The contract board is server-wide. Nations post jobs; anyone can take them.
Open it with /etcontract gui.
Two kinds of posting share the board:
- Delivery contracts - bring us N of an item
- Bounties - kill this player
It is the main way nations deal with players who are not their citizens.
Deliveries
A nation asks for an item and count, backed by treasury cash, an escrowed item stack, or both.
Anyone may fulfil one - including players with no nation at all.
Matching is by item type and count only. Durability, enchantments and custom names are ignored, so a worn enchanted pickaxe satisfies a request for one pickaxe. Post accordingly.
Bounties
A nation posts on a named online player. Whoever kills them first is paid automatically - no claim step.
Four rules keep them honest:
- The killer must not be in the posting nation - checked at the kill
- Nor may the target
- One open bounty per target - a second post tops it up
- The kill must be a direct player kill - void, fall, lava and mobs pay nothing
You get a login reminder if you have an active bounty on you, or one you posted.
Posting
You must be in a founded nation and hold a high enough rank.
From the board, the header shows + Contract and + Bounty buttons. They open a form where you pick the requirement and reward straight from your inventory grid.
Nothing moves when you click - the form uses ghost slots, so closing it can never lose or duplicate an item.
Commands still work: /etcontract post|postbounty|list|cancel|fulfil.

title: Contracts & Bounties (suite)
text:
Refunds
Contracts expire on a timer. Cancelled, expired and disbanded-nation postings all refund the same way: cash to the treasury, items to whoever posted them.
Nations have a cap on open contracts, and some servers block posting during a war.
A war bounty and a board bounty can sit on the same victim at once - a qualifying kill pays both.

title: Treasury & Upkeep
text:
A nation can hold money. The treasury pays for levels, perks, wars and contracts - and it is drained daily by upkeep.
Open the Treasury tab of the Nation screen, or use /etnation treasury.
This requires the banking mod and must be enabled by your server. Without it, nations level from score alone.
Income
- Deposits - /etnation treasury deposit
- Pickup tax - a slice of every member's cash pickup
- Territory income - paid periodically, scaling with claimed chunks and level
The pickup tax splits two ways: 5% to your treasury and 10% into the central bank reserve - a server-wide money sink.
Territory income never stops, even in debt. That is what makes recovery possible.
Spending
Levels are bought once the economy runs: /etnation levelup. You must both qualify by score and pay.
Perks are bought from the treasury: /etnation perks buy <id>. A few are 1-hour buffs (War Footing, Swift Hands, Stone Skin, Tax Holiday); the rest are permanent upgrades - Veterans' Discount, Forge Boon, Spawner Overclock, Golden Ledger, Honored Name, Charter of Industry, Bond of Souls, Deep Pockets, Defender's Resolve, Magicule Attunement.
Perks in Detail
- War Footing - +10% nation attack, 1h
- Swift Hands - Haste I, 1h
- Stone Skin - Resistance I, 1h
- Tax Holiday - suspends the pickup tax, 1h
- Veterans' Discount - halves war declare cost
- Forge Boon - better forge quality and crit in your territory
- Spawner Overclock - spawners act one level higher
- Golden Ledger - more treasury interest

title: Treasury & Upkeep (suite)
text:
- Honored Name - reputation stops decaying
- Charter of Industry - one extra mission per cycle
- Bond of Souls - larger subordinate EP share
- Deep Pockets - more contracts open at once
- Defender's Resolve - bonus war points while defending
- Magicule Attunement - passive regen in your territory
Upkeep
Every day your nation is billed:
30 per claimed chunk plus 100 x your level.
The bill scales with what you hold, so a sprawling empire costs more to run than a compact one.
Two mercies: a period where nobody logged in bills at 25%, and after server downtime only one missed period is billed at a time.
Watch the next-bill countdown in the Treasury tab.
Debt
Read this before it happens.
If a bill lands and you cannot pay, the treasury goes negative:
- Every nation bonus is suspended - achievements, perks, mission buffs, for every member
- Every spend is locked - levels, perks, wars, contracts, withdrawals
Achievements and missions cleared while in debt are still earned - only the bonus waits.
Recovery
Territory income keeps flowing and members can still deposit. The moment your balance reaches zero, bonuses are restored automatically and the Voice announces it.
There is no penalty beyond the time spent suspended.
The practical advice: do not spend your buffer to zero right before a bill. A nation that buys a perk an hour before upkeep is a nation about to lose all its bonuses.

title: Nation Missions
text:
Missions are recurring objectives your whole nation works on together.
Every nation rolls at the same moment, on a 7-day cycle, drawing 3 missions filtered to your level.
Open the Missions tab of the Nation screen, or use /etnation missions.
Missions do not need the banking mod - only their cash rewards do.
Delta & Absolute
At the roll, every nation statistic is snapshotted.

- A delta mission asks you to increase something - claim 20 more chunks
- An absolute mission asks you to reach a value - have 8 members
A delta mission cannot be completed by standing still, and cannot be cheesed by having already been large.
Frozen Targets
Thresholds are calculated from your population at the roll and then frozen.
Recruiting ten people mid-cycle does not move the goalposts - it makes the existing targets easier.
Missions auto-complete. There is no claim step.
A nation founded mid-cycle sits out until the next roll, starting fresh with everyone else.
Rewards
Each mission pays reputation, optional treasury cash, and +1 to your missions-completed count.
That counter is permanent and feeds three things: your nation's score (and so its level), an achievement condition, and a Standings column.
Clearing every mission in a cycle grants a nation-wide buff until the next roll.

title: Founding a Nation
text:
A Nation is your FTB team raised into a power on the world stage. The team owner rules as Sovereign; the rest become citizens.
Nations gain levels, claim land, earn achievements, build reputation, forge alliances, and wage war.
Off by default - a server enables it with the ETNationSystem gamerule.
Founding a Nation
First form an FTB party and claim a little land. Then, as the team owner, run /etnation found.
You need at least 2 members AND 1 claimed chunk.
The nation starts at Level 1. Its alignment is taken from you: Demon Lord -> Demonic, True Hero -> Heroic, otherwise Neutral.
Roles & Commands
Ranks come straight from your FTB team:
- Sovereign - the ruler (found, disband, capital)
- Officer - may set the capital
- Citizen - a member
Use /etnation:
- info / gui - view your nation
- score - level & score breakdown
- setcapital, list, disband
Growing Stronger
A nation's level (max 20) is driven by a score that rewards almost everything you do together:
- Members & claimed territory
- Total member EP
- Awakened members, True Heroes, Demon Lords
- Records earned & world events joined
- Nation achievements
The score updates on its own - check it with /etnation score.
Rewards & Glory
Each level grants more claim chunks (about 4 per level), so growing literally widens your borders.

title: Founding a Nation (suite)
text:
Achievements unlock nation-wide bonuses for members, and the first nation to reach certain feats seizes a World Record announced to everyone - Largest Territory, Most Citizens, Most Demon Lords, Mightiest Nation.
Going Further
Three deeper systems build on your nation - each has its own page:
- Reputation - your standing, and the diplomacy it gates
- Alliances & War - pacts and conflicts
- Nation Spawners - level-gated mob spawners

title: Reputation
text:
Every nation has a Reputation from -1000 to +1000, shown as a tier:
- Reviled, Infamous, Distrusted
- Neutral
- Respected, Honored, Exalted
Left alone, reputation slowly drifts back toward Neutral over time.
Gaining & Losing
Your deeds move the needle:
- Win a war (more on defense) +; lose one -
- Bully a far weaker nation -
- Form an alliance +; break one -
- Defend a Calamity, attend a Walpurgis, earn achievements +
- Hostile council rulings -, friendly ones +
What It Gates
Your standing opens or closes diplomacy:
- Rogue - fall to -250 or below and you are branded a rogue state
- War - you must sit above the war floor to declare
- Alliances - your tier caps how many you may hold: Neutral 2, Respected 3, Honored 4, Exalted 5 (Distrusted just 1; lower, none)

title: Nation Spawners
text:
Nation Spawners put your team's mob spawners under nation law - stronger nations may run bigger, deadlier spawners.
This only affects player-placed spawners. Natural, dungeon, and trial spawners are never touched.
Off by default - a server turns it on with the ETNationSpawnerSystem gamerule.
How It Works
When a nation member places a spawner, it is claimed for that nation.
Each time it tries to spawn a mob, two checks run:
- The mob must be unlocked at your nation's level
- Your nation must be under its active-mob cap
Fail either check and that spawn is skipped - the spawner just tries again next cycle.
Tier Ladder
Higher nation levels unlock stronger mobs and raise the cap:
- Lvl 1 - cap 8: common beasts, goblins, slimes
- Lvl 5 - cap 16: creepers, orcs, direwolves
- Lvl 10 - cap 32
- Lvl 15 - cap 64
- Lvl 20 - cap 96: apex beasts (megalodon, arch daemon)
Good to Know
Unlocks are cumulative - your nation can spawn anything from every tier at or below its level, using the cap of its highest unlocked tier.
The cap counts living spawner-mobs across your whole nation. Hit it and spawners pause; thin the herd or break a spawner to free room.
Datapacks can retune the levels, caps, and mob lists.

title: Alliances & War
text:
Nations shape the world through diplomacy - alliances and wars.
Alliances are pacts between nations. Allies may join your wars.
How many you can hold depends on your Reputation tier - from 5 at Exalted down to none while rogue. Forming one grants both nations reputation; breaking one costs the breaker dearly.
Declaring War
There is no accept step. Your Sovereign declares, and the war begins: /etnation war declare <player>.
Declaring costs treasury cash, +25% for every level you are above your target.
You are blocked if you are rogue, at your war cap, allied to them, or they are under loser grace from a recent defeat.
Declaring on a much weaker nation is bullying - allowed, but it costs reputation.
The Campaign
A war is a race for war score, not a fight to the death.

- Warmup - 24h, no scoring. Allies may join
- Active - 72h, scoring live
- Resolution - spoils and standing
- Cooldown - 2h before you may clash again
The loser also gets 24h of grace where nobody may declare on them.
Follow it with /etnation war status.
Scoring
- Enemy kill - 10 points
- Kill inside their claims - doubled
- Repeat kill on one victim - decays to a quarter
- Regicide (their Sovereign) - 50
- First Blood - 15
- Rampage (3 victims) - 30
- A Masterwork+ forge craft while the war runs - scales with quality
Raiding pays double. Farming one player does not pay at all. Crafters contribute without fighting.
Objectives rotate every 4 hours for both sides.
Bounties

title: Alliances & War (suite)
text:
Your Sovereign may escrow treasury cash on an enemy's head: /etnation war bounty <player> <amount> - minimum $1000.
Any killer on your side takes the whole escrow into their bank, plus 20 points for the side. Re-placing tops it up; unclaimed cash refunds when the war ends.
These are separate from the public bounty board.
Victory & Spoils
At the deadline the higher score wins. A tie is a draw with no spoils. A side may also /etnation war surrender at any time.
The victor loots a share of the loser's treasury - paid to the winning nation itself, not its allies.
Winning grants reputation, with a bonus if you were the defender. Losing or surrendering costs it.
Treasury withdrawals are locked during a war - build your war chest before you declare.

title: Ouroboros, Lord of Eternity
text:
Type: Ultimate Skill
The serpent that devours its own tail. Where Beelzebuth turns hunger outward, Ouroboros turns it inward - self-consumption that fuels endless renewal.
Evolves from Survivor and Gourmet (both mastered). Neither is consumed - the serpent takes nothing but its own tail.
Eternal Renewal
Toggle. While active, a share of the damage you deal returns to you as flesh and magicule - but your strikes land softer.
The serpent feeds on the fight itself. The icon shows while the feast lasts.
Timeless Fangs
Prime the fangs, then strike: your next blow bites three times - once now, twice more across the following seconds, each echo harder than the last.
The echoes pierce armor and belong to no one.
Molt
Shed your skin: severance and every affliction are cast off, and new scales harden over you - golden hearts that grow with what you shed.
Your own Cycle Debt clings too deep to molt away.
Coil Back
The coil remembers. One press returns you to where you stood five seconds ago and mends half of what you lost on the way.
The serpent does not undo the past; it slithers back along it.
Cycle's End
Pay half your greatest magicule to arm the cycle - the mark shows how long it holds. Die while it holds and you die in truth: the price is paid, and then you rise where you fell, diminished, bearing Cycle Debt that stacks with each rebirth.
A severed soul cannot complete the circle.
Serpent's Maw

title: Ouroboros, Lord of Eternity (suite)
text:
The serpent's jaws close on everything before you: a bite that strikes all in a cone ahead, dealing heavy damage plus a share of each victim's greatest health - and a quarter of all it takes returns to you as flesh.
An empty bite costs nothing. The maw does not snap at air.

title: Raphael, Lord of Wisdom
text:
Type: Ultimate Skill
The Lord of Wisdom — a battlefield-computation entity. Power flows from Analysis: mark a target with Analyze, then Prediction can negate their attacks, the Multilayer Barrier hardens against them, and Reverse-Engineer reconstructs their skills — no luck involved.
Shift-press Analyze to cycle appraisal vision: Off, Entities, Blocks, Both.
Independent Counsel
Raphael watches the battle and proposes actions — deploying the barrier when your vitals drop, engaging Prediction when an analyzed hostile closes in. Press the skill key while a proposal is pending to approve it.
Against a lethal blow, Raphael acts on its own: an emergency defense leaves you at 1 HP, at a heavy magicule cost.
Ars Magna & Workshop
Instant casting, chant annulment and halved magicule costs apply only while a computed situation exists — a live analysis, Prediction, or the barrier running.
The Sage's Workshop mode bundles the artisan facilities: spatial storage, research enchanting, refining, repeat crafting, Degenerate crafting and synthesis/separation (sneak to cycle).
How to Unlock
Master both Great Sage and Godly Craftsman, become a True Demon Lord or True Hero, and reach 10,000,000 EP.
Servers may relax these requirements via config.

title: Record Bonuses
text:
Every earned Record grants a permanent bonus - and unlike titles, there are no slots to manage. All of your Record bonuses are always active.
Bonuses include:
- Attribute boosts
- Status effects
- Skill-mastery gains
Ever Stronger
Records come in seven rarities - Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary, Mythic, Divine.
The more Records you write, the permanently stronger you become - a reward no reset can take away.

title: Records
text:
Records are a permanent chronicle of your journey. Once earned, a Record is yours forever - it survives prestige resets and even death.
Enabled by the ETRecordsEnabled gamerule (on by default).
Records vs Titles
Records mirror the Title system, but with one big difference - they are never wiped and never need equipping. Their rewards are simply always on.
They are grouped into categories:
- Combat & Exploration
- Crafting & Nation
- Social & World Event

title: Unlocking Records
text:
Each Record lists conditions - feats the game tracks for you automatically. Meet every condition and the Record is written at once.
Examples:
- Kills, EP reached, deaths survived
- Biomes & structures found, distance walked
- Skills learned/mastered, forge crafts
- Calamities slain, wars won, Walpurgis attended
World-First Records
Some Records are a race. The first player ever to achieve one claims the World First - announced to the entire server by the Voice of the World.
Everyone can still earn the Record afterward; only the first claims the glory.

title: Runesmith's Insight
text:
Runesmith's Insight is the smith's own skill - the one thing at the forge you cannot buy, trade, or learn with Existence Points.
It arrives on its own. Finish 25 successful crafts and it is simply yours, with no prompt and no cost. Nothing you do at the anvil is wasted; the count only ever goes up.
At the Anvil
From the moment you hold it, every forging minigame gets kinder.

- The sweet spot is 25% wider, so the band you are aiming for is easier to hit.
- Heat drains 25% slower, giving you more time before the temperature drifts out from under you.
Both apply the instant a craft begins. There is nothing to switch on.
Mastery
Every successful forge after you learn it adds one mastery point. Keep working and it masters itself.
A mastered Runesmith's Insight gives each craft a 25% chance of one extra engraving slot - a free roll at another property on the finished piece, on top of everything your other skills grant.
It stacks with Godly Craftsman, Researcher, Analyst and the rest. They are not alternatives to each other.
Notes
The skill sits in your list but has no button and no active use - it works entirely on its own while you craft.
Forging is on by default. If an admin has turned it off with the ETForgeEnabled gamerule, nothing at the anvil progresses, this skill included.

title: Saiyan
text:
The Saiyan bloodline - a warrior race that grows stronger with every battle and brush with death.
Saiyans ascend through four tiers of raw power:
- Lesser Saiyan
- Medium Saiyan
- High Saiyan
- Divine Saiyan
Each tier raises combat potential and unlocks greater strength.

title: Scavenger
text:
Type: Extra Skill
Fortune favors you. Passively grants Luck II.
Once mastered, toggle the skill on to raise your fortune to Luck III.
How to Unlock
Granted by an operator or in Creative mode.
Once held, its passive Luck works for everyone; only mastered holders can toggle the Luck III boost.

title: Finale Siege
text:
A season does not simply stop. When it is called to an end, the world throws one last battle at whoever is still standing - the Finale Siege.
Win it and the season closes with spoils. Lose it and the season closes anyway, with nothing.
The Waves
The siege is cried, then 10 minutes pass so the living can gather.
Four waves of the undead follow. The first is 8 strong; each after adds 4 more and another quarter of health. A wave breaks early once nine in ten are dead, or after 5 minutes.
The whole siege dies of old age after 45 minutes.
The Boss
After the last wave comes the Lich or the Gravebound Colossus, chosen blind, at x3 health and x2 damage.
There is nothing to join. Fight what comes. The world counts every blow each of you lands, and remembers who struck the last one.
Spoils
If the boss falls:
- Top damage and the killer both take the Siegebreaker title
- Every wounder shares a 100 point Legacy pool, split by damage, never less than 2
- Every nation that fought shares a 200 point ladder pool
- The top five nations split $50,000 in treasury
Nation spoils come from their own purse - being sworn to a nation never shrinks your own Legacy share.
Failure
If the clock runs out, or the last player logs off, the siege is lost. No title, no Legacy pool, no ladder points, no treasury.
The season still closes. Your Chronicle tiers, your leaderboard finishes and your nation's levels still become Legacy as always - only the siege's own spoils are forfeit.

title: Legacy
text:
Everything you build in a season is unmade when it ends - your EP, your skills, your nation. Legacy is the exception.
Legacy Points are kept outside the world itself, so they outlive the wipe and follow you into every season after. They buy cosmetics and nothing else; there is no path from Legacy to power.
Earning Points
Paid once, at the season's close, for what you did:
- 10 per Chronicle tier completed
- 25 per top-three leaderboard slot held
- 2 per level your nation reached
- A share of 100 for wounding the Finale boss
A season where you cleared the Chronicle and topped a board is worth some eighty points. Most of the shop is several seasons deep.
The Shop
Codex, Season tab, Legacy section - your balance, what you own, what you wear.
Chat badges from 25 to 200 points, a pair of season-limited badges at 130, three display titles from 90 to 220, and one headline piece: the Dawnrise Aura at 350 - a glowing ring that plays every time you log in, sized to your character.
Servers may stock more.
What You Keep
Bought is yours forever. Plushies and titles are handed back to you each new season when you log in - a world wipe never costs you a purchase.
Badges sit beside your name in chat. Wear one at a time, or none.
Some cosmetics can only be bought during a certain season. That limit never touches what is already in your collection.

title: Season Mutators & Titles
text:
Every season rolls one buff and one twist when it starts. They hold for the whole season and bind everyone equally. The pair in force is shown in the Season tab of your Codex.
A mutator only rolls if the thing it touches is running - a calamity twist never appears where calamities are switched off.
Kind Years
- Surge of Souls - kill EP x1.5
- Generous World - daily rewards x2
- Restless Ambition - one extra daily
- Prosperous Trade - mission and contract pay x1.5
- Forgemaster's Favor - one free perfect forge stage daily
- Magicule Bloom - magicule regen x1.5
- Enlightened Age - mastery gain x1.5
- Golden Age - mob cash x2
Hard Years
- Magicule Drought - magicule regen x0.5
- Wrathful Calamities - calamities x1.5 health, x1.25 damage
- Heavy Crown - nation upkeep x1.25
- Cruel World - hostile mobs +15% health, +10% damage
- Demanding Chronicle - daily targets x1.5
- Age of Calamity - calamities twice as often, one fewer player needed
- Taxing Weave - skill and magic costs x1.15
Season Titles
Eleven titles can be earned only during a season, and most only under the twist that season rolled. A different twist simply never offers them.

- Chronicler - Bronze, Silver and Gold, for climbing the Chronicle deep
- Drought-Blessed - dailies cleared through the Drought
- Iron Steward - upkeep kept paid under a Heavy Crown
Season Titles
- Relentless - every daily cleared, days running, under a Demanding Chronicle
- Worldbreaker - a long tally of kills in a Cruel World

title: Season Mutators & Titles (suite)
text:
- Weave-Hardened - enduring the Taxing Weave
- Wrathbreaker - standing against Wrathful Calamities
- Calamity's Bane - slaying in the Age of Calamity
- Siegebreaker - topping the Finale Siege
The greatest are cried across the whole server. What exactly they ask is never written down - that is the point of them.

title: Seasons
text:
A season is a run of the world with its own ladder laid over everything else you do. You climb a Chronicle of tiers, clear daily objectives, and when it ends the best players and nations are paid - then the world wipes and the next one begins.
Off by default - a server enables it with the ETSeasonSystem gamerule. If the Season tab is missing, no season is running.
Where To Look
Open Tensura's main menu, click Codex, then the Season tab. It holds three things:
- Chronicle - your tier, its objectives, today's dailies
- Legacy - your points and the cosmetic shop
- Nations - the nation ladder standings
There is no season command for you to type. It is all in that tab.
The Chronicle
A ladder of tiers. Each names several objectives and you must meet all of them.
Progress is read from your lifetime totals - the world wipes each season, so your lifetime is your season.
You never claim a tier. Satisfy it and it awards itself, announces you in chat, and banks points for your nation.
First Flames
The default track runs ten tiers, climbing from Common Keys to Elite:
- Awakening - 500 kills, 5 biomes
- Apprentice - 10 forges, 100,000 EP, 5 records
- Wayfarer - 12 biomes, 5 structures
- Blooded - 80,000 kills, 5 titles
- Veteran - 10,000 kills, 10 titles
- Calamity's Witness - wound a calamity, 500,000 EP
- Warforged - 25 war kills, 50 forges
- Ascending - 5,000,000 EP, 15 records
- Ascendant - 50,000,000 EP, 25 records

title: Seasons (suite)
text:
- Legend of the Season - 250,000,000 EP, 3 calamities slain, 50 records, a war won
A second built-in track, Second Dawn, raises every target further. Servers may run their own track entirely.
Dailies
Two objectives are rolled for you each day - kills, forges, biomes, structures, records or titles.
They reset at midnight UTC, not your local midnight and not with nation upkeep. Clearing one pays a Common Key and banks points for your nation.
There is no reroll. An uncleared daily is simply gone.
The Nation Ladder
Your season work scores for your nation too:
- Chronicle tier - 10 points
- Daily objective - 2
- War won - 100
- Finale Siege damage - a share of 200
Points are banked as you earn them, so changing nations never moves what you already earned. Nationless players simply score nothing - nothing is taken from you.
The Close
When a season ends, the top three on each leaderboard - EP, resets, titles, records, forging - each take an Elite Key. Top two boards and you are paid twice. Log off before the close and it waits for you.
Ladder standings are announced, everything you did converts to Legacy Points, and the world begins again.
If the Finale Siege is enabled, it is fought first.

title: Static Chain
text:
Type: Aspectual Magic (Lightning)
Hold to cast, then release to fire a lightning arc at whatever you're looking at within 14 blocks. The arc then jumps to nearby enemies - up to 4 targets total - dealing less damage with each hop, and leaving every target Glowing and Slowed.
Costs & Damage
Costs 120 magicule per cast. First hit deals 20 magic damage, each following hop dealing 65% of the last.
Chain jumps reach up to 6 blocks between targets.
Charged Cast
Once mastered, holding past the normal cast time charges the spell: 200 magicule, 35 base damage, 4 extra hops, and each hop only decays to 80% of the last - the arc holds its power much longer.
How to Unlock
Requires Thunder magic mastered first - Static Chain builds on it.

title: Title Synergies
text:
Every title carries hidden tags (like combat, dragon, or soul). When the right mix of tags appears across your titles, a passive Synergy awakens - an extra bonus layered on top of your titles.
By default synergies read your unlocked titles, so even un-equipped ones count toward them.
How They Match
A synergy checks three things across your titles:
- Coverage - you hold its required tags (all of them, or at least a few)
- Volume - enough different titles carry those tags
- Depth - some demand several titles of the same tag
Meet all three and the synergy is satisfied.
Enabling Synergies
Synergies are opt-in. When you qualify you get a Synergy Available notice - it does not switch on by itself.
Turn it on with /etsynergy enable <id>; review and manage with /etsynergy list and /etsynergy disable <id>.
You may run up to 3 synergies at once (configurable).
Power & Examples
The harder a synergy is to reach, the stronger and rarer its reward:
- Blooded Novice - combat + monster, 4 titles
- Pathfinder - any 3 of exploration/survival/knowledge, 4 titles
- Demon Lord's Aura - demonic/leadership/combat, 6 titles
- Sovereign of Ruin - 4 dark tags across 8 titles
Tag Vocabulary
Collect titles across these tags to feed synergies.
Primary: combat, heroic, demonic, leadership, exploration, crafting, magic, survival, knowledge, monster
Themes: fire, ice, void, soul, dragon, oni, undead, predator, sage, elemental, holy, cursed, wealth, speed, nature
Good to Know

title: Title Synergies (suite)
text:
Synergies are live: change your titles and any you no longer qualify for switches off by itself.
Active bonuses re-apply when you log in. You can opt out of any synergy you dislike, and a server may require titles to be equipped (not just unlocked) to count.

title: Titles & Synergies
text:
Titles are honors you earn for your deeds. Equip a title to gain its passive bonus - attribute boosts, status effects, or special stats.
Open Titles and Synergies from the Tensura main screen.
Enabled by the ETTitleSystem gamerule.
Earning Titles
The game watches your progress and unlocks a title the moment you meet all of its requirements - things like:
- Kills, EP, single-hit damage
- Biomes & structures found, distance walked
- Skills held, mastered, or by type
- Awakening, alignment, other titles held
Some stay hidden until earned; some announce to the whole server.
Slots & Equipping
Earning a title does not auto-equip it. You slot titles into a limited number of slots, and only equipped titles grant bonuses.
Slots = 3 base, +1 every 2 prestiges, up to 10.
Swap them freely to suit the moment.
Rarities
Nine rarities mark a title's prestige:
- Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic
- Legendary, Mythic, Unique
- Hardcore & Cursed - special
Hardcore titles ignore the slot limit and stay always-on. A few titles are one-of-a-kind - only one player may hold them at a time.
Prestige & Persistence
When you prestige (reset), ordinary titles are wiped - you re-earn them as you grow again.
Exceptions stay with you:
- Hardcore - kept (re-enable after reset)
- Cursed - kept, but switched off
- Event titles - kept (cannot be re-earned)
Synergies
Every title carries tags (combat, fire, dragon, soul...). When your titles share the right tags, passive Synergy bonuses switch on by themselves.

title: Titles & Synergies (suite)
text:
You can run a few at once (configurable) and opt out of any you dislike.
A server option can require titles to be equipped, not just unlocked, to count.

title: Voice of the World
text:
The Voice of the World is the cinematic narrator. Great moments appear as an on-screen banner:
- Skill unlocks & evolutions
- Title and Record unlocks
- World events - dungeons, monsters, Calamities
- World-first feats (announced to everyone)
Tuning the Voice
Shape how it speaks in the Voice settings:
- Turn the overlay on or off
- Echo messages to chat
- Play sounds
- Use the Minecraft narrator (accessibility)
- Stretch display time, or merge rapid messages into one banner
Spoken Audio
An optional spoken-audio layer can read announcements aloud, voiced by a text-to-speech service.
It is set up by the server and is entirely optional - the overlay works fine without it.

title: Void Edge
text:
Type: Unique Skill
Cloak yourself in the void and hurl void projectiles at your enemies.
This skill is the precursor to the Void Sovereign ultimate.
How to Unlock
Granted by an operator or in Creative mode - it is not learned through normal growth.
Note: the Void Edge sword is a separate weapon item, not this skill.

title: Void Sovereign
text:
Type: Ultimate Skill
