Dominion over the void. Open a void domain, strike with a null slash, dash through space with Event Horizon, and collapse the souls of those caught within.
Evolves from Void Edge.
How to Unlock
Disabled in survival by default - it is granted only by an operator or in Creative mode.
In lore, it evolves from Void Edge.

title: Walpurgis Council
text:
The Walpurgis is a grand council of Demon Lords, held in its own dimension - a banquet hall with a dueling arena.
There the mightiest gather to claim land, name enemies and allies, recognise new Demon Lords, and settle great matters by vote.
Off by default - a server enables it with the ETWalpurgisEnabled gamerule. Only Demon Lords may take part.
Convening
Any Demon Lord may right-click a Walpurgis Orb to call a council; others answer by clicking the Orb too.
Once 3 Demon Lords have answered (within ~10 min), a portal opens and the banquet begins.
Missed the portal? Use /etwalpurgis teleport while a council is active.
The Agenda
In the Agenda phase (~5 min), attendees submit motions with /etwalpurgis submit. Motion types:
- Territorial Claim
- Declare Enemy / Declare Neutral
- Treaty
- New Demon Lord Recognition
- Expel Member
- Free Topic
Filling the Form
Title - required, cannot be left blank.
Description - free text for most motions. For a Territorial Claim it must be the two corners of the plot in block coordinates: x1,z1 x2,z2.
Target Player - appears for Declare Enemy, Declare Neutral, Expel Member, Treaty, and New Demon Lord Recognition. It's a hard requirement for Declare Enemy, Declare Neutral, and Treaty - the form won't let you submit without a name there.
Working the Agenda
A Demon Lord isn't limited to one motion - submit as many as you want while the Agenda phase is open.
Motions go to a vote in the order they were submitted.

title: Walpurgis Council (suite)
text:
The phase doesn't need to run its full ~5 minutes: once every attendee has submitted at least one motion, deliberation begins early. Otherwise the timer decides when submissions close.
Deliberation
Motions are voted on one at a time. Cast yours with /etwalpurgis vote aye|nay|abstain.
A simple majority passes a motion.
Carrying the Walpurgis Seal makes your vote count double - the word of an elder carries weight.
The Combat Clause
A tied vote is settled by blood. The council opens a duel window - use /etwalpurgis challenge <player> within 60s to fight for the outcome.
Win and the motion passes; lose and it fails. If no one steps forward, the motion fails by default.
Outcomes & Aftermath
Passed motions reshape the world:
- Enemy - the target is marked and hunted
- Treaty - a pact between two lords
- Claim - land recorded to its lord
If the proposer leads a Nation, the ruling ripples into nation diplomacy (war, alliance, or claim budget).
Then the council rests on cooldown (~2 hours). Review standings with /etwalpurgis territories | enemies | treaties.

title: Alchemy Furnace
text:
Crafting
Craft with copper ingots, copper blocks, a blast furnace, and magic ore shards. When placed, automatically forms a 2-block-tall structure.
How to Use
The Alchemy Furnace has 7 slots:
Material Slots (left 3): Ingredient type and the count in each stack must match exactly. The three slots are unordered, but extra materials invalidate the recipe.
Fuel Slot (bottom 1): Add any burnable item. Shift+Right-click quick-inserts fuel.
Output Slots (right 3): Finished pills appear here.
Acceleration
1. Alchemy Prodigy
Enable the skill and remain near the furnace:

- Normal — cooking time is halved (effective range about 5 blocks)
- Mastered — cooking time becomes 10% (effective range about 10 blocks)
2. Fire Spirit Root
A Fire-root player within about 5 blocks adds a ×0.8 cooking-time multiplier, stacking with the skill.
3. Special Fuels
See "Essence Charcoal & Fuels".

title: Essence Charcoal & Fuels
text:
Essence Charcoal & Fuels
The Alchemy Furnace accepts any burnable item as fuel, but different Essence Charcoals provide different speed multipliers, greatly reducing crafting time.
Normal fuels (coal, charcoal, etc.) have a 1.0x speed multiplier, providing only base crafting speed.
Below are the speed bonuses for each type:
Speed Overview
Cooking progress currently advances at an integer speed, discarding decimal portions. Effective defaults are:
- Mud Essence Charcoal — 1x
- Yellow Essence Charcoal — 1x
- Black Essence Charcoal — 1x
- Void Essence Charcoal — 2x
- Prime Essence Charcoal — 5x
- Explosive Crystal — 10x
Prime Essence Charcoal reduces a 30-minute Foundation Building Pill to about 6 minutes. Configure values in mortal_cultivation-alchemy_furnace.toml.

title: Foundation Building Pill
text:
[Foundation Building Pill]
The first pill on the path of cultivation.
Effect: A required condition for evolving from Human to Foundation Establishment.
Evolution Requirements:
- Existence Points (EP) >= 2000
- Consume 1 Foundation Building Pill
Right-click to consume.

title: Giant Spirit Pill
text:
[Condensed Essence Pill]
A pill that eases inner demons and stabilizes the Nascent Soul.
Effect: A required condition for evolving from Golden Core to Nascent Soul.
Evolution Requirements:
- Existence Points (EP) >= 30000
- Consume 1 Giant Spirit Pill
Bonus Effect: Grants Resistance I for 5 minutes.
Right-click to consume.

title: Heaven Cleansing Elixir
text:
[Heaven Cleansing Elixir]
Cleanses the meridians, purging impurities from the cultivator's system.
Special Effect: Wastelander race can transform into Human race upon consumption, unlocking the path of cultivation!
This is one of three ways for a Wastelander to escape their fate.
Right-click to consume.

title: Mystic Void Elixir
text:
[Mystic Void Elixir]
A mysterious pill that resonates with the void, granting profound insight into the nature of reality.
Effect: A required condition for evolving from Spirit Transformation to Void Refinement.
Evolution Requirements:
- Existence Points (EP) >= 100,000
- Consume 1 Mystic Void Elixir
Right-click to consume.

title: Spirit Cleansing Pill
text:
[Spirit Cleansing Pill]
The Spirit Cleansing Pill refines an awakened spirit root, refreshing it into another spirit root.
Effect: Consuming it refreshes your current spirit root and grants the resonance and inheritance tied to the new root.
Limit: It has no effect if you have not awakened a spirit root.
Right-click to consume.

title: Stellar Core Pill
text:
[Stellar Core Pill]
A powerful buff pill that harnesses the power of stars.
Effect: Grants the following buffs for 3 minutes:
- Strength III
- Resistance I
- Absorption II
Cooldown: 10 minutes
Note: Combat support pill, not used for race evolution. Right-click to consume.

title: Void Refinement Pill
text:
[Void Refinement Pill]
A wondrous pill condensed from void essence, helping cultivators break through the Void Refinement bottleneck.
Effect: A required condition for evolving from Void Refinement to Unity.
Evolution Requirements:
- Existence Points (EP) >= 200,000
- Consume 1 Void Refinement Pill
Right-click to consume.

title: Wastelander
text:
Wastelander
Wastelanders cannot undergo any evolution. Only by repairing their meridians through special means can they begin the path of cultivation.
Here are three ways to become Human:
Transformation Methods
- Heaven Cleansing Elixir
Consuming it directly transforms you into the Human race.

- Dream Realm Challenge
When sleeping at night, there is a chance to enter a Dream Realm. Defeat the Wither Skeleton to succeed and become Human.

- Break and Rebuild Manual
A possible reward for deciphering an Ancient Book at a Scholar Table. Right-click it to become Human.

title: Deciphering the Array
text:
Starting
Place an Ancient Book in Decipher to begin deciphering and breaking its array.
Rotating Runes
Left-click a rune to rotate it counterclockwise.
Right-click to rotate it clockwise.
Each valid rotation consumes a random 3 to 8 runes from the nearby table.
Connection Rules
The board contains a 6x4 array. Every opening must align with the neighboring cell, and all runes must form one complete network from the array's heart.
Connected paths carry flowing golden light. A gap, one-sided connection, or isolated branch means the array is not solved.

title: Ruins Progression
text:
A Lost Legacy
This progression revolves around ruins, runes, and ancient books. Prepare Spirit Glasses and an empty Reflection Orb before searching for an underground stele grotto.
Only the glasses reveal hidden runes and allow the orb to work on a stele.
Complete Route
- Gather runes from a stele
- Extract and store them in a Rune Table
- Find Torn Pages in ruin chests
- Analyze them into an Ancient Book
- Spend runes to rotate its array
- Connect the network and claim a random manual
Two Resources
Deciphering needs two separate resources:
Torn Pages power Ancient Book production, while runes pay for rotations on its array.
Gathering only one cannot complete the progression, so collect both while exploring.

title: Lost Manuals
text:
Deciphering Rewards
Each solved Ancient Book has an equal chance to become one of these manuals:
- Sword Flight Manual
- Break and Rebuild Manual
- Myriad Swords Return Manual
- Supreme Alchemy Canon
These manuals do not generate directly in wild loot chests.
Sword Flight Manual
[Sword Flight Manual]
Right-click to learn the extra skill Sword Flight. A successful study consumes the manual outside Creative mode. A player who already knows the skill does not consume it again.
Myriad Swords Return
[Myriad Swords Return Manual]
Right-click to learn the extra skill Myriad Swords Return. A successful study consumes the manual outside Creative mode. A player who already knows the skill does not consume it again.
Break and Rebuild
[Break and Rebuild Manual]
A meridian-restoring art intended for the Wastelander race. When its conditions are met, right-clicking the manual sheds that broken state and opens a cultivation path.
Supreme Alchemy Canon
[The Supreme Alchemy Canon]
Right-click to comprehend Alchemy Prodigy. If the skill is already known, studying instead increases its mastery until it is fully mastered.

title: Rune Table
text:
Crafting a Rune Table
A Rune Table extracts and stores runes from golden Reflection Orbs. Right-click the block to open its orb slot and storage display.
Extracting Runes
Place a filled golden orb in the slot. It rises above the table and extraction begins. After about 5 minutes, the table gains 100 runes and the orb loses 1 durability. It returns to blue while durability remains, but is consumed after its fifth extraction.
Capacity and Pausing
A Rune Table stores up to 500 runes.

title: Torn Pages & Ancient Books
text:
Crafting the Scholar Table
The brush and cinnabar blood ink in this recipe are tools. Both remain in the crafting grid after the table is made. Right-click the table to open its interface.
Finding Torn Pages
Torn Pages may appear in chests from Ancient Cities, Desert Pyramids, Jungle Temples, Ruined Portals, and Underwater Ruins. Each eligible chest yields 0 to 3 pages.
Complete manuals never generate directly in wild loot chests.
Analyzing Pages
[Torn Page]
Place Torn Pages in the Scholar Table's Analysis page to analyze them automatically.
One Book, One Array
[Ancient Book]
Place the Ancient Book produced by analyzing Torn Pages into Decipher to begin breaking its array.

title: Spirit Glasses & Grottoes
text:
Crafting Spirit Glasses
Right-click the glasses to equip them in the head slot.
Finding a Grotto
Stele grottoes generate sparsely below ground in the Overworld, averaging about one every 1,200 blocks. They only appear in newly generated chunks.
There is no artificial entrance; explore underground caves or dig into the surrounding rock.
Ancient Stele
[Ancient Stele]
Each grotto has a pool, central island, earth and moss layers, glow berries overhead, and a stele at its center.
The stele cannot be mined with a pickaxe. Wear Spirit Glasses to see its faint golden runes.

title: Reflection Orb
text:
Collecting the Inscription
[Reflection Orb]
While wearing Spirit Glasses, right-click an Ancient Stele with an empty Reflection Orb. Collection cannot begin without the glasses, if the orb is already filled, or while the stele is busy.
Rune Capacity
A filled orb carries 100 runes. The orb has 5 durability; every completed extraction at a Rune Table consumes 1 durability, and the orb disappears when all five uses are spent.

title: Alchemist Fire
text:
A cultivator's true flame. Hold the skill key to breathe fire, burn targets in front of you, and refine smeltable blocks or items.
Type: Intrinsic Skill
Input: Hold the skill key
Cost: 400 magicules per second, or 200 per second with a Heaven Spirit Root
While the breath remains on a target, each damage check has 10 base damage. Fire Spirit Root increases damage by 50%, while Heaven Spirit Root increases it by 60%. Releasing the key removes the Alchemist Fire breath entity.

title: Alchemy Prodigy
text:
Precise control reduces refinement time and stabilizes pill formation. This skill improves nearby Alchemy Furnaces.
Type: Extra Skill
Input: Press the skill key to enable or disable
Cost: None
While enabled, it dynamically changes nearby Alchemy Furnaces: within about 5 blocks, normal skill reduces total cooking time to 50%; when mastered, it reaches about 10 blocks and reduces time to 10%. Leaving range or disabling it restores the original total while preserving proportional progress.

title: Cultivating the Mystic Dao
text:
Sit within the void and refine your divine consciousness. This skill suspends the cultivator in meditation and manifests a Taoist array below them.
Type: Extra Skill
Obtainment: Cannot be unlocked automatically through EP; it must be obtained by other means
Input: Keep holding the skill key; release to stop
Cost: None
Meditation creates a Taoist array, fixes your hovering position, restores 1% of max health and base magicules each second, and grants mastery every 3 seconds. It does not currently restore aura, and its effects require the key to remain held.

title: Early Cultivation
text:
A basic cultivation attack that condenses magicules into a small fireball and launches it along your line of sight.
Type: Intrinsic Skill
Cost: 50 magicules
Cooldown: 8 seconds
The fireball flies quickly, explodes on impact with an entity or block, has about 2 explosion power, and deals fire damage on direct hits. It also explodes after about 5 seconds or around 50 blocks of travel.

title: Great Sage
text:
The evolved form of mastered Mischief, combining Celestial Twin, Defy, Cloud Walker, Primal Fury, and White Lie.
Type: Extra Skill
Obtainment Cost: 130000 MP
Learning Cost: 3000
Max Mastery: 2500
Celestial Twin summons a stronger clone and has a 12-minute cooldown. If the twin already exists, sneak-use to teleport to it with a 10-second teleport cooldown. The clone copies your data and gains Self Regeneration, doubled damage, doubled health, resistance, and absorption.
Defy costs 30000 MP, grants about 10 seconds of near-invulnerability, and also affects your twin. When it ends, accumulated damage becomes absorption at 1.5x value; cooldown is 5 minutes. Cloud Walker costs 1% of base maximum magicules to start, grants high-speed flight and invisibility, and has a 50-second cooldown.
Primal Fury costs 1% of base maximum magicules to start, temporarily equips the Ruyi Jingu Bang, doubles attack, health, and speed, and grants Strength and Speed effects. White Lie costs 15000 MP and lasts 5 minutes: with no target player, it hides you; with a target player, it disguises you and temporarily copies one skill you do not have. The copied skill is removed when the effect ends. Cooldown is 5 minutes.

title: Hundred Ghosts Surge
text:
Command a hundred souls through the Ten Thousand Soul Banner. This skill revolves around summoning, recalling, and harvesting souls from the banner.
Type: Extra Skill
Obtainment: Cannot be unlocked automatically through EP; it must be obtained by other means
Modes: Summon Mode / Soul Collection Mode
Summon Mode costs 100000 magicules, summons or recalls your banner, and has a 40-minute cooldown. Soul Collection Mode costs 50000 magicules and converts souls in your owned or targeted banner into soul points; on success, it has a 20-minute cooldown.

title: Mischief
text:
Trick the three realms with more than brute force. Mischief focuses on a celestial twin, concealment, and death avoidance.
Type: Extra Skill
Obtainment Cost: 85000 MP
Max Mastery: 1000
Modes: Celestial Twin / White Lie
Celestial Twin costs 20% of your base maximum magicules and summons a following clone at your line of sight. The clone copies your stats, equipment, and skills, gains Self Regeneration, deals double attack damage, and has a 40-minute cooldown. If a twin already exists, sneak-use to teleport to it with a 60-second teleport cooldown.
White Lie costs 15000 MP, lasts 5 minutes, grants invisibility and presence concealment, and has a 10-minute cooldown. If your twin is alive when you would die, you teleport to it, inherit its health, and the twin disappears to cancel that death.

title: Myriad Swords Return
text:
All Swords Pay Homage
Swords descend in six streams, pursue the caster's crosshair, pass through their mark, and turn for another attack.
Type: Extra Skill
Source: Decipher an Ancient Book and study a Myriad Swords Return Manual
Maintaining the Art
[Myriad Swords Return Manual]
Hold the skill key to cast and release it to stop. Maintaining the art consumes 2,000 magicules per second; it cannot continue without enough energy. The formation contains 60 swords divided into six circulating streams.
Targeting and Damage
The crosshair can lock an unobstructed valid creature up to about 48 blocks away. Attacks begin after roughly 0.9 seconds of steady aim, then deal 8 damage about once every 2 ticks. Successive strikes clear normal hurt invulnerability, producing a dense chain of hits.

title: Qi Flight
text:
Control the spiritual energy inside your body to fly freely through the air.
Type: Extra Skill
Obtainment: Cannot be unlocked automatically through EP; it must be obtained by other means
Input: Press the skill key to toggle flight
Cost: 1.5 magicules per toggle, with no ongoing drain
When enabled on the ground with space overhead, it first lifts you 1 block and then enables high-speed flight. Press again to disable it. Each toggle has a 3-second cooldown.

title: Heaven and Earth Manifestation
text:
When large, you tower over the battlefield; when small, you become tiny as dust. This skill shifts your body size to trade mobility for reach and strength.
Type: Intrinsic Skill
Input: Hold the skill key and scroll the mouse wheel
Cost: 3500 magicules per adjustment
Size ranges from about 0.3 to 10.0 and snaps back to your race's default size when close enough. Growing above your default size increases attack damage and interaction range. Size modifiers are cleaned up or restored on death, respawn, and login.

title: Sword Flight
text:
Sword Flight
Transform a held sword into a rideable flying sword and travel while standing upon its blade.
Type: Extra Skill
Activation Cost: 2,000 magicules
Source: Decipher an Ancient Book and study a Sword Flight Manual
Deploying the Sword
[Sword Flight Manual]
Hold a sword in either hand and press the skill key. It leaves that hand and becomes a flying sword entity. Right-click your sword to stand on and ride it.
Flight Controls
Use movement keys for horizontal control.
Jump: ascend
Sprint (Ctrl by default): descend
Shift: dismount
The sword follows its rider's facing direction and moves faster while sprinting.
Summoning and Recalling
Use Shift+Right-click on the sword to return it to your inventory.
If an existing deployed sword is elsewhere, pressing the skill key summons it toward you.

title: Talisman Master
text:
An Extra Skill for practitioners who specialize in talisman creation. It opens the talisman-making interface.
Type: Extra Skill
Input: Press the skill key
Cost: None
Using the skill opens the Talisman Table interface and plays a page-turn sound. It does not use a toggle state; it is a direct activation skill.

title: Fasting Talisman
text:
[Fasting Talisman]
No activation is required. While a Fasting Talisman is anywhere in your inventory or either hand, it continuously keeps hunger and saturation full.
It has 25 durability and loses 1 durability per minute while active, disappearing when exhausted.

title: Monster Gathering Talisman
text:
[Monster Gathering Talisman]
Gathers mobs and controls them.
Usage: Right-click to throw and place. Attracts nearby mobs to the talisman's position.
Retrieve: Shift+Right-click with empty hand to pick up.

title: Nourishing Qi Talisman
text:
[Nourishing Qi Talisman]
Hold Right-click for about 1 second, then release at full charge; releasing early does nothing. A successful cast consumes one talisman and grants Qi Nourishing for 8 seconds.
Each second restores 1% max health, 3% max magicules, and 3% max aura.

title: Puppet Talisman
text:
[Puppet Talisman]
The terrifying puppet art of the southern lands.
Usage: Right-click on a mob to consume magicules and take control of the target.
Restriction: The target must not be too powerful and must not already be tamed.

title: Scholar Table Talismans
text:
Brush and Ink
Shapelessly combine a Brush with Cinnabar Blood Ink. The resulting Brush and Ink has 20 durability and is the dedicated tool for the Scholar Table's Talisman Making page.
Talisman Making
Right-click a Scholar Table and switch to Talisman Making. Put Brush and Ink in the lower-left tool slot, then arrange ingredients in the seven ring slots. The center previews an output only when every position matches a recipe.
Materials and Durability
Taking the center output consumes one item from every occupied recipe slot. Making Talisman Paper does not damage Brush and Ink; every completed talisman costs 1 durability.
JEI and EMI display all seven-slot layouts and their exact order.
Two Talisman Interfaces
This entry describes only the Scholar Table page. The older Talisman Master skill still opens a separate interface that accepts a Brush and Cinnabar Blood Ink individually and follows its own tool rules.

title: Five Thunder Talisman
text:
[Five Thunder Talisman]
Summons heavenly thunder to strike enemies with devastating power.
Usage: Right-click to throw. On hit, triggers a lightning strike dealing massive AoE damage.

title: Veldora, True Dragon of Storm
text:
Description:
WIP
How to Obtain:
Obtain enough Bond Points.
Passives:
• Storm-Type Magic [In-Slot] - The user gains Storm Magics. Increases Lightning, Wind, and Water Damage by 50%.
Active Skills:
• Storm Dragon Summon [Hold] - Hold for 1 min (-10s per 100 Mastery). Summons Veldora in his human body. Shift-use summons Dragon Body Veldora.
Summon Stats: 1,400 HP, 8,560 SHP, 21 Atk, 75 Armor.

title: Velgaia, True Dragon of Earth
text:
Description:
WIP
How to Obtain:
Obtain enough Bond Points.
Passives:
• Earth-Type Magic [In-Slot] - The user gains Earth Magics. Boosts Earth and Gravity Damage by 50%.
Active Skills:
• Earth Dragon Summon [Hold] - Hold for 1 min (-10s per 100 Mastery). Summons Velgaia in her human body. Shift-use summons Dragon Body Velgaia.
Summon Stats: 1,400 HP, 8,560 SHP, 21 Atk, 75 Armor.

title: Velgrynd, True Dragon of Scorch
text:
Description:
WIP
How to Obtain:
Obtain enough Bond Points.
Passives:
• Scorch-Type Magic [In-Slot] - The user gains Scorch Magics. Boosts Fire, Heat, and Light Damage by 50%.
Active Skills:
• Scorch Dragon Summon [Hold] - Hold for 1 min (-10s per 100 Mastery). Summons Velgrynd in her human body. Shift-use summons Dragon Body Velgrynd.
Summon Stats: 1,400 HP, 8,560 SHP, 21 Atk, 75 Armor.

title: Velzard, True Dragon of Frost
text:
Description:
WIP
How to Obtain:
Obtain enough Bond Points.
Passives:
• Frost-Type Magic [In-Slot] - The user gains Frost Magics. Boosts Cold Damage by 50%.
Active Skills:
• Frost Dragon Summon [Hold] - Hold for 1 min (-10s per 100 Mastery). Summons Velzard in her human body. Shift-use summons Dragon Body Velzard.
Summon Stats: 1,400 HP, 8,560 SHP, 21 Atk, 75 Armor.

title: Akashic Records, God of Information
text:
Description:
WIP
How to Obtain:
Master Astral Light. Reach 60M EP, evolve Astral ego to manas and name it "???". Use new "memory restoration" with "???" to produce Memory.
Precursor:
Astral Light.
Passives:
• Know It All [Toggle] - Grants +35 Mastery and Learning. 75% Melee and Projectile Dodge Chance. 100% Crit Modifier.
• Deep Storage [True] - Immune to having skills copied or plundered. Grants 3 additional skill slots.
Active Skills:
• Skill Creation [Press] - Create up to 3 Unique, Ultimate, or Anti-Skills. A 4th overwrites the oldest (bypassed by Informational Understanding).
• Informational Understanding [Hold] - Records entity info to learn their skills. Unique/Ultimates go to Skill Creation. Skills can be blacklisted.
• Star King Creation [Press] - Creates a Star King Vessel for ???, granting sentience. Renames bound Manas to ???.
• Godly Body [Press] - Costs 1.5M MP. Forcefully evolves user into a God Man Race.
• Residual Breeder Reactor [Hold] - Grants MP equal to 5% (10% Mastered) of max every 115 ticks. Can exceed MP cap up to 525% without ramping out of control.
• Star Order [Press] - Pushes ???'s focus into a created skill, doubling previous Directive Imprint benefits.
• Information Re-Creation [Press] - Opens menu to create skills.
• Material Creation [Press] - Insert an item to instantly learn and re-create it.

title: Azathoth, God of the Void
text:
Description:
"This is it. The Peak over Power"
How to Obtain:
Master Raphael (Wisdom) and Beelzebuth. Have 100 subordinates, 100 mastered skills, and >40M EP. 
Precursor:
Raphael, Lord of Wisdom & Beelzebuth, Lord of Gluttony.
Passives:
• True Dragon Sacrifice - Use /trnightmare TrueDragonNucleation sacrifice [Dragon] to add it to Azathoth (Costs 1M MP).
• Spacetime Manipulation [True] - Becomes Domination on mastery.
• Null [Toggle] - Bypasses Resists/Nullifications. Immune to Crits. 50% Dodge Negation.
• Nihility Bar [True] - Purple resource bar (Max 100k).
Active Skills:
• Imaginary Space [Press] - Normal: 66-page spatial storage. Shift: Warps user/entities into a personalized dimension. Eject via normal press.
• Soul Gluttony [Hold] - Instakills <60% EP or non-Ultimate entities. Deals 450 Spiritual + 150 Void Dmg.
• Multidimensional Barrier [Press] - x4 HP (6x mastered) + Fault Field.
• Darkest Void [Hold] - Produces a blackhole. Shift to power up/throw. Deals 50 Spiritual + 50 Void Dmg (Scales up to +250 with Soul Points) and applies Soul Rot.
• Nihility Generation [Hold] - Generates 500 Nihility/s. Mastered + Raphael Manas makes it passive.
• Imaginary Blade [In-Slot] - Costs 1,500 Nihility (1,000 mastered). Deals 250 Void Dmg. Killed entities go to Imaginary Space and their skills are copied.
• True Dragon Release [Press] - Shift between possessed Dragons to let them free roam in your body with their Ultimate Skills.

title: Azathoth, God of the Void (suite)
text:
• True Dragon Nucleation [Hold] - Produces 1 core per dragon type. Storm: 50 Water/Wind/Lightning Dmg. Scorch/Frost: 200 Flame/Cold Dmg. Earth: 100 Earth/Gravity Dmg.
• True Nucleation Core - Combines all 4 cores. Costs 50k Nihility for a massive blackhole + Black Burn, Chill, Overheat, Anti-Skill.

title: Nodens, God of the Abyss
text:
Description:
"This is absurd, one of the strongest abilities concieved!"
How to Obtain:
Master Lucifer, possess >40M EP, 150 mastered skills, copy 8+ Ultimate modes, master spatial motion & multilayer barrier, use Alteration on Lucifer. OR Copy Soul Gluttony + Skill Storage, >30M EP (Requires 12.3M MP).
Precursor:
Lucifer, Lord of Pride.
Passives:
• Ultimate Arroganz [True] - Stores Lucifer in Skill Storage. Copy modes for free upon being hit.
• Spacetime Domination [True]
• Nihility Bar [True] - Max 100k (Requires a submode to generate).
• Arroganz Solution [In-Slot] - Immune to owned conditions (e.g., Infinity Prison). Bypasses Absolute Guard if Infinity Prison/Uriel owned. Partially bypasses Castle Guard if Uriel/Michael owned.
Active Skills:
• Soul Gluttony [Hold] - Same as Azathoth.
• Imaginardy Space [Press] - Same as Azathoth, but visually different.
• Multidimensional Barrier [Press]
• Ultimate Arroganz [Press] - Shift modes: Skill Creation/Duplication/Storage, Arroganz Skill (manage learned skills), Arroganz Alteration (compile submodes for 2x MP), Abyss Weapon Alteration (enhances The World or Hihi-irokane Scythe).
• Catastrophic Eclipse [In-Slot] - Bypasses Castle Guard. Siphons energy based on EP ratio: 
<40% user EP: Sets EP/MP/AP to 0.
<60%: -40% EP/MP/AP.
<80%: -10%.
Equal: -5%.
>10% gap: -2%.
>40% higher than user: Immune. 
Shift-press to remove.

title: Abbadon, King of Destruction
text:
Description:
"The judge has spoken. Your verdict stands"
How to Obtain:
Master Breaker and Sandalphon Judgement, have enough MP.
Precursor:
Breaker and Sandalphon, Lord of Judgement.
Passives:
• Spacetime Manipulation [True]
• Silent Movement [Toggle] - The player makes zero noise, undetectable by Sculk or Sense Sound Wave.
Active Skills:
• Remove [In-Slot] - Instantly breaks Barriers. 5s CD.
• Dispel [In-Slot] - Auto-removes certain conditions from the user and target on hit. 3s CD.
• Eraser [In-Slot] - Damages Current MP. Instakills if target has <15% user EP; otherwise reduces Current MP by 5% (2.5% vs Ultimate Skills). 2s CD.
• Necrosis [In-Slot] - Applies Necrotic Effect for 25s (halts Magicule regen and Regeneration skills). 30s CD.
• Judgement [In-Slot] - Uses enhanced versions of previous skills. Dispel: 5 Dmg per Barrier Point destroyed + bypasses resists. Eraser: Instakills <50% EP targets; else reduces EP by gap + 35% target EP. Necrosis lasts 1m. 1,440s CD.
• Multidimensional Barrier [Press]
• Dimensional Rupture [In-Slot] - Reduces Spatial Damage by 50%, bypasses Distortion/Fault Field, immune to severance.
• Limit Breaker [In-Slot] - Bypasses Dodge/Resists, MP/AP regen x30, immune to Magicule Poisoning. Max MP reaches 250%.
• Nihility Supply [In-Slot] - Requires Mastery. Generates 1 Nihility per 20 Spatial Damage dealt. Max 25,000 Nihility. Take 50 Void Dmg/sec if >10,000.

title: Abbadon, King of Destruction (suite)
text: • Rapture [In-Slot] - Combines Judgement, Limit Breaker, and Dimensional Rupture. Drains 100 Nihility/sec. Usage >2 mins puts skill on 10m CD and gives transformation debuffs for 30m.

title: Astaroth, King of Fallen
text:
Description:
WIP
How to Obtain:
Master Astarte and Belphegor. Belphegor must have 100,000 stored MP. Astarte must have used Heavenly Design and Recycle 10 times each.
Precursor:
Astarte, Belphegor.
Passives:
• Fallen Lord [True] - Majin Alignment. Take 15% less Holy Damage.
• Duality of Understanding [Toggle] - Grants +15 Mastery and Learning Speed.
• Phantasmal Style [In-Slot] - Attacks deal 2.5% target SHP (5% mastered). 15% chance (30% mastered) to apply Drowsiness (max level 8). +50 Spiritual Damage per target Drowsiness level.
Active Skills:
• Fallen Edge [In-Slot/Press] - Shift-press to swap modes. 
Catastrophe: Instakills if target lacks 2 of 3: Spiritual Res/Null, >30% user EP, Ultimate Skill. 2/3 met = Drowsiness 5. 3/3 met = Drowsiness 4. 15s CD. 
Strike: Deals 2.5% SHP (5% mastered). Instakills non-Ultimate targets at <30% SHP.
• Fallen Slumber [Held] - Swap modes via Shift-press. 
Thanatos: Applies Drowsiness every 7s to nearby entities. Kills nearby entities with Drowsiness 10. 
Sleep: Immobile. Regen 100 HP/SHP (+25% mastered)/sec, 150x MP/AP regen. >500k stored MP regenerates ally MP by 5,000/sec.
• Skill Domination [Press] - Copies Common, Extra, Res, Unique, and Ultimate Skills to store in Sacrilegious Creation.
• Sacrilegious Creation [Press] - Spawns copied skills. Can create Ultimate Skills if conditions met (costs 8x MP).
• Destruction [Press] - Deletes owned skills for MP. 30% chance (60% mastered) to refund +40% MP (+80% mastered).

title: Astaroth, King of Fallen (suite)
text:
• Fallen One [Press] - Converts Stored MP (30k/m) then MP (25k/m) into massive scaling stats. Minute 1: +35 Atk, +30 Armor, 10% DR. Scales up to Minute 15: +205 Atk, +170 Armor, 60% DR.
• Fallen World [Press] - Pulls enemies into a world filled with Fake Astaroths. Nothing can die to Physical Damage here.

title: Cthugha, King of Divine Flame
text:
Description:
"I am Speed"
How to Obtain:
Master Raguel, have enough MP, defeat Masayuki OR someone uses Alteration on you while you have Raguel and Uriel mastered.
Precursor:
Raguel, Lord of Charity.
Passives:
• Spacetime Manipulation [True]
• Amplification & Thought Acceleration [Toggle] - MP regen x4 (8x mastered). +4 Learning/Mastery Points. Magic cast speed x3, move speed +0.02 (0.04 mastered), attack speed +0.3 (0.6 mastered).
Active Skills:
• Cardinal Acceleration [Press] - Shift: Beam dealing 250 Flame Dmg (350 mastered) that melts blocks. Normal: Rush line dealing 350 (500 mastered) Flame Dmg + Attack Dmg.
• Parallel Existence [Press] - Creates a sentient Body Double Entity with your skills and identical EP.
• Encore [Press] - Increases barriers by 90% (180% mastered).
• Stockpile [Press] - Stores up to 225% (500% mastered). Deals 50 bonus Damage for every 100% over 200%.
• Multidimensional Barrier [Press] - Creates Barrier with x4 HP (6x mastered) + Fault Field benefits.
• Scorch Excitation [Hold] - Massively buffs area allies: grants Ally Boost every 10s, Insanity every 15s, and uncaps MP scaling by +10%/sec. Shift-use affects only the user: Ally Boost every 10s, Insanity every 20s, MP uncaps by +15%/sec.

title: Cthulhu, King of Divine Ice
text:
Description:
"Eversleeping he stays, as his awakening is the end of humanity"
How to Obtain:
Master Leviathan and Gabriel, have enough MP, kill 15,000 Mobs, and have Insanity level 4 applied to yourself.
Precursor:
Leviathan, Lord of Envy & Gabriel, Lord of Patience.
Passives:
• Serpent's Jealousy [In Slot] - Randomly siphons Magicules from target on hit.
• Envious Fortune [Toggled] - Passively grants Luck X and auto-removes specific negative effects from yourself for 1,000 MP.
Active Skills:
• Heat Death [Press] - Instakills nearby mobs without Thermal Nullification or <70% EP. Survivors gain Heat Death (increases Cold/Spatial Damage taken).
• Counter Freeze [Press] - 3s duration. Getting hit disables the attacker for 5s (10s mastered) and applies Chill.
• Eternal World [In-Slot] - MP/Aura not expended (applies to allies too). In a 16x16 radius, halts all regen (HP, SHP, MP, AP) but prevents death (left at 1 HP).
• Snow Crystal [Hold] - Spawns 10x10 unbreakable ice crystal around user, protecting from damage and freezing mobs inside while draining 2.5% MP/sec.
• Inferior [Press] - Empowers Atk/Armor for 60s (100s mastered). Grants Envious Mirror effect: user attacks become "Inferior," capped at 1,000 Damage.
• Crushing Jealousy [Toggle] - Higher MP/AP targets gain "Envied" (suffer MP/AP drain when hit). Lower MP/AP targets receive "Stolen Luck".
• Complete Fixation [Press] - Stops time for 15s.

title: Cthulhu, King of Divine Ice (suite)
text: • Whiteout Absorb [Press] - Stops time for 3s (user regen sealed 5s). Instakills non-Ultimate targets. Ultimate targets lose HP/MP based on EP gap: <80% user EP = -80%; <60% = -60%; <20% = -40%. Targets within 10% or above user = -20%.

title: Hamiel, King of Splendour
text:
Description:
"Above all else, i will regenerate, no matter the Injury"
How to Obtain:
Master Haniel, have enough MP, win 12 raids, master day-night inversion and stand in an ancient forest biome.
Precursor:
Haniel, Lord of Glory.
Passives:
• Evershining Glory [True] - Extra learning/mastery points, immune to severance, black burn, holy burn, spin, infinite prison, and more.
• Offensive-Defensive Accord [In-Slot] - 30% universal damage res (50% mastered). Absorbs attacks and doubles the damage for your next attack (costs 15 config magicules per point). Does not stack.
• Ever Victorious [Toggle] - Retains 1/3 cost infinite regen. Attacks degrade resistances 1 extra level (e.g., 0 becomes 1). Grants 75% melee dodge, 100% projectile dodge, and 90% dodge denial.
• Danger Sense [Toggle] - Alerts user to incoming threats.

title: Nyarlathotep, King of Chaos
text:
Description:
WIP
How to Obtain:
Master Faust, Spatial/Water/Lightning/Wind Domination, Multilayer Barrier, and Body Double. Reach 30M EP. Investigate 30 entities.
Precursor:
Faust, Lord of Investigation.
Passives:

Active Skills:

• Pursuit of Truth [Hold] - Investigates every 10s (50% chance for data, max 10). Shift-press to cycle modes: Surprise (traps), Treasure (loot), Battle (mobs). While In-Slot: +30 Mastery/Learn, 80% melee dodge, 50% proj dodge, 50% crit chance, 70% dodge negation.
• Pursuit of Tutelage [Press] - Requires Mastery. Opens menu to teach your known Spells and Skills to others.

• Parallel Existence [Press] - Creates a sentient Body Double Entity.
• Multidimensional Barrier [Press] - Barrier with x4 HP (6x mastered) + Fault Field benefits.

title: Shub-Niggurath, King of Harvest
text:
Description:
WIP
How to Obtain:
Method 1: Have 2 Ultimate Skills (excluding Uriel) + 100 Skills Mastered.
Method 2: Alter Uriel to Raguel for a Cthuga evo for another player, evolving your Uriel into Shub-Niggurath.

Uriel, Lord of Oaths/Vows.

• Skill Creation [Press] - Create unowned skills permanently. Costs MP, cannot be mastered.
• Skill Duplication [Press] - Menu of skills created 3+ times. Free MP cost to duplicate and can be mastered.
• Skill Gifting [Press] - Bestow analyzed skills. Non-Unique/Ultimates work perfectly. Unique/Ultimates cost MP and have an 80% incompatibility rate (removed on death, unmasterable). Target can only be compatible with one skill.

title: Surya, King of Brilliance
text:
Description:
"The power to sort out all mixed laws, prevent interference, and select pure energy. Refined enough to not harm others unintentionally"
How to Obtain:
Master Metatron, have enough MP, master 10 holy Spells, win 15 raids, and use 10k Spiritrons.
Precursor:
Metatron, Lord of Purity.
Passives:
• Spiritron Collection [True] - New SP bar fills if MP >= 60%. Regens 10 SP/s (15 mastered). Max 500 SP (800 mastered). >150 SP grants 35% magicule cost reduction.
• Interference Prevention [True] - Spells work in anti-magic. Immune to magic interference. Bypasses magic jamming.
• Purified Attacks [In-Slot] - If SP >= 60, physical hits deal 40 Holy Dmg (60 mastered). If SP >= 150, adds 25 Holy Dmg to spells.
• Holy Miracle [Toggle] - Increases all Holy Damage by +90.
Active Skills:
• Disintegration [Chant] - Costs 60 SP + 25k MP. Deals 250 Holy Dmg (300 mastered). 5s chant.
• Melt Cut [In-Slot] - Coats blade in Holy Magic. Deals 90 Holy Dmg on hit. 1s CD. Becomes Melt Breaker on mastery (+90 true dmg if SP > 500).
• Disintegrate Coat [In-Slot] - Requires Mastery. If SP > 400 and Melt Cut active, hits deal 50 absolute/true dmg.
• Spiritron Coat [Toggle] - Sacrifices 1/5 SP equivalent to block damage. Reflects Holy Dmg equal to SP spent.

title: Agni, Lord of Blaze
text:
Description:
WIP
How to Obtain:
Reach 1.2M Magicules. Be in the Nether, consume 10 blaze powder.
Precursor:
Raguel, Lord of Charity.
Passives:
• Flame Authority [Toggled] - Increases Flame Damage to x6 (Doesn't stack with Flame Manipulation or Domination). Bypasses Flame Attack Resistance and degrades Nullification to Resistance.
Active Skills:

• Maximum Blazeball [Held] - Requires 1,000 kills with Blazeball + mastery. 4x4 ball of flame dealing 200 Flame Damage.
• Blaze Wave [Press] - Superior Heat Wave variant. Mobs in a 10x10 radius take 50 damage every second while held.

title: Alternative, Proxy Rights
text:
Description:
WIP

Have player manas of Michael bestow this to you.

• Dominion Bullet [Press] - Fires mental bullet dealing SHP damage based on criteria: <50% EP (+2,500), No Hero Egg/Demon Lord Seed (+1,000), Non-Spiritual (+2,000), Non-Divine (+1,500). Max 7,000 damage.
• Enemy Identification [Press] - Reveals targets unique/ultimate skills if their EP is below x2 user's EP.
• Parallel Existence [Press] - Creates a sentient Body Double with user's skills and EP.
• Soul Protect [In-Slot] - Immune to Spiritual Damage (goes on a 10s cooldown every 30s). Immune to Mind Control, Insanity, Fear, and Rampage (unless user has Wrath/Satanael).
• Subjugation Conquest [Held] - Emits Holy spirit Haki. Deals 50 Holy damage (100 when mastered).

title: Amaterasu, Lord of the Shimmering Flames
text:
Description:
"I command thee KNEEL"
How to Obtain:
Master Commander, obtain enough MP, obtain Flame Domination and Spatial Domination.
Precursor:
Commander.
Passives:

• Will Control [True] - Grants subordinates Inspiration 1 (2 on mastery).
Active Skills:

• Thought Domination [Press]

• Prominence Acceleration [Press] - Dash forward releasing Black Haki/Flames that mirror a black sun. Applies Black Burn to targets in 30 blocks and damages a 12x12 area.

title: Amatsumara, Lord of Crafts
text:
Description:
WIP

Master Godly Craftsmen. Reach 600k Magicules, Law Manipulation, and enchant 100 items.

Godly Craftsmen.
Passives:

• Craftmens [Press] - Godly Craftsmen menu variant. Can stack items to 700, and includes a third tab for engraving skills onto items.

title: Artist, Authentic Writer
text:
Description:
WIP
How to Obtain:
Master Imitator. Reach 750k Magicules and have 30 known imitations.
Precursor:
Imitator.
Active Skills:

• Gallery Fake [Press] - Shift-press to pick a specific move from your database of simulated entities to execute without shapeless shifting.

text:
Description:
"Asmodeus is in truth, the ability to subdue and enslave life itself"
How to Obtain:
Master Lust, obtain enough MP, obtain 25 subordinates and breed 100 entities.

Lust.

• Life Domination: Arousal [Press] - Sneak-use on yourself to fully heal/cleanse. Use on mobs to heal/cleanse or trigger breeding status (can reset timers when mastered).
• Death Blessing [Hold] - 14 block range. Slows entities in a 6x6 area by 80%. After a 4s cast, instantly kills targets under 65% EP and converts their EP to user MP/AP. Scaled damage/drain for higher EP targets. Cost: 170,500 MP. Cooldown: 5s.

title: Asmodeus, Lord of Lust (suite)
text: • Memory End Requiem [In-Slot] - Striking drains Magicules and Aura based on target EP ratio relative to user (Drains 80% if <30% EP, 60% if <50% EP, 40% if <70% EP, or 99% if <50% EP with no Ultimate Skill). 7s cooldown.

title: Astarte, Lord of Heaven
text:
Description:
WIP

Master Designer, Master 50 skills, kill 500 mobs.
Precursor:
Designer.
Evolution:
Astaroth, King of Fallen.
Passives:

title: Astraea, Lord of Blessings
text:
Description:
"Justice is my standard, and my sword exists to right wrongs."

Gift.

• Sword Saint [In-Slot/Press] - Passive component bypasses 50% target dodge and boosts crit to 100%. Active component imprints or upgrades Holy Weapon up to Tier 3.
Available Blessings:
• Phoenix Blessing
• Sword Saint

title: Astral Light, Lord of Information
text:
Description:
"Your Skills will have no effect against me"
How to Obtain:
Master Creator, BE HUMAN, have enough MP, create Anti-Skill 10 times.
Precursor:
Creator.
Passives:

• Tachyon Processing [In-Slot] - Grants +25 Mastery and +25 Learning acceleration.
• Bodily Recreation [Hold] - Chunnels 5,000 MP/sec for 60 seconds to forcefully ascend your physical race. Subject to a massive cooldown constraint.

title: Azazel, Lord of Temptation

WIP

Active Skills:

• Temptation World [Press] - Drags non-allies into the Temptation Dimension, inflicting Magic Jamming status.
• Solicitation [Press] - Opens a dedicated menu within the Temptation Dimension to wield modified skill sub-modes.
• Severed Realm [Press] - Banishment property that traps a target in the alternate world for 4 minutes.
• End of World [Press] - Implodes the dimension. Inflicts 3,000 Spiritual Damage to all units inside. Instantly slays targets under 50% user EP.

title: Azazel, Lord of Temptation (suite)
text:
• End of World: Requiem [Press] - Requires 100 base skill uses and mastery. Triggers internal dimension collapse inside target, dealing 5,000 SHP and 5,000 Darkness damage. Slay execute applies to charmed or sub-50% EP targets.
• Punitive Domination [Press] - Outlines statuses via glowing highlights (Allies=Green, Feared=Red, Mind Controlled=Blue). Second activation reveals exact HP targets. Shift-use executes controlled or high-fear targets instantly.

title: Beelzebub, Lord of Gourmet
text:
Description:
Guardian Gets Gourmet After killing Orc Disaster
Gourmet Gets Guardian After eatting 10 royal blood
How to Obtain:
Master Gourmet and Guardian. Reach 120k Magicules, secure 25 Subordinates, and absorb 100,000 baseline Damage.

Gourmet, Guardian.

• Corrosion [Held] - Fires an area cloud dealing 5 corrosion damage per 10 ticks in a 10x10 radius. Kills absorb basic skills and siphon 30% max EP. Cost: 200 MP.

• Stomach [Press] - Accesses a large structural vault space (28 chest rows) that allows item stacking sizes up to 400.
• Chaos Control [Press/In-slot] - Fires 3 projectiles dealing 400 Corrosion damage. Meat Cleavers deal 200 bonus Predation damage after 100 uses.

title: Beelzebuth, Lord of Gluttony
text:
Description:
WIP
How to Obtain:
Master Gluttony and Merciless. Reach 1.75M Magicules, 1500 kills, eat 10 cakes, have Hunger active, and fall under 50% HP.
Precursor:
Gluttony, Merciless.

• Imaginary Space [Press] - Accesses a pocket vault dimension consisting of 18 inventory rows. Boosts max block stack sizes up to 666.
• Mimicry [Press] - Shapeshifts user into any slain entity species, inheriting relevant baseline stats.
• Corrosion [Hold] - Chunnels 50 Corrosion damage per 10 ticks across a 12x12 radius, siphoning skills from casualties. Cost: 500 MP.
• Soul Steal [Hold] - Instantly slays units inside a 60x60 zone if below 15% HP or plagued by Tier 4 Fear.
• Food Chain [Press] - System framework interface that lets you harvest skills from subordinates. Shift-use reverses the pipeline to teach your own skills to subordinates.

title: Belial, Lord of the Underworld
text:
Description:
"'What do you have there?' 'Nothing' The suspiciously Nihility based skill of Mass destruction being wielded:"
How to Obtain:
Master Freezing Flame, 5 flame skills, Spatial Domination, Multilayer Barrier, 4,500 mob kills, and 15 subordinates.
Precursor:
Freezing Flame.
Passives:
• All of Creation [True] - Unlocks all structures.
• Spacetime Manipulation [True]
• Life Domination: Soul Bank [True] - Accumulates souls directly (boosts collection rates by 25%).
• Paradox Flame [Toggle] - Transmutes Fire magic into a White variant that inflicts Freeze status.
Active Skills:

After 5 boosts, generates a Death Storm. Releasing shouts "Apocalypse", striking nearby entities with Black Lightning for 150 Damage.

Description:
WIP
How to Obtain:
Master Infinity Prison. Reach 1.75M Magicules, win 25 raids, and have 50 subordinates.
Precursor:
Infinity Prison.
Passives:
• Believer System [True] - Grants +1 Mastery and +1 Learning for each subordinate you possess.
• Absolute Guard [In-Slot] - Blocks all attacks. Energy Cost = Attack Damage x 15. Bypassed by opponents with 80% or higher of the user's EP.
Active Skills:
• Imprison [Press] - Costs 50,000 MP. Seals movement, skills, and healing. Drains 500 MP per 10 ticks. Lasts 600s (1200s mastered). Cooldown: 15s (10s on miss if mastered).
• Absolute End [Press] - Costs 20,000 MP. Fires an 8-block (12 mastered) projectile dealing 350 (450 mastered) damage with Severance. 3s CD.
• Nova Break [Press] - Costs 75,000 MP. Sword strike dealing 100 Space and 200 Severance damage. Both damage types scale up by +1 for every subordinate you have over the target. Cooldown: 20s.
• Imaginary Space [Press] - Opens a 9x10 storage inventory. Items stack to 999. Stores the energy of attacks blocked by Absolute Guard.

title: Yog-Sothoth, Lord of Space-Time
text:
Description:
WIP
How to Obtain:
Master Time Traveler, Absolute Severance, Infinity Prison, and Usurper. Trigger Time Traveler's passive 25 times.
Precursor:
Time Traveler.
Passives:
• Spacetime Manipulation [True] - Unlocks Spacetime Manipulation extra skill.
• Absolute Coating [True] - Grants +200 (+250 mastered) damage boost and applies Severance on hit.
• Seize [In-Slot] - Hits have a 50% chance to steal 1.5% MP from your target to refill your own.
Active Skills:
• Rob/Copy/Force Takeover [Press] - Usurper skills enhanced: Rob ignores EP rules, Copy can steal resistances, Force Takeover works up to 90% of target EP.
• Absolute End [Press] - Fires an invisible projectile dealing 300 (400 mastered) damage.
• Infinity Prison [Press] - Costs 50k MP + 10% target EP. Seals movement, healing, skills. Drains 100 MP/10 ticks. Lasts 300s (600s mastered). CD 20s (10s miss).
• Time Leap [Press] - Saves location. On death, you revive here instead and set Yog-Sothoth on a 500s cooldown.
• Reverse Fate [Press] - Requires Mastery & Learning. Saves the state of all things in 60 blocks. Secondary cast reverts everything to that exact state. 3m CD.
• Time Stop [Press] - Requires Learning. Stops local area time for 10s (15s mastered). Bypassed by Time Souls/Time skills. Costs 250k MP.

title: Absolute Severance
text:
Description:
Wield the power to cut through any who stand in your path, whether by coating your strikes or launching slashing projectiles that sever all in their path.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Active Skills:
[Press] Coating: Costs 1,000 MP, adds a 50 (200 if mastered) damage boost, as well as a severance effect to the player's attacks for 60 seconds.
Resist Bypass: Bypasses Resistances and treats Nullifications as Resistances while coat is active.
[Press] Projectile: Costs 20,000 MP, launches an invisible projectile that deals 50 (300 with Mastery) Damage and has a severance effect. Projectile travels 5 blocks (10 with mastery). (3s Cooldown)

title: Acceleration
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Scorching Flames: Increases outbound Flame Damage by +25 (+50 when mastered).

Active Skills:
[Hold] Burning Breath: Fires a highly compressed thermal beam. Inflicts 25 (50 mastered) Flame and 50 (100 mastered) Spiritual Damage.
[Hold] Bloody Lava: Emits a volatile burning aura that actively turns floor surfaces into lava blocks. Deals 50 Flame Damage to surrounding targets.

[Hold] Superheating: Boosts Magicule generation speeds by x4 (x8 when mastered). Expands caps to store up to 256% of standard maximum MP. Fully immunizes against Magicule Poisoning upon mastery.

title: Analyst
text:
Description:
Analyze the magic of the world and learn it yourself expanding your knowledge in the arcane. Law Manipulation is acquired upon mastering the skill.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Analyst: Increases the amount of Learned Points and Mastery Points gained by 2. Grants Thought Acceleration and Chant Annulment.
Active Skills:
[Press] Analytical Appraisal: Analysis Level 18 (28 with mastery), distance 40 blocks (50 with Mastery).
[Hold] Analyze: When held down for 5s (3s with mastery) while looking at a Magic Circle or Magic Entity within a 30 block radius, copies the magic. It cannot copy any spirit magic or elemental summoning magic.

title: Anti-Skill
text:
Description:
Become immune to Magic, Skills, Skill Debuffs and Battlewill, destroy barriers and block skill usage of other entities.
How to Obtain:
Created Through Creator.
Passives:
[Toggle, Requires Creator Mastery] Anti-Skill Aura: Makes the user completely immune to Magic, Skills (including your own Resistances), Battlewill, and Skill Debuffs (such as Mind-Control, Infinity Prison, Spatial Blockade, and Magic Jamming).
Passives (Cont.):
[True] Spiritual Interference: Allows the user to attack Spiritual Entities and grants immunity to spiritual damage and Energy Drain.
[True] Absolute Ward: Punching a Ranged Barrier instantly destroys it. Disables skill stealing and copying from the user under any gamerule setting.
Active Skills:
[True] Nullifying Strike: Attacking a target with both hands empty (only main hand empty with Creator Mastery) removes all their barrier points, clears all skill status effects (buffs/debuffs), and inflicts a debuff making them unable to activate skills for 4s.

title: Berserk
text:
Description:
Massively empower your body and infuse it with a flame aura. Allows you to go into a risky but overwhelmingly powerful berserker mode.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Flame Aura: Adds Flame Damage to the player's physical and aura attacks equal to 50% of their base damage. Costs 200 MP per attack. Increases Flame Damage by 2x.
Active Skills:
[Press] Rage: Grants the player Strengthen 10 (20 with Mastery) buff for 5 Minutes. Costs 300 MP.
[Press] Mad Ogre: Grants Strength 15 (30 mastered), doubles size, gives +0.4 (0.8 mastered) Knockback Resistance, +0.04 Speed, and 20 (40 mastered) armor for 10 minutes.
During Mad Ogre, the player is inflicted with Rampage. Afterwards, grants Fragility 2, Weakness 2, and Paralysis 2 for 10 minutes. Costs 5,000 MP.
With Mastery, spawns 6 flame spheres. Sneaking allows them to auto-block half of incoming damage. Orbs regenerate every 20s.

title: Berserker
text:
Description:
Feed on your enemies' defeat. Gain EP from kills, destroy equipment faster, and boost your physical stats based on your power level. Mastery is gained passively.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll or killing Shogo Taguchi if config enabled.
Passives:
[Toggle] Death Benefit: Upon killing an enemy, receive 4% of its EP (2% Magicule, 2% Aura). Stacks with base 3% for a total of 7%.
[In Slot] Equipment Destruction: Attacks deal double damage to armor durability. Incoming attacks take double durability from the attacker's weapon.
Active Skills:
[Press] Diamond Body: Grants temporary Armor and Physical Damage buffs based on max EP (Costs 0 EP):
• Attack Damage (x2 mastered): 5 base + 1 per 40k EP
• Armor: 1 per 20k EP
• Speed: 0.01 per 25k EP

title: Bewilder
text:
Description:
Use this skill to manipulate friends and foes, compelling them to act according to your will. Doesn’t work on Spiritual Lifeforms or those under Rampage.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll or killing Kirara Mizutani if config enabled.
Active Skills:
[Press] Target: Turns looked at mob into an ally for 10 Minutes. Costs 50 MP (Negated by Nullification, 5 min with Resistance).
[Press] Area: Turns all mobs within 20x20 (30x30 mastered) into allies for 5 Minutes. Costs 80 MP per mob.
[Press] Charm: Applies a 'Hero of the Village V' effect for 2 Minutes. Costs 200 MP.
[Press] Kill: Kills all mind-controlled mobs in a 20x20 (30x30 mastered) radius. Costs 100 MP per mob. Deals half HP with resistance. (5s CD, 3s mastered)

title: Breaker
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Active Skills:
[In-slot] Boundary Breaker: Substantially boosts your base Dodge Chance and defensive Resistances. Multiplies MP and AP passive regeneration speeds by 20x and grants absolute immunity to Magicule Poisoning status effects.
[In-slot] Spatial Rupture: Dampens all incoming direction-based Spatial Damage by 50%. Allows the user to move seamlessly through active Distortion Fields and provides permanent immunity to Severance modifiers.

title: Butcher
text:
Description:
Mark and rupture an enemy's blood vessels through repeated weapon strikes.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[In Slot] Aortic Work of Art: Slashes add 1 mark.
• 5 Marks: Death causes a burning-blood explosion.
• 10 Marks: Blood vessels rupture every 10s, dealing 5% max HP until death.
Active Skills:
[Press] Heighten: Increases reaction, movement, and attack speed.
[Press] Rupture: Targets with 15+ marks continuously lose health until death. Curable only by Isolation.
[Art, Press] Anatomy Art: Killing an entity with 10+ marks grants a charge. Opens an anatomy GUI to make up to 3 cuts.
Anatomy Cuts:
• Legs: Halves movement and jumping.
• Arms: 1 arm = 1.5x cooldowns, half damage. Both = 2x cooldowns, no attacks.
• Torso: Deals heavy damage by consuming the heart and heals user.

title: Cadence
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Evolution Of Stasis.
Evolution:
Gabriel, Lord of Patience.
Passives:
[In Slot] Status Quo: Maximum Health cannot be reduced by external hazards like Severance or Cook.

[Toggle] Render Stillness: Solidifies fluid surfaces directly underfoot, letting you walk over them like solid blocks.
Active Skills:
[In Slot] Fixed State: Locks active resource pools entirely, preventing Magicules and Aura from being expended during combat frames.

[Hold] Air Wall: Conjures an impenetrable 5x5 physical air barrier that completely blocks pathing and vaporizes incoming projectiles.
[Hold] Time Control: Distorts the space inside a local 8x8 matrix, slowing all caught components down by 50% (80% when mastered).

[Press] Time Freeze: Requires learning. Stops time globally within an 8x8 area for all targets except yourself and units holding Time Manipulation nodes.
[Press] White Lock: Requires mastery. Instantly paralyzes a single targeted opponent in time for up to 30 seconds.

[Press] Block Acceleration: Drops a specialized glass utility node that drastically scales up random tick rates of nearby blocks to accelerate crop and spawner speeds.

title: Captivator
text:
Description:
Control a performance through alternating Lie and Truth modes, charming enemies while inspiring allies.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[True] Fever Pitch: Completing Performance switches Lie Mode to Truth Mode or vice versa.
Active Skills:
[Hold] Performance: Charms non-allied entities within 20 blocks for 30s and grants Inspiration to allies. Costs 250 MP/s. Max 15s hold (60s CD).
[Press, Lie Mode] Masquerade: Restores 25% HP/SHP to allies within 20 blocks and grants minor speed increase.
[Press, Truth Mode] Unveil: Paralyzes non-allied entities within 10 blocks for 10s. Mastery applies Marked for Death. Costs 500 MP (30s CD).
[Press] Star Power: Requires Mastery. Applies Dazzled to non-allied entities looking at the user. They remain frozen for 10s and cannot look away. (40s CD)

title: Carnation
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Sentient Being, Gluttony AND Eat 10 dragon essence.
Passives:
[True] Abundance: Magicule Regeneration speeds scale by x2 whenever current levels fall below an 85% threshold.

[Toggle] Family Account: Shares your active Magicule pool dynamically with nearby subordinates.

[In-Slot] Unique Law Ignoring: Direct attacks bypass enemy Resistances, degrade Nullifications, and ignore Barrier Points.
Active Skills:
[Hold] Predation: Releases an aggressive vacuum mist dealing 100 damage (functions using Gluttony logic structures).

[Press] Recovery: Clears harmful status conditions like Cook/Severance. Restores health at a cost of 90 MP (45 mastered) per HP. Mastery permits full Spiritual HP recovery at 70 MP per point.
[Press] Stomach: Unlocks access to an extensive 9-row spatial vault. Contained items stack up to a maximum threshold of 666.

[Hold] Snack For Later!: Boosts standard Magicule Regen by 5x (10x mastered). Overfills extra reserves into Stored Magicules if at 100% capacity.
[Press] Family Bonds!: Opens an ally's profile menu to copy an active skill node by splitting base costs. Requires Mastery to clone up to 4 distinct Unique Skills.

title: Cessation
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Ice Walk: Grants standard Frost Walker logistics, immediately freezing water blocks beneath the user's feet.

Active Skills:
[Hold] Freeze All: Sets movement speeds of all nearby units to 0 and freezes active projectile frames in an 8x8 matrix. Targets can only escape via teleportation (30s CD).
[Hold] Ice Wall: Spawns a solid, indestructible ice barrier measuring 8 blocks tall and 3 blocks thick. Neutralizes all oncoming direction-based Spiritual and Spatial damage instances.

Ultimate Combo: Automatically scales up into a Snow Crystal configuration if the user owns Gabriel, forming a protective diamond cage.

title: Chef
text:
Description:
Purify and renew. Remove all negative effects and restore vitality to those under your care.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Active Skills:
[Press] Purify: When not looking at a target, removes all negative status effects from yourself and restores full HP. Looking at a mob applies it to them. Costs 60 MP (40 mastered) per healed HP and 100 MP per effect level removed.

title: Chosen One
text:
Description:
Radiate authority and charisma to force fear into the hearts of your enemies and to make them follow you instead, while empowering yourself and your allies. Become Blessed upon obtaining.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[True] Hero’s Beacon: Requires Mastery. All Skills and Battlewill owned by a subordinate become yours when they are killed.
[Toggle] Hero’s Action: Grants Hero of the Village V.
[In Slot] Hero’s Blessing: Grants permanent Luck 5. You and allies have a 100% critical hit rate and a 10% auto-dodge chance.
Active Skills:
[Hold] Hero’s Haki: Costs 25 MP/s. Inflicts 1 Fear level per 20% EP difference on mobs in a 30x30 radius.
[Press] Hero’s Charisma: Passive/neutral mobs in a 20x20 radius assist in combat for 120s. Mobs you defeat resurrect as allies with half max HP. When mastered, only occurs while in-slot. Costs 200 MP.

title: Coalescence
text:
Description:
Remove movement restrictions, immobilize targets, and solidify space into absolute barriers.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Hindrance Removal: Activation removes Burden, Slowness, and other movement-hindering effects.
Active Skills:
[Press] Fixation: Immobilizes target within 5 blocks (10 mastered) for 15s. (60s immunity after). Missing causes 5s CD.
[Press] Solidification: Creates an invisible shield 3 blocks ahead that blocks movement, projectiles, and damage. Sneak-activate to remove. (10s CD)
[Art, Press] Eternal Domain: Creates an 8-block field (16 mastered). Targets inside are Fixated. You gain Stasis, reducing Magicule costs to 0. (180s CD, 90s mastered)

title: Coffin of Darkness
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[In Slot] Assault Mode: Requires Mastery. Overrides death once every 1200 seconds, dropping the user into an empowered Assault state for 400 seconds.

[True] Hellblaze: Requires Mastery. Permanently unlocks access to specialized Black Flame variations.
Active Skills:
[Hold] Full Counter: Intercepts incoming projectile tracks, reflecting them directly back at the sender for x2 (x4 when mastered) damage output.

[In Slot] Dark Prominence: While actively slotted, weapon attacks deal an extra +10% (+20% when mastered) bonus Dark Damage.
[Hold] Divine Slayer: Builds up an internal power scale reaching up to 10. Releasing the channel unleashes a rapid onslaught of physical blade slashes and black fire bursts onto your target, dealing dynamic Dark and Fire attributes scaling directly with your base damage statistics.

title: Commander
text:
Description:
Lead the charge with your allies. Empower yourself and your allies to gain an overwhelming advantage.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Thought Acceleration: Enhances processing.
[Toggle] Inspire Forces: Boosts allies within 30 blocks’ stats and critical-hit chance by 30% (60% mastered).
[Toggle] Predictive Calculation: 10% auto-dodge, 50% dodge bypass. Bypasses resistances and ignores Magic Jamming.
Active Skills:
[Press] Thought Communication: Give commands to allies remotely.
[Press] Thought Domination: Works like Vampire’s Charm.

title: Compulsor
text:
Description:
Replicate your body, adapt to resistances, and distort the anatomy of living targets.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[In Slot] Self Replication: Falling below 20% HP spawns a clone (Max 5).
[True] Adaptive Replication: Grants extra learning points for Resistances.
[Toggle] Shared Design: Mastering a Resistance automatically grants its Nullification form.
Active Skills:
[Press] Organic Distortion: Deals 50 damage and applies Distorted for 10s. Distorted increases gravity, reduces speed/damage, and disrupts Skills. (20s CD)
[Hold] Anatomy Manipulation: Use scroll wheel to alter user body size.

title: Constant
text:
Description:
Preserve fixed values for health, damage, and energy despite changing conditions.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Constant: Requires Mastery. Prevents Cook and Severance from affecting the user.
Active Skills:
[Hold] Constant: Health: Locks current HP and SHP. Costs 1,000 MP/s. Max 15s hold.
[Press] Constant: Physical: Records highest physical hit dealt over 5s, then enables Destruction. (10s CD)
[Hold] Constant: Destruction: Every attack deals recorded damage. Costs 3,000 MP/s. Max 15s hold.
[Press] Constant: Energy: Requires Mastery. MP and AP do not decrease for 10s. Afterward, twice total spent energy is deducted. If below 0, MP resets to 25% and regen is disabled for 3 mins.

title: Cook
text:
Description:
Bend reality to ensure enemies meet their demise by ignoring dodge and barriers.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Passive] Certain Outcome: Toggled: all attacks become crits. In-slot: attacks shatter all barrier points unless target has >2x your EP.
[Toggle] Optimal Action: Attacks ignore all dodge. Bypasses resistances.
Active Skills:
[Toggle] Chaotic Fate: Requires Learning. Next attack reduces target's max HP by damage dealt. Crouch-activate to undo permanent damage to yourself (or looked-at mob). Press ability with Mastery.

title: Corroder
text:
Description:
Coat attacks and the surrounding area in corrosive force while remaining immune to Corrosion.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Corrosive Touch: Physical attacks apply Corrosion II for 10s (Corrosion III for 15s mastered).
[In Slot] Corrosion Ward: Grants complete immunity to Corrosion.
Active Skills:
[Hold] Dissolve: Emits corrosive aura for 100 MP/s. Deals 10 Corrosion Damage/s and applies Corrosion I for 10s (15 dmg, Corrosion II mastered).
[Art, Press] Cross Corrosion: Requires Learning. Coats blade in acid; next attack deals heavy armor-ignoring damage. Costs 1,000 MP.

title: Crasher
text:
Description:
Channel the void to sever enemies, repel threats, and cross dimensions.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Thought Acceleration: Doubles Magic casting speed, adds 0.01 speed, 0.2 attack speed (0.02 / 0.4 mastered).
[In Slot] Unstable Transmitter: Falling below 10% HP grants 75% absorption and teleports nearby enemies away. (120s CD)
[In Slot] Void Infusion: Unarmed attacks deal extra armor damage and sever a percentage of the target's health.
Active Skills:
[Press] Destroyer Haki: Deals 25 (50 mastered) Void Damage/s to nearby enemies. Applies Slowness based on EP diff. Costs 500 MP/s.
[Hold] Dimension Hopper: Hold and scroll between Overworld, Nether, End, Hell, and Spirit Dimension. Release to travel. (600s CD, 300s mastered)

title: Creator
text:
Description:
Create Unique Skills and use them for a limited time.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[In Slot] Anti-Skill: Toggled with Mastery. Grants immunity to Magic, Skills, and Battlewill. Punching a Ranged Barrier instantly destroys it. Empty-handed attacks strip barrier points.
Active Skills:
[Press] Analytical Appraisal: Analysis Lvl 1 (2 mastered), range 5 blocks (10 mastered).
[Press] Skill Creation: Select one Unique Skill or Anti-Skill and gain it for 20 minutes (1 MC day). Cannot chain-create without Mastery.

title: Cultivator
text:
Description:
Refine energy through combat and achieve temporary breakthroughs in physical power.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[True] Heavens Favor: Mob kills grant 10% (15% mastered) of their MP instead of 3%.
[In Slot] Martial Prodigy: Battlewill learned instantly. Empty-handed attacks gain +50 (+100 mastered) damage.
Active Skills:
[Press] Breakthrough: Every 1,000 mob kills grants a Breakthrough level. Activation triples MP gain and grants Strengthen XV and Resistance V for 5 minutes. (1h CD).

title: Deadly Poison
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Evolution:
Samael, Lord of Deadly Poison.
Passives:
[Toggle] Thought Acceleration: Enhances processing speed.

[In-Slot] Detect Weakness: Hitting entities actively fills up the progress meter for your Lethal Dose status.
Active Skills:
[In-Slot] Bloody Bite: Costs MP to inject poison. Effect scales by Detect Weakness %:
• <=30%: Physical & Spiritual DMG
• 50%: Magicule Poisoning
• 80%: Lethal Poison
• 100%: Cursed Poison
[Hold] Poison Refinement: Drains MP over time to safely generate 2.5% (5% when mastered) Lethal Dose progress per second.

[Press] Deadly Domain: Requires 100% Lethal Dose. Spends total dose to deal 500 (1000 mastered) SHP damage to physical entities, and 250 (500 mastered) to spiritual lifeforms.
[Press] Cursed Poison: Requires Mastery & Learning. Infects a target for 5 minutes. Deals 25 HP & SHP damage per second per level. Defeating infected entities grants a bonus +10% EP.

title: Deal Maker
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Reroll.
Evolution:
The Don.
Active Skills:
[Press] Deal: Initiates bargaining interfaces for trading EP, Skills, Submodes, or Toggles. The user cannot break the contract; however, if the target breaks it, the user absorbs all promised benefits immediately without penalty.

title: Degenerate
text:
Description:
Craft, decraft, customize items and absorb strength from weakened enemies.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll or killing Shizu.
Active Skills:
[Press] Crafting: Opens crafting GUI to decraft items into base components, combine enchantments without renaming, and strip enchantments. Bypasses vanilla cap by up to 2 levels.
[Press] Separate: Steals Extra/Common skills from <75% EP targets. Strips oxidation/ore blocks. Extracts suspicious sand. Un-targeted use strips negative status effects for 100 MP per level.
[Press] Synthesize: Aiming at Charybdis Core grants stats based on state. Aiming at natural Spiritual mob <=25% HP kills it and plunders skills/EP.

title: Designer
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Reroll.
Passives:
[In-Slot] By Design: Grants a flat +6 bonus points when actively learning skills.

Active Skills:
[Press] Copy: Copies Resistances, Common, and Extra skills from targets, storing them into the Skill Designer archive.
[Press] Skill Designer: Opens the customization GUI. Any skills saved via Copy can be instantly crafted into Temporary Skills (using Current MP) or purchased as Permanent Skills (at double the MP base cost).
[Press] Recycle: Opens a utility GUI to break down owned skills. Grants their original Magicule Cost, with a 5% (10% mastered) chance to refund an extra 10% (20% mastered) bonus MP. Unique and Ultimate breakdowns yield Soul Energy instead.

title: Divide
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Gain it from Veldora.
Passives:
[Toggle] Dragon's Claw: Grants +1 base Attack Damage per 100 Mastery points (+2 when mastered).

[In-slot] Cut Through: Allows all standard player attacks to completely bypass enemy Resistances and Nullification statuses.
Active Skills:
[Press] Dragon Claw: Must be empty handed. Performs a heavy sweeping claw swipe dealing double base Attack Damage. Extends reach by +7 blocks and punctures blocks if terrain griefing rules allow.

title: Divine Berserker
text:
Description:
Empower your body by a massive amount, but beware the aftereffects.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Active Skills:
[Press] Divine Release: Grants Strength 20, +20 Armor, and +0.06 Speed for 3 minutes (6 min, 2x stats mastered). All damage taken counts as physical. Battlewill attacks deal 6x (8x mastered) damage.
Penalties: Costs 10,000 MP, deals 10 self-damage/s. Ends with Paralysis II, Fragility II, Weakness II for 10 minutes. Can reactivate to end early (penalties still apply).

title: Domicile
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Evolution:
Hearth.
Active Skills:
[Press] Homestead: Generates a starter custom pocket dimension home. The owner holds exclusive building permissions. Combat and violence are completely neutralized inside this zone.
[Press] Shopkeeper: Manifests a specialized marketplace pocket dimension built for vendor trading. Blocks cannot be modified or broken within this realm, and violence is completely blocked.

title: Dominator
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Evolution:
Michael, Lord Of Justice.
Active Skills:
[In-slot] Castle Guard: Requires 3+ subordinates. Absolute immunity against all active Skills, Magic, and Battlewills for up to 1 minute. Prevents you from utilizing magic or skills too (Haki and attacks function). Bypassed by Nova Break.
[Hold] Angel Knight: Channels for 30s (10s mastered) to summon a helpful Angel Knight companion (up to 3 when mastered). Knights spawn with 50 HP (200 mastered), Holy Attack Resistance, Sleep Mist, and Solar Rain magic.
[Hold] King's Authority: Channels for 60s (30s mastered) to temporarily subordinate a target. Bypasses naming costs, but requires spending equivalent target EP. Requires user to be at 30%+ max EP.

title: Dreamer
text:
Description:
Record a dream to restore your previous state, escape death, and consume the dreams of sleeping enemies.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[In Slot] Recall: Restores 0.5% (1% mastered) MP every 5s.
[True] Lucid Dream: Fatal damage activates saved Dream, restoring stats/location. (1,200s CD, 900s mastered)
Active Skills:
[Press] Dream: Saves HP, SHP, MP, AP, and location. Reactivation restores. Sneak-use cancels. (1,200s CD)
[Hold] Hypnosis: Applies Drowsiness I (II mastered) within 10 blocks (15 mastered).
[Hold] Dream Eater: Target Drowsy mob for 5s to deal 30 (50 mastered) Physical & Spiritual Damage. Success reduces Dream CD by 30s.

title: Elegy
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[True] Spatial Barriers: Instantly unlocks the Barrier, Spatial Manipulation, and Spatial Motion skills.

Active Skills:
[In-slot] Barrier Refinement: Permanently doubles all incoming Barrier Points gained from external sources.
[Press] Counter Barrier: Consumes 100 Barrier Points to instantly intercept and vaporize incoming projectiles.

[Press] Stability: Sacrifices all active Barrier Points to recover vitals:
• 1 Barrier Point = 100 MP
• 1 Barrier Point = 5 HP

title: Elementalist
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[True] Spiritually One: Grants permanent Blessed Status alignments.

[Toggle] Elemental Boost: Buffs elemental outputs by +30% (+40% when mastered).
Active Skills:
[Hold] Elemental Conversion: Enters a completely stationary meditation state, automatically absorbing incoming elemental damage and converting it directly into usable Magicules.
[Press] Elemental Connection: Links the user to a selected element. Grants full elemental immunity to that type while increasing its base output damage by +20 (+40 when mastered).

title: Ending
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[True] Scent of Death: Automatically spawns cosmetic floating soul particles around the player's model every 5 seconds.

Active Skills:
[Press] No Escape: Drags targets slightly closer while dealing 44 damage. (44s Cooldown / 4444 MP Cost)
[Press] Death’s Door: Conjures an unstable blade housing a static 44,444 max EP capacity value. (444s Cooldown)

title: Endorse
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Evolution:
Raguel, Lord of Charity.
Active Skills:
[Press] Encore: Looking away buffs yourself; looking at an entity targets them instead. Boosts total Barrier Points by 20% (45% mastered) and applies active Speed, Magicule Regen, Strength, and Resistance values.
[Press] Stockpile: Increments attack power charges by +20% per execution (up to 100%, scaling to 200% upon mastery). Must be recharged after usage. Reaching maximum 200% threshold drops an extra 50 Flame Damage on impact.

title: Engineer
text:
Description:
Construct automated sentries, support dispensers, and defensive energy shields.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[In Slot] Tools of the Trade: Nearby Sentries/Dispensers level up over time.
Active Skills:
[Hold] Build [Sentry]: Stationary sentry copying user stats. Max 2. (30s CD). Lvl 2 (120s) = 2x fire rate. Lvl 3 (300s) = missiles.
[Hold] Build [Dispenser]: Support station. Lvl 1 = +0.5% MP/AP. Lvl 2 (120s) = 10 HP, 1% MP/AP. Lvl 3 (300s) = 5% HP, 3% MP/AP.
[Press] Bubble Shield: Blocks external damage/entities/projectiles for 15s. (25s CD)

title: Engorger
text:
Description:
Increase your size and boost your physical stats.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Engorge: 1.5x size, 0.4 Knockback Resistance, Knockback I, 10 bonus damage, 2x Speed, 10 Armor, +1 reach. Permanently saturates hunger.
Active Skills:
[Press] Amplify: Requires Engorge toggle. Doubles Engorge buffs for 2 mins (300 MP). Reactivating dashes forward, dealing +50 (+100 mastered) weapon damage to touched mobs. Toggling Engorge off ends mode.

title: Envy
text:
Description:
Absorb strength from enemies, empower yourself, and debilitate your enemies.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Jealous Luck: Grants 10% auto-dodge chance, Luck III, and immunity to Weakness and Slowness.
Active Skills:
[Press] Absorb: Converts target EP diff into 50% max EP / 50% temp MP/AP. (30s CD, 10s mastered)
[Hold] Strength Sap: Affects 30x30 area. Applies 10s Weakness/Slowness per 10% EP difference. Drains 0.1% MP/AP/s. Costs 1,000 magicules/s.

title: Falsifier
text:
Description:
See through falsehoods and invisibility, conceal your presence from prying eyes, and create illusions.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Falsifier: Allows the user to see through illusions and invisible targets.
Active Skills:
[Press] Presence Concealment: Makes mobs unable to register the user for 120 seconds. Costs 200 MP.
[Press] Illusion: Opens a GUI where the user selects a fake item to display in each armor and hand slot.
[Hold] Fake Death: Reduces movement speed by 40% (20% mastered) while held (up to 30s). If hit, spawns a dead body, sends a fake death message, halves incoming damage, and grants Presence Concealment. (10s CD, 5s mastered)

title: Fighter
text:
Description:
Achieve mastery through discipline. Learn combat and magic abilities instantly, gain more mastery points, and hit much harder.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Fighter: Makes learning Battlewills and Magic happen instantly.
[True] Fighter: Grants 2 additional mastery points with each usage.
[In Slot] Fighter: Grants +75 base damage (+150 mastered). Hold Skill Activation and scroll to scale the damage output.

title: Freezing flame
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[True] Pyromaniac: Instantly grants access to all Flame-Type Aspectual Magics.

[Toggle] Paradox Flame: Changes all flame magics to a white aesthetic. Causes all fire damage dealt to apply a Freeze effect to targets.
Active Skills:
[Press] After World: Erects a virtual space converting flame magic damage into hybrid Spiritual damage. Kills inside grant Soul Points. Yields 1.5x EP Regen per 1,000 Souls owned.
[Toggle] White Flame: Envelops the user in intense white-hot aura. Attacks inflict Freezing Burn on hit.

Note: Targets with Spiritual or Thermal Fluctuation Nullification ignore this status.

title: Fusionist
text:
