Description:
Turn the world into a weapon by absorbing the environment to create powerful mines and grenades.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Active Skills:
[Press] Disassemble: Breaks the targeted block without dropping it and adds 1 Matter. Sneak-use consumes blocks from your hand instead.
[Press] Fuse: Converts a block into a landmine for 5 Matter. Explodes in a 25-block TR radius on touch (or manual trigger), dealing 300 (500 mastered) damage. Costs 1,000 MP.
Fuse Mastery: Reactivate looking at a mine to charge it. Each charge adds 50 damage and 5 blocks of radius (Costs 10 Matter, stacks 5 times).
[Press] Stone: Uses 1 Matter to throw an exploding projectile. Level 6 explosion deals 77 area damage through blocks. Costs 200 MP.

title: Gardener
text:
Description:
Accelerate crop growth, empower hoes, and bless food with time-based effects.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[True] Hoe Mastery: Greatly increases the damage of all hoes.
[Toggle] Crop Mastery: Every 5s, nearby crops have a 50% chance to advance one growth stage. Costs 20 MP per 5s.
Active Skills:
[Press] Blessing: Blesses the held food stack for 250 MP (500 mastered) per item. Effects vary by time:
• Dawn: Strengthen III for 3m (V for 5m mastered).
• Noon: Resistance I for 3m (II mastered).
• Night: Speed III & Step Height 2 for 3m (V & Height 3 mastered).

title: Gatekeeper
text:
Description:
Command a royal treasury of weapons and bind enemies in divine chains.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[In Slot] Golden Rule: Grants Luck V.
Active Skills:
[Press] Enkidu: Imprisons target in holy chains, preventing movement/skills for 120s (240s mastered). Costs 25,000 MP. (20s CD, 10s mastered).
[Press] King's Storehouse: Opens weapon-only Spatial Storage with 5 slots (10 mastered). Stored weapons fuel Gates of Babylon.
[Hold] Gates of Babylon: Fires stored armaments toward a location (1 to 5 portals based on Mastery). Sneak-use surrounds a location with portals to autonomously fire Spatial arrows.

title: Gift
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Active Skills:
[Press] Gift Creation: Opens a dedicated interface to manifest any Divine Protection as a sub-skill. Exclusive to the user. Shift-Use opens a deletion utility map.

[In-Slot] Divine Protection: Swaps actively to access the active blessing's attributes.
Creatable Blessings:
• Dark / Light Blessings
• Earth / Fire / Water / Wind
• Durability / Insensitivity
• Wind Evasion / Wind Reading
• Food Lover

title: Glorious
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Evolution:
Haniel, Lord of Glory.
Passives:
[True] Evershining Glory: Immune to maximum health reduction from spatial attacks. Grants a +4 speed bonus to learning and mastery tracking.
[Toggle] Sensing Modes:
• Danger Sense: Alerts user to threats.
• Hostility ID: Detects nearby entities and traps within 10-15 blocks.
• Accord: Ignores 50% of enemy dodge chances.
• Auto Recovery: Rapid regeneration at half standard cost.

title: Gluttony
text:
Description:
Absorb everything in your path, steal abilities, store items, and cleanse harmful effects.
How to Obtain:
Mastered Predator + Starved.
Active Skills:
[Hold] Predation: 10-block (15 mastered) mist. Deals 50 damage, applies Corrosion for 5s, drains 1,000 MP, and has a 30% chance to steal 1-3 Skills. Kills steal all eligible Skills. Mastery eats Magic projectiles. Sneak-use toggles block consumption.
[Press] Stomach: 9-row spatial storage; items stack to 666.
[Hold] Corrosion: Deals 10 Corrosion damage every 10 ticks in a 10x10 area (Costs 200 MP). Killed enemies surrender Skills.
[Press] Receive: Grants Skills owned by subordinates.
[Press] Isolation: Consumes held item, restoring 2x MP. Empty-handed removes target's negative effects. Without a target, cleanses user effects. Costs 100 MP per level removed.

title: Godly Craftsman
text:
Description:
Use advanced crafting knowledge to forge high-potential equipment, store enchantments and Engravings, and process materials.
How to Obtain:
Mastering Researcher.
Active Skills:
[Press] Godly Craftsman: Opens a GUI with 256-stack spatial storage, instant full-stack smelting, a crafting table, and a custom enchanting table using analyzed enchantments.
Stores enchantments/Engravings up to 2 levels above their cap. Crafted gear begins with 25%, 50%, 75%, or 100% of maximum potential EP (Mastery eliminates the 25% low-roll).

title: Gourmand
text:
Description:
Feast on enemy energy, steal Magicules through attacks, and grow stronger by executing weakened targets.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Gourmand: Kills grant an extra 3% (7.5% mastered) permanent Aura and Magicule EP.
[In Slot] Gourmand: Attacks have a 50% (75% mastered) chance to steal 1% of target's MP.
Active Skills:
[Press] Gourmand: Executes Fear V targets or targets with <10% user EP. Restores target's EP directly to MP/AP.

title: Gourmet
text:
Description:
Devour enemies, steal their abilities and EP, corrode nearby targets, and store consumed matter.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Active Skills:
[Press] Predation: 2-block mist. Deals 10 damage, drains 100 MP, 10% chance to steal random skill. Kills steal all eligible skills. Sneak-use sends blocks to Stomach.
[Hold] Corrosion: 10x10 area, 5 Corrosion DMG per 10 ticks. Kills steal Skills and add 30% EP.
[Press] Stomach: 7-row spatial storage (stacks to 200).
[Press] Receive: Grants the user the Skills owned by the targeted subordinate.

title: Great Sage
text:
Description:
Accelerate thought, learn and cast faster, appraise targets, copy abilities, and process materials.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Parallel Processing: Adds 9 Learning/Mastery Points when using Skills/Magic/Arts.
[Toggle] Chant Annulment: Instantly fills MP meters for mastered Magic.
[Toggle] Thought Acceleration: 2x Magic cast speed, +0.01 (+0.02 mastered) movement speed, +0.2 (+0.4 mastered) attack speed.
Active Skills:
[Press] Analytical Appraisal: Analysis Lvl 2, 20-block range (30 mastered).
[Press] Analysis: 25% (50% mastered) chance to copy eligible Magic or Skill within 20 blocks. (10s CD, 5s on fail).
[Press] Refining: GUI for crafting, brewing, item replication, and ore processing. Replication requires materials but no schematic. Brewing auto-processes slots every 5s.

title: Greed
text:
Description:
Dominate targets, empower yourself or allies through Spiritual Health, and execute enemies.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Active Skills:
[Hold] Spiritual Domination: Controls target after ~60s channel. Distance alters time (-30s close, +30s far). Desire stacks from trading reduce time on players. Sneak-use releases target.
[Hold] Death Wish: After 200 ticks of sight within 5 blocks, slows target by 60% and kills it. Costs 1,000 MP.
[Toggle] Greed Flare: 
• No target: +5% (+10% mastered) SHP bonus damage. Cost: 10 MP x Bonus.
• Ally target: Grants +2.5% (+5% mastered) SHP damage. Cost: 50 MP x Bonus.
• Enemy target: Deals 2.5% (5% mastered) SHP as damage. Cost: 20 MP x Bonus.

title: Guardian
text:
Description:
Protect allies by taking their damage and granting defensive buffs.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Substitution: Takes physical damage in place of subordinates.
Active Skills:
[Press] Grant Protection: Grants nearby subordinates and allies 10 Armor and 30 Barrier Points for 180s. Costs 100 MP.
[Toggle] Iron Wall: Grants 15 (40 mastered) Armor and 0.4 (1.0 mastered) Knockback Resistance.

title: Handler
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Active Skills:
[Press] Skill Optimization: Opens a menu listing customizable skills. Selecting a skill replaces or appends completely new traits onto its active sub-abilities.
[Press] Attribute Optimize: Grants a 1.5x multiplier to 3 attributes.
• Normal: Max HP, Armor, and Attack Speed.
• Shift (Mastered): Applies to SHP, Magicules, and Aura (does not restore missing points).

title: Healer
text:
Description:
Restore physical and spiritual health, remove Virus, or spread Infection.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll or from killing Shinji Tanimura if config enabled.
Active Skills:
[Press] Heal: Heals physical HP for 80 MP (40 mastered) per HP. Mastery also heals SHP for 60 MP/point. Sneak-target to heal entities, otherwise heals self/removes Virus.
[Press] Infection: Applies Infection (or cures Virus if already infected). Costs 100 MP.
[Hold] Plague: Mastery. Infects 15x15 area. Costs 300 MP.

title: Hearth
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Master Domicile and Have 5 subordinates.
Evolution:
Hestia, Lord of The Hearth.
Passives:
[Toggle] Home is Hearth: Boosts MP and AP regeneration speeds by 20x for the user and all allies inside their designated Homestead dimension zone.
Active Skills:
[Press] Homestead: Manifests a custom starter pocket dimension. Building is strictly locked to the owner. Combat and damage are entirely disabled inside.
[Press] Shopkeeper: Generates a locked marketplace pocket dimension for secure trading. Changes cannot be made to the terrain and violence is banned.
[Press] Hearth Heart: Projects a localized anchoring point. Establishes an absolute non-violence safe zone restricting all entities inside its radius.

title: Hidden Ruler
text:
Description:
Conceal your existence, empower nearby subordinates, and temporarily copy or distribute Skills.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Silence: Mutes user sounds.
[Toggle] Hidden Authority: Grants invisibility, hides from server player lists, sends fake join/leave messages.
[True] Ruler's Reign: Nearby subordinates gain Inspiration I (II mastered).
Active Skills:
[Press] Copy: 25% (50% mastered) chance to copy a target's Skill. Stored skills vanish on death. Sneak to view storage.
[Press] Paste: 25% (50% mastered) chance to gift a stored skill to target.
[Press] Recruitment: Charms target if EP < 20% of yours. Costs 1,000 MP.

title: Imitator
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Evolution:
Artist, Authentic Writer.
Active Skills:
[Press] Actor: Targets an entity to analyze them. At 100%, Shift-Use to transform completely into them. Copies stats, names, and skills. 

Limit: Fails if target's EP exceeds 50% of your current max EP. Does not copy player inventories.
[Press] Stage Crew: Projects and maps your recorded character imitations directly onto a designated body double or clone construct.

title: Infinity
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[In-Slot] Magic Alteration: Adds +10 flat Magic Damage. Bypasses Magic Jamming filters and degrades target Nullifications into standard Resistances.
[Toggle] Gluttonous Witch: Automatically memorizes and learns new magic types when exposed to them directly.

[Passive] Instant Enchant: Instantly casts any mastered spells. Requires Mastery to instantly cast any known spell.
Active Skills:
[Press] Spellbook: Shift-Use selects and amplifies a recorded spell. Use normally to cast the spell frame.

[Press] Absolute Cancel: Clears all status effects on self or target. Shift-Use clears all nearby entities. Requires Mastery to remove Cook.

title: Infinity Prison
text:
Description:
Seal targets inside a dimensional prison, block attacks, and store items and absorbed energy.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[In Slot] Absolute Guard: Blocks attacks for MP (Attack DMG x 25). Bypassed by targets with >75% your EP.
Active Skills:
[Press] Imprison: Costs 50k MP + 50% target EP. Seals movement/skills/healing and drains 500 MP per 10 ticks for 300s (600s mastered). (20s CD, 10s mastered).
Active Skills:
[Press] Imaginary Space: Opens 9x10-row spatial storage (stacks to 999). Safely stores the residual energy cost absorbed by Absolute Guard.

title: Inverse
text:
Description:
Reverse harmful conditions, reflect Magic Damage, and exchange positions with other entities.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Damage Redirection: Fully reflects Magic Damage (2x damage mastered).
[True] Destiny Switch: Mastery. Falling below 25% HP swaps user with the farthest mob within 40 blocks.
Active Skills:
[Press] Malice Exchange: Transfers negative status effects between entities.
[Press] Redirect: Exchanges positions with target.

title: Inversion
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Spatial Authority: Cuts all incoming Spatial Damage and incoming Severance status modifiers in half.
Active Skills:
[Hold] Motion Control: Halves movement speeds of all nearby targets. Halves your speed too, unless the skill is mastered.
[Press] Scrap: Drags targets forcefully toward you. Targets a block held by an enemy to smash the block and retrieve it.

[Press] Spatial Management: Access an expansive 7-page spatial storage container. Items can stack up to a max of 77.

title: Investigator
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Evolution:
Faust, Lord of Investigation.
Passives:
[Toggle] Thought Acceleration: Speeds up reaction times.

Active Skills:
[Toggle] Analytical Appraisal: Grants Appraisal Lvl 5 (Lvl 15 when mastered).

[Press] Pursuit of Tutelage: Requires Mastery. Opens a training UI to teach spells/battlewills to targets.
[Hold] Pursuit of Truth: Every 10s, rolls a 1/3 chance to gain data profiles on targets (up to 10 points).
In-slot bonuses: +10 Learn Speed/Mastery, 50% Melee Dodge, 25% Projectile Dodge, 30% Crit Chance, and 40% Dodge Negation.
Shift-Press cycles search filters:
• Surprise: Outlines nearby traps (Lava, Sculk, TNT, etc).
• Treasure: Outlines valuable Ores, Vaults, and Charybdis Cores.
• Battle: Color-codes targets (Yellow = Neutral, Red = Hostile).

title: Kyurem
text:
Description:
Control freezing weather and draconic energy to slow and damage everything nearby.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll or you must have either [Reshiram] Or [Zekrom]. Additionally, you need 100k EP, as well as consume 10 Ice Essence and 10 Dragon Essence.
Passives:
[In Slot] Pressure: Attackers suffer double ability costs for 30s.
Active Skills:
[Hold] Glaciate: 10-block hail. Cold Damage scales from 10 to 100 (200 mastered). Costs 500 MP/s.
[Press] Draconic Pulse: Fires dragon blast for 40 Magic Damage. Costs 300 MP.
[Hold] Freeze Dry: 20 Cold Damage/s to target. 10% chance to freeze for 30s. Costs 500 MP/s.
[Hold] Blizzard: Continuous storm dealing heavy Cold and Water Damage. (10s CD after release)

title: Lemegeton
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[True] Magical Prodigy: Instant learning and mastery of all acquired spells. Unlocks Concentrator automatically.
[In-Slot] Magic Cancel: Requires Mastery. Getting hit by an ability locks all its submodes behind a 300s cooldown. (60s Cooldown).

[Toggle] Arcane Blessing: Multiplies all outbound Magic, Holy, and Spiritual damage by 2x.
Active Skills:
[Press] Demon Seal: Costs 50k Magicules. Temporarily tames spiritual players with <=40% EP, or spiritual mobs with <=80% EP.
[Hold] Key’s Defense: Blocks Physical, Fire, and Water impacts using Magicules at a cost of 50 MP per damage point. Halves player movement speed while channel is held.

title: Lord of Magewolves
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Ultra Instinct: Ultimate evasion reflex states.

Active Skills:
[Press] Tribe Summon: Spawns 1-3 loyal nameless Direwolves (3-6 when mastered). Cap of 12 active wolves. Requires Mastery to name pack via command.
[Hold] Tribe Regeneration: Regenerates the user at Ultraspeed thresholds. If user's HP is full, channels the healing stream directly to all nearby registered pack wolves.
[Press] Assimilation: Merges physically with a target subordinate or pack wolf. Absorbs their raw stats and grants full usage of their active skills.
[Press] Will Manipulation: Changes pack AI states: Neutral, Passive, Aggressive, or Protect. Aggressive commands direct wolves to hunt non-allied entities exceeding 10k EP.

title: Lust
text:
Description:
Control life and death by draining energy, healing allies, and condemning weaker targets.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll or from Luminous Valentine.
Active Skills:
[Press] Drain: Targetless: 10s buff draining 200 MP/AP per hit (+0.1% mastered). Targeted: Instant drain of 200 MP/AP (+0.5% mastered). Costs 100 MP.
[Press] Invigorate: Fully heals/cleanses. 80 MP (40 mastered) per HP + 100 MP per effect level. Sneak-target to heal allies.
[Press] Embracing Drain: Requires Learning. Locks user and target. Drains 200 MP/AP/s (+0.5% mastered) for 5s. Bypasses resistance. Costs 500 MP.
[Hold] Death Blessing: Mastery & Learning. Targets 10-block point, slows 6x6 area. After 5s, kills entities <50% EP to restore MP/AP. Damages higher EP entities. Costs 7,500 MP.

title: Malleable
text:
Description:
Adapt like clay by learning defenses rapidly, changing attack attributes, and hardening the body.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Acquisition] Cold Clay: Grants Flame Attack Resistance on unlock.
[Toggle] Memory Material: Resistances and Earth-type Magic learned 5x faster.
Active Skills:
[Press] Alchemy: Cycles elemental modes (Physical, Fire, Ice, Light, Dark, etc). Damage changes to match.
[Hold] Harden: Locks movement. Grants Regen V, Resistance II, 10 Armor. Releasing gives Weakness II / Slowness II for 30s. (120s CD, 60s mastered)
[Press] Vessel: Creates clay golem with 40 HP (200 mastered). Possessors act as temporary subordinates. (Max 2)

title: Martial Master
text:
Description:
Strengthen melee and Battlewill attacks, accelerate thought, and evade incoming strikes.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[True] Martial Master: 5x Learning/Mastery Points for Battlewill.
[In Slot] Secret: Multiplies melee/Battlewill by 1.5.
[Toggle] Thought Accel/Foresight: Dodges 100% projectiles, 25% melee. 2x Magic cast speed.
Active Skills:
[Press] Ultra Accel: Rushes 15 blocks, dealing crit damage (+75 mastered) to targets in path. Costs 100 AP.

title: Mathematician
text:
Description:
Apply calculation to faster learning, improved reactions, precise attacks, and target appraisal.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll or from Hinata Sakaguchi.
Passives:
[Toggle] Mathematician: +2 Learning/Mastery Points.
[Toggle] Predictive Calculation: 25% auto-dodge, 50% dodge bypass, 75% crit rate.
Active Skills:
[Press] Analytical Appraisal: Lvl 1 (2 mastered), 10-block range (20 mastered). Blocks details of >5x EP targets.

title: Melancholy
text:
Description:
Spread sorrow through a slowing aura while manipulating entities with powerful wind.
How to Obtain:
 Master Thrower & Molecular Manipulation.
Passives:
[In Slot] Isha's Tears: Slowness IV to nearby targets. User gains Slowness II and Resistance II.
[True] Veil: <25% HP triggers violent 12-block repulsion. Applies Slowness X & Burden IV. (5m CD)
Active Skills:
[Press] Gust / Grief: Gust produces wind tools. Grief (1,000 MP) repels 8 blocks and blinds.

title: Merciless
text:
Description:
Drain Spiritual Health through attacks and instantly kill weakened, terrified, or vastly weaker enemies.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll or Obtaining 20k Souls with rimuruMode on OR some servers have special conditions its obtainment.
Active Skills:
[In Slot] Soul Consume: Attacks drain 10 SHP every 10 ticks for 5s. Costs 100 MP per attack.
[Hold] Soul Steal: Instantly kills mobs within a 30x30 area meeting one condition: <10% HP, EP <10% user max EP, or Fear V+. Costs 100 MP.

title: Murderer
text:
Description:
Move without sound, vanish from detection, and strike harder while concealed.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Silent Movement: User produces no sound. Immune to Sculk/Sense Soundwave.
Active Skills:
[Hold] Presence Concealment: Toggle Mastered. Grants invisibility and radar block. While In-slot, attacks deal +50 (+150 mastered) physical damage. Costs 50 MP per 20 ticks.

title: Musician
text:
Description:
Turn sound into armor-piercing blasts and detect nearby entities through noise.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Sense Soundwave: Outlines noise-producing entities in green (20 blocks).
Active Skills:
[Press] Sonic Blast / Sound Wave: Blast deals 75 (150 mastered) Armor-ignoring damage. Wave deals 40 (70 mastered) in a 10x10 area.
[Press] Mind Requiem: Mastery. 150 Damage + 100 Spiritual Damage.

title: Observer
text:
Description:
See all, evade all. Instinctively avoid attacks, detect concealed dangers, and identify hidden entities.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll or from Shin Ryusei.
Passives:
[Toggle] Instinctual Avoidance: Grants a 20% chance to auto-dodge melee attacks and a 100% chance to auto-dodge thrown projectiles.
[In Slot] Danger Detection: Functions like Danger Sense.
Active Skills:
[Hold] Presence Detection: Raises Presence Sense Level by 1 and distance by 20 blocks. Sneak-activate to cycle modes:
• All: Highlights every mob in blue (including invisible/concealed).
• Monsters: Highlights neutral mobs in yellow, enemies in red.
Presence Detection (Cont.):
• Trap: Highlights lava, sculk, TNT, webs, etc., in red at half range.
• Treasure: Mastery. Highlights chests, vaults, dragon eggs, Magic Ore, and Charybdis Cores in gold at half range.

title: Oppressor
text:
Description:
Dominate gravity, control attractive and repulsive forces, and crush enemies with ranged attacks.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Oppressor: Grants fall-damage immunity. Mastery grants simple projectile immunity and enables manual range selection for Repel, Attract, and Flicker.
Active Skills:
[Hold] Repel/Attract: Pushes/pulls viewed target. Holding increases distance. (50 MP)
[Hold] Flicker: Launches user forward. Holding scales distance. (50 MP)
[Press] Oppress: Traps target for 30s. Reduces speed/jump to 5% and applies Burden II. Adds 1 Insanity level every 10s. Reactivation deals 100 (200 mastered) damage. Trap costs 300 MP, damage costs 700 MP. (10s CD, 5s mastered)
[Press] Bleve: Deals 100 damage (200 mastered) to the viewed target and launches it 10 blocks upward. Costs 1,000 MP.

title: Phaser
text:
Description:
Access a private dimension, become intangible, and eject stored projectiles through portals.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Eye of Insight: Grants Thought Acceleration and Magic Sense (50 MP per 5s).
[True] Overuse: Phaser abilities add Overuse. At 10 stacks, forces 180s CD. Avoiding use for 15s resets stacks.
[True] Intangibility: Auto-dodges next attack, granting 5s immunity. (15s CD). Adds Overuse.
Active Skills:
[Hold, Press] Ejection: Sneak-press opens storage for 3 projectile stacks (5 mastered) of up to 128 each. Hold for 3s (1.5s mastered) to open portals. Releasing launches one projectile from every slot at 3x bow speed with increased damage. Adds Overuse.

title: Plunderer
text:
Description:
Preserve slain enemies as permanent Shadow Warriors and merge their strength into your own.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Soulscape: Kills have a 25% (50% mastered) chance to leave a soul for 30s. Must create a Shadow Warrior before it vanishes.
[True] Essence of Night: Shadow Warriors gain damage and speed at night.
Active Skills:
[Press] Shadow Warrior: Converts lingering soul into a permanent subordinate (excludes bosses). Target's former EP is permanently removed from user's max MP.
[Press] Shadow Storage: Converts viewed subordinate into an item to store or summon later.
[Press] Shadow Merge: While holding a stored Shadow Warrior, merges its stats/max EP into the user. Applies Essence of Night to user. Reactivation returns it to item form. Dying while merged destroys it. Mastery grants Shadow Motion.

title: Predator
text:
Description:
Eat, analyze, refine, store, and mimic. Become the monster you were meant to be.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Evolution:
Gluttony.
Active Skills:
[Press] Predation: 2-block mist. Deals 10 damage, drains 100 MP, 10% chance to steal random Skill. Kills grant all eligible Skills. Mastery eats projectiles (learning Magic) and has 50% chance to copy Magic on consume. First kill of each mob adds 30% EP to max.
[Press] Stomach: Opens 7-row spatial storage (stacks to 128).
[Press] Isolation: Consumes held item for 2x MP. Empty-handed removes target's (or user's) negative effects for 100 MP per level.
[Press] Analysis: Opens analysis GUI similar to Great Sage's Refining (no automation).

title: Pride
text:
Description:
Turn an opponent's strength into your own by copying ability modes after they affect you.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll or from Gii Crimson from TR:Nightmares.
Passives:
[In Slot] Copy: Copies specific ability modes after being hit/affected by them. Mastery allows copying status-inflicting abilities (Spirit Magic excluded). Mastery gain equals 1 point per 2,500 MP cost of the original skill.
[In Slot] Copy (Cont.): Failed copies grant 10% Mastery and 10% CD. Successful copies charge the full MP cost, place Pride on CD, and instantly learn the mode. Note: Copied modes lack original passive features.
Active Skills:
[Press] Copy: Opens GUI to manage/equip copied modes.

title: Processor
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[True] Multi-Threading: Cast/chant 2 abilities simultaneously (3 on mastery).

[True] RAM Access: Casting an Allocate spell again within 5s results in an instant cast.
[Toggle] Thought Acceleration: Cuts spellcasting times in half and adds +1 dodge I-frame. Mastery scales down cast times per allocated processing Thread.
Active Skills:
[Toggle] Allocate: Dedicates extra threads into a single spell, locking multi-cast. Shift-Use disables. Mastery shifts idle threads into Thought Acceleration.
[Press] Overclock: Requires Mastery. Boosts skill outputs by +30% for 40s, then forces a 5-minute cool down lock. 

🔥 Heat Synergies: Heat Resistance or Nullification scales power up to +50% and reduces down-times.

title: Provider
text:
Description:
Empower allies through an amplification gate, then spend their contributions to strengthen yourself.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Active Skills:
[Press] Generosity: Creates a gate that triples allied projectile damage. Allies passing through gain Speed/Step Height for 10s and grant 1 Contribution. User gets no benefits. Costs 1,000 MP + 500 MP/s. Sneak to remove.
[Toggle] Pay It Forward: Consumes Contributions to empower user (10s per).
• 30: 2x DMG, +0.1 Spd, +2 Height
• 50: 3x DMG, +0.15 Spd, +3 Height
• 100: 5x DMG, +0.2 Spd, +4 Height
• 500: 10x DMG, +0.5 Spd, +6 Height

title: Reaper
text:
Description:
Scout by shrinking and sensing enemies, create combat clones, or consume targets in a single strike.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Recon: Halves user size, adds 1 Presence Sense Lvl and 10 range (20 mastered). Highlights mobs in white. Grants 10% (20% mastered) auto-dodge. Disabled if Attack is active.
Active Skills:
[Press] Attack: Select up to 5 clones via scroll. Releasing halves user size/EP, dividing 50% EP evenly among identical clones. Sneak uses Alex model. Reactivate to recall.
[Press] Infinite Eater: Instantly kills targets with lower EP, consuming 50% EP (first kill per mob type). Costs target's EP. (10s CD, 5s mastered).

title: Reducer
text:
Description:
Greatly improve energy regeneration and reduce the cost of every ability.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[True] Beloved by Energy: Multiplies MP and AP regeneration by 10.
[Toggle] Purification: Reduces all MP and AP costs by 50% (66% mastered).
Active Skills:
[Toggle] Emancipation: Adds Holy Damage (1.75x original damage). Costs 2,000 MP + 300 MP/s.
[Press] Purity Edge: Empowers next strike for 3s (5s mastered). Deals 25% (50% mastered) of target's max HP (doubled vs Majin). Missing deals 75% (50% mastered) self-damage. Base Cost: 10,000 MP. (120s CD, 60s mastered).

title: Reflector
text:
Description:
Store received damage as Echo Points, fire it back as a projectile, or directly counter an attack.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[In Slot] Reflector: Taking damage adds an equal number of Echo Points.
Active Skills:
[Press] Echo Reflection: Consumes Echo Points to fire an electric projectile dealing Echo x3 (x5 mastered) damage. Sneak/scroll to adjust output %.
[Hold] Echo Counter: Stops/reflects next attack. Roots user without Mastery. Non-projectiles return with 2.5x force. Projectiles return at 2x speed (Magic deals 2.5x damage). (5s CD)

title: Repeater
text:
Description:
Repeat physical attacks and accumulate a sequence of strikes into one amplified result.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll or from Memories boss Tensura Mysticism.
Passives:
[Toggle] Repeating Action: Every instance of physical damage dealt by the user occurs a second time.
Active Skills:
[Press] Recursion Depth: Lasts 5s. Each hit deals 10% less than the last. At end, all hits are summed, multiplied by 1.5x, and dealt to target.
[Press] Flarefrost Storehouse: Stores Axiom and Memory Blades after defeating Memoires. Activation equips stored blades (prioritizing Axiom). Sneak-activate to manage storage manually.

title: Researcher
text:
Description:
Study enchantments, process materials, and build equipment through an integrated research workspace.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Evolution:
Godly Craftman.
Active Skills:
[Press] Researcher: Opens GUI with 128-stack storage, instant smelter, crafting table, and custom enchanter. Books add to the selectable list. Enchantments can exceed caps by 1 level. Upgrades cost Max MP. Auto-evolves to Godly Craftsman upon mastery.

title: Reshiram
text:
Description:
Command blue fire and draconic power to burn large areas and bombard enemies.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll or you must have either [Zekrom] Or [Kyurem]. Additionally, you need 100k EP, as well as consume 10 Blaze Essence and 10 Dragon Essence.
Passives:
[Toggle] Turboblaze: Doubles all Fire damage (stacks with Flame Domination).
Active Skills:
[Press] Blue Flare: 20x20 blue flame area. Deals 60 continuous damage. Costs 400 MP. (10s CD, 5s mastered)
[Press] Fusion Flare: Vortex dealing 40 Fire DMG/s for 5s (400 MP). Adds 40 Electric DMG with Zekrom.
[Press] Draconic Meteor: Drops meteor dealing 70 Magic Damage. Destroys blocks/knocks back. Costs 400 MP. (20s CD)
[Hold] Flamethrower: Breathes fire dealing 30 Fire Damage/s. Costs 70 MP/s.

title: Restricted
text:
Description:
Sacrifice Magicules and ordinary Skill growth for overwhelming Aura and physical power.
How to Obtain:
Restricted Human.
Passives:
[True] Heavenly Restriction: Prevents gaining MP/new Skills (except racial/gift/Battlewill). Grants 3x normal AP. Immune to Magicule sensing.
[In Slot] Fearless: Immunity to Fear, Slowness, Burden, Haki.
[Toggle] Learned Techniques: Multiplies Battlewill by 5x and physical by 3x.
Active Skills:
[Press] Decimate: Dashes 12 blocks (16 mastered). Deals 20 + weapon crit. Mastery: 1.5x (35 + crit), hits Spirituals, bypasses resist. (500 AP)
[Press] Counter: Stationary parry for 3s (5s mastered). Negates next physical hit and disables attacker's speed for 5s. (15s CD on success). (1,500 AP)

title: Reverser
text:
Description:
Flip alignments, invert buffs and debuffs, and turn harmful conditions into advantages.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Active Skills:
[Press] Inverted Fusion [Buff]: Inverts negative effects into buffs (e.g. Poison -> Regen, Slowness -> Speed, Weakness -> Strength). Mastery converts gear Curses into Blessings.
[Press] Inverted Fusion [Debuff]: Reverses buffs into debuffs. Mastery makes it toggleable to auto-reverse incoming debuffs.
[Press] Alignment Reverse: Forces a Majin/Holy/True Hero to Chaos alignment. Chaos Majins may become True Heroes, bypass Holy Coat, and resist Charybdis lasers. Mastery allows changing other players/mobs.

title: Robotnic
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Active Skills:
[Press] Deconstruct: Data: Select an owned skill to sacrifice. Adds 1/2 of its creation value directly to your max MP allocation profile and 1/2 to the skill index.
[Press] Deconstruct: Object: Instantly deletes the item in your main hand. Converted EP yields half its value as max AP and feeds the skill's stored MP bank. (30s Cooldown)

title: Royal Beast
text:
Description:
Unleash primal fury and gain a massive physical boost.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Active Skills:
[Press] Royal Beast: Fully restores HP/MP/AP. Grants Strength 10, 20 Armor, +0.08 Speed, creative flight, and doubles max MP/AP for 3 mins (6 mins mastered).
Applies Paralysis II, Fragility II, Weakness II for 10 mins after ending. (20 min CD). Costs 0 MP.

title: Saint
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Evolution:
Metatron, Lord of Purity.
Passives:
[True] Spiritron Collection: Gains a Spiritron Point (SP) Bar below MP/AP. Fills by 1 SP/s (5 when mastered) up to 100 while MP is at >=90%.

[In-Slot] Purified Attacks: While SP is >=50, melee hits deal +20 (+40 mastered) Holy Damage.
[Toggle] Holy Miracle: Increases Holy DMG by +25 (+75 mastered), but you take 50 (25 mastered) self-damage on execution.

Active Skills:
[Hold] Disintegration: Chants a holy spell costing 75 SP and 25,000 MP. Deals 150 absolute Holy Damage.
[Press] Melt Cut: Requires Mastery. Coats your weapon blade in raw Holy Magic. Attacks deal 75 Holy Damage on hit. (1s Cooldown)

title: Scholar
text:
Description:
Instantly gain technical knowledge, study attackers, and manage enchanted books.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Acquisition] Knowledge of the Ages: Teaches all Schematics.
[Toggle] Quick Reader: +6 Learning/Mastery Points.
[In Slot] Study: 20% chance on hit to gain Study Point for that mob. Each point adds +2% dodge (cap 50%, 75% mastered).
Active Skills:
[Press] Library of Babel: Opens book-only storage. Right-click enchanted books to raise/lower levels (up to +5 over cap). Upgrades consume max MP based on level.

title: Schrodinger
text:
Description:
Survive repeated deaths, preserve energy after dying, and fight with feline instincts.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[True] Nine Lives: Permits 9 respawns in Hardcore.
[True] Dead or Alive: 50% chance to preserve energy/Souls on death.
[Toggle] Feline Instincts: +32 blocks safe fall distance.
[In Slot] Poison Touch: Hits apply Poison II (Fatal Poison II mastered).

title: Seeker
text:
Description:
Seek the world's truths and learn as much Magic as possible.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[True] Seeker: +4 Learning/Mastery Points for Magic.
[Toggle] Thought Accel: 2x Magic cast speed, +0.01 (+0.02 mastered) speed, +0.2 (+0.4 mastered) attack speed.
[Toggle] Chant Annulment: Instant cast for mastered Magic.
Active Skills:
[Press] Analyze: Channels for 3s (1s mastered) to copy a viewed Magic Circle/entity within 15 blocks. Excludes Spirit/elemental summoning Magic.

title: Seer
text:
Description:
Foresee attacks, evade or reduce their damage, and predict movement for precise critical strikes.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Precognition: 25% (50% mastered) physical/projectile auto-dodge. Connected hits deal 70% (50% mastered) damage. Grants 33% (50% mastered) crit chance.
Active Skills:
[Press] Future Sight: Grants perfect dodge, dodge negation, and crit chance for 10s (20s mastered). (10s CD after ending).

title: Sentient Being
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Evolution:
Carnation.
Passives:
[True] Abundance: Magicule Regeneration scales by x2 whenever current levels fall below 85% MP.

[Toggle] Family Account: Shares the user's active Magicule pool dynamically with nearby subordinates.
Active Skills:
[Hold] Snack For Later!: Boosts Magicule Regen by 5x (10x mastered). Overfills into Stored Magicules if at 100% MP.

[Press] Family Bonds!: Spends MP + Stored MP to copy an ally's skill. Requires Mastery to copy up to 4 Unique Skills.

title: Severer
text:
Description:
Slice through reality with Spatial Blades, Severance, and devastating blade storms.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Active Skills:
[Press] Dummy Sword: Creates a Spatial Blade with Severance V (X mastered). Costs 100 MP. Regenerates lost blades for 20 MP.
[Press] Blade Storm: Requires Spatial Blade. Fires 5 (10 mastered) Severance Blades toward target. Range 20 (30 mastered). 2,000 MP. (5s CD, 3s mastered).
[Press] Severance: For 120s, all attacks apply Severance and gain +10 damage (+30 mastered). Costs 200 MP.

title: Shadow Striker
text:
Description:
Become one with shadows, deal massive Spiritual Damage, and hide from sensory abilities.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Thought Accel: Doubles Magic cast speed and increases movement/attack speed.
[In Slot] Instakill: Attacks deal 500 (1,000 mastered) Spiritual Damage. Costs 3,000 MP. (10s CD, 5s mastered).
Active Skills:
[Press] Ultra Accel: Rushes 10 blocks, dealing crit damage (+70 mastered) to targets in path. 100 AP.
[Hold] Espionage: Toggle Mastered. Grants Presence Concealment I (II mastered). Immune to Magic Sense, Heat, and Sound detection.

title: Sloth
text:
Description:
Put enemies into a fatal sleep, drain their power, and rest to recover vitality.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Phantasmal Strike: Deals 10 Spiritual DMG (+1% max SHP mastered).
Active Skills:
[Hold] Deep Hypno: Adds 1 Drowsiness level every 10s. Lvl V kills. Destroys Magic Circles.
[Hold] Fallen Hypno: 10x10 area (20x20 mastered) Hypno. Channels take 2x longer.
[Hold] Deprive: Drains 1,000 MP, deals 10 SHP/s (+0.3% max MP/1% SHP mastered). Targets <50% SHP become subordinates.
[Hold] Rest: Roots user. Restores 10 HP/SHP per second (+1% max mastered). Multiplies regen by 10x. Right-click to heal allies in 30 blocks.
[Press] Fallen Strike: Requires Phantasmal Strike/Mastery. Deals 500 Spiritual DMG, ignoring Nullification. 5,000 MP. (10s CD).

title: Snatch
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Fountain of Youth: Grants Costless Regeneration, Thought Acceleration, a 50% chance to steal MP on hit, and full immunity to Abnormal Conditions, Chill, Rest, and Sleep.
Costless Regen Conversion:
• 1 HP = 80 MP (40 mastered)
• 1 SHP = 240 MP 
• With Infinity: 1 SHP = 50 MP

Active Skills:
[Press] Physical Hunt: Targets a unit (20-block range) to apply Fragility while gaining Strength, Haste, Resistance, and +75% of their ATK damage. Sneak-use makes it an AoE effect.
[Press] Fox Hunt: Requires learning. Instantly executes a looked-at target with lower EP than you, absorbing its full EP value. Re-casting on the same type yields 25% EP. Sneak-use grants an AoE bypass.

[Hold] Zero Sign: Grants complete Presence Concealment and a +5 ATK boost per entity within 15 blocks.

title: Sniper
text:
Description:
Deal ranged damage with specialized ammunition that bypasses defenses and secures fast kills.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle, In Slot] Spatial Manipulation: 2x Spatial DMG. Non-Magic projectiles warp behind target (50 MP).
[Toggle] Magic Sense: Mastered radius.
[Toggle] Predictive Calculation: 10% auto-dodge, 50% bypass. Bypasses resistances.
Active Skills:
[Press] Create Weapon: Creates Walther P99. Sneak-click swaps ammo. Physical: 100 AP, 30 DMG (1s CD). Magic: 100 MP, 100 (200 mastered) DMG (3s CD). CDs removed with Mastery. Magic bullets apply Severance if Warp is active.
[Press] Create Weapon (Alt): Activating while viewing an entity or already holding a pistol throws a 5x5 exploding grenade. (3s CD, 1s mastered).

title: Soul Shrine
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Black Flash: Grants a 1% chance on melee hit to land a Black Flash, multiplying damage by 2.5x. Enters 'The Zone' to boost subsequent damage by 1.2x and increase Black Flash odds by +20% (up to a 5% baseline).
Active Skills:
[In-Slot] Divergent Fist: Melee hits trigger a second magic attack for 1.5x placeholder damage. Upon mastery, original damage is multiplied by 2x.

[Press] Simple Domain: Grants +50% Dodge Chance and halves incoming magic damage for 30s. (2 min CD / 60s CD on mastery)

title: Spearhead
text:
Description:
Empower and command allies, then collect their abilities after they fall.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[True] Skill Collection: When an ally dies within 20 blocks, the user collects its Resistance, Intrinsic, Common, Extra, and Unique Skills. Player Skills require Hardcore Mode.
[In Slot] Spearhead: Allies gain 10 damage, +0.02 Speed, +1 Swim Speed, and 5 Armor. Mastery doubles these bonuses.
Active Skills:
[Press] Thought Domination: Opens commands for subordinates, including directing them to act as a Meat Shield.

title: Spiritualist
text:
Description:
Draw support from spirits to improve Magic casting, reduce damage, harvest Souls, and empower attacks.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Chant Reduction: Spirits greatly reduce the casting time of unmastered Magic.
[Toggle] Chant Annulment: Mastered Magic requires no chanting.
[In Slot] Spiritfarer: Reduces Magic and Spiritual Damage by 25% and Physical Damage by 10%.
Passives (Cont.):
[In Slot] Leyline Connection: Halves every MP cost.
[True] Harvester: Kills grant Souls even when the user is not a Majin.
Active Skills:
[Press] Carve: Spins the Ritual Scythe and harvests Souls based on damage dealt. (10s CD).
Active Skills (Cont.):
[Scroll] Enhance: Hold and scroll to select a percentage of stored Souls. The selected amount empowers the next Magic or Spiritual attack by that percentage plus 10%.

title: Stagnator
text:
Description:
Halt movement and physical action while preserving health and severing enemies.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Active Skills:
[Hold] Stagnate Aura: Entities within 25 blocks cannot move or use physical and Aura attacks. Mental, Magic, and Skill attacks remain available. Costs 500 MP/s.
[Hold] Inaction: Prevents user from moving or using physical/Aura attacks, but current HP cannot decrease. SHP remains vulnerable. Costs 100 MP/s.
[Toggle] Stasis Coat: Adds Severance and 10 damage to melee attacks.
[Press] Stasis Shot: Requires Learning. Fires an air projectile at 25 blocks per second. It bypasses Armor, deals 5 damage, and severs the target's HP. Costs 1,000 MP. Cooldown 20s.

title: Starved
text:
Description:
Consume enemies, corrode their bodies, take their abilities, and drive subordinates into a rampage.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll or Use Predator to predate a mob/player with Starved or from Orc Lord Race.
Active Skills:
[Hold] Corrosion: In-slot: adds Corrosion to physical attacks. No target: deals 5 Corrosion Damage every 10 ticks in a 10x10 area (200 MP). Killed enemies surrender Skills and add EP to Stomach energy.
[Press] Stomach: Opens a 6-row spatial storage where items stack to 128.
[Press] Receive: Grants the user the Intrinsic, Common, Extra, and Resistance Skills owned by the viewed subordinate.
[Press] Spiritual Domination: Provides Thought Communication commands plus Rampage. Rampage affects subordinates within 30 blocks for 5 mins. Reactivating removes it.

title: Stasis
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Evolution:
Cadence.
Passives:
[In-Slot] Status Quo: Maximum Health cannot be reduced by external hazards like Severance or Cook.

[Toggle] Render Stillness: Solidifies liquid surfaces underfoot, letting you walk seamlessly over them.
Active Skills:
[In-Slot] Fixed State: Locks consumption models, stopping Magicules and Aura from being expended.

[Hold] Air Wall: Drops a solid 5x5 impenetrable air barrier that blocks pathing and completely vaporizes incoming projectiles.

title: Stripes
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Active Toggles:
[Toggle] Force: Requires Object OFF. Complete immunity to Disintegration, Slowness, Slow Falling, Mining Fatigue, and Burden. Shatters multi-layer barriers. Damages enemies who physically strike you.
[Toggle] Object: Requires Force OFF. Cuts all incoming damage by 50%. Grants physical resistance that functions like full Nullification. 

Weakness: Getting struck by an attack that degrades physical resistances instantly breaks this state.

title: Subjugator
text:
Description:
Build subordinate loyalty, convert it into defense, and directly control weaker targets.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Unbreakable Defense: Requires 2,000+ nearby Loyalty. Every 2,000 grants 2% damage reduction (up to 50%). Disables Skills/Magic/Battlewill for user.
[In Slot] Undying Loyalty: Nearby subordinates (8 blocks) gain 2 Loyalty every 5s (4 in 16 blocks mastered).
Passives (Cont.):
[Toggle] Under Orders: Changing subordinate targeting grants Inspiration I for 30s (II for 60s mastered).
[True] Powerful Control: Requires Mastery. Greed/Dominate abilities no longer require extended targeting.
Active Skills:
[Press] Takeover: Controls viewed target if its EP is below user's MP (cap 600,000). Mental Magic raises cap by 100,000.
[Press] Thought Domination: Controls subordinate Movement (Follow, Wander, Meat Shield) or Targeting (Passive, Aggressive, Protect).

title: Sunshine
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[Toggle] Grace of the Sun: Multiplies Damage, HP, Armor, and Speed based on daytime. Peaks at noon; provides zero boost at night unless wielding Rhitta.

Active Skills:
[Press] Solar Burst: Shoots a flame orb dealing Fire DMG. (100s CD)
[Press] Cruel Sun: Fires a highly destructive solar orb, dealing massive Fire damage and obliterating blocks in a 6-block radius. (160s CD)

[Press] Burn to Ash: Requires learning. Summons a blazing fire ring around a target location, trapping and dealing fire/magic damage. (200s CD)
[Press] Spiral of Creation: Erupts a massive 4x4 column of flame centered on your position. Traps all caught units inside for a few seconds, dealing ticking damage to everyone except the user. (800s CD)

title: Suppressor
text:
Description:
Restrict teleportation, swap positions, and cross large distances through spatial movement.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[True] Suppressor: Mastery grants Severance immunity.
[Toggle] Thought Acceleration: Doubles Magic casting speed and increases movement and attack speed.
Active Skills:
[Press] Spatial Suppression: Prevents teleporting in a 50x50 area for 60s. Costs 300 MP.
[Press] Swap: Exchanges positions with the viewed entity within 30 blocks. Costs 100 MP.
[Press] Spatial Motion: Normal use blinks for 10 MP per block. Sneak-use opens the Spatial GUI, costing 10 MP per block for instant travel or 5 MP per block for a portal.

title: Survivor
text:
Description:
Endure overwhelming damage through efficient regeneration and broad defensive resistances.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll or from Shogo Taguchi.
Passives:
[Toggle] Ultraspeed Regeneration: Functions like standard Ultraspeed Regeneration at one-fifth of its normal MP cost.
[Toggle] Various Attributes Nullification: Grants Abnormal Condition Nullification, Physical Attack Resistance, Pain Nullification, and Resistance to all major elements (Darkness, Light, Earth, Water, Flame, Wind, Spatial, Electricity, Gravity, Heat, Cold, Corrosion).

title: Tempter
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
From Seeker.
Evolution:
Azazel, Lord of Temptation.
Passives:
[In-Slot] Solicitation: Requires Mastery. Allows copying sub-skills using Pride-based logic patterns.

Active Skills:
[Press] Charm: Afflicts targets with charm status.

[Press] Temptation World: Traps Charmed or Feared units in a blinding illusion. Blinds vision to a few blocks. Spiritual Nullification or higher EP ignores this.
[Press] Reality Exchange: Requires Mastery. Drags all units currently stuck inside Temptation World down into the Temptation Void Dimension.

[Press] Solicitation: Requires Mastery/Learning. Opens a sub-menu to use skills copied via Tempter exclusively inside the Temptation Dimension.
[Press] End Of World: Requires Mastery/Learning. Collapses the dimension in a blinding flash. Deals 1,000 Spiritual Damage to all units inside (halved if within 50% of user's EP). Instantly executes targets with under 30% of your EP.

title: The Balance
text:
Description:
Accumulate received misfortune and redirect critical attacks and stored damage toward enemies.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[In Slot] Freund Schild: Every 1,000 damage received grants 1 Misfortune Point. Released Misfortune cannot be mitigated or nullified.
[Toggle] Probability Manipulation: Grants 50% dodge chance and 45% critical-hit chance (70% and 65% mastered).
Passives (Cont.):
[Toggle] The Balance: Reflects incoming critical damage and carries over attached effects (like Cook or Severance) back to the attacker. Susano'o bypasses it.
[True] Fortune Mitigation: The user's own power reduces all damage they deal by 25%.
Active Skills:
[Press] Misfortune Release: Releases up to 10 stored Misfortune Points. Each point deals 1,000 absolute damage and bypasses every barrier type.

title: The Don
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
 Master Deal Maker, have 10 Daemon Subordinates, and Obtain shopkeeper though a deal.
Active Skills:
[Press] Deal: Upgrades trading contracts to manipulate and gamble directly with the souls of contract targets.

[Press] Editing: Allows modification of active contracts if the target explicitly agrees.
[Press] The Casino: Requires Domicile/Hearth Shopkeeper. Manifests a specialized gambling realm, allowing players to bet, win, or completely lose assets typically restricted to unique Deals.

title: Thrower
text:
Description:
Throw almost anything with extreme force, precision, and specialized effects.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll or from Mark Lauren.
Evolution:
Melancholy.
Passives:
[Toggle] Homing Projectile: Thrown items home toward the viewed position or lock onto targets within 50 blocks.
[True] Thrower: Kunai, Spears, and Tridents deal increased damage.
Active Skills:
[Press] Throw: Throws held item model for 50 (100 mastered) damage + normal weapon damage. Gravity abilities scale damage (x2 or x3). Elemental Cores add elemental damage. Tool throws break blocks. Empty-hand throws air for 30 (50 mastered) damage. Mastery returns thrown items via Loyalty.

title: Time Traveler
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Evolution:
Yog-Sothoth, Lord Of Spacetime.
Passives:
[True] Time Leap: Periodically snapshots player coordinates and status data. Upon taking fatal death damage, rewinds you safely to the last save point. (10 min CD)

Active Skills:
[Press] Reverse Fate: Requires Mastery/Learning. Snapshots everything within 60 blocks. Secondary cast restores the field state. (5 min CD)
[In-Slot] Further Fate: Defeat by entities wielding Absolute Severance, Infinity Prison, Usurper, or Uriel grants a random acquisition chance, provided Time Leap rolls to save you.

title: Traveler
text:
Description:
Move through space, open gates, warp projectiles, and attack with stardust.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll or from Mai Furuki.
Passives:
[Toggle] Spatial Manipulation: Doubles Spatial Damage. While in-slot, non-Magic projectiles warp behind the viewed target (50 MP). Sneak to prevent warp.
Active Skills:
[Press] Instant Motion: Teleports to viewed position within 200 blocks (5 MP/block). (5s CD).
[Press] Teleport: Opens Spatial GUI. Instant travel costs 5 MP/block, portals cost 25 MP/block.
[Press] Stardust Arrow: Requires Learning. Fires energy arrow dealing 30 DMG and Severance. Costs 100 MP/AP.
[Press] Stardust Rain: Mastery. Drops 10-12 arrows in a 20-block sphere. Costs 5,000 MP/AP.

title: Tuner
text:
Description:
Change fate to survive fatal blows and gain emergency power when near death.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[True] Destiny Change: Fatal damage instead fully restores HP, removes negative effects, and restores MP/AP to 50% (75% mastered). Works once per damage type every 20-minute cycle. Cooldown resets specific damage types.
[In Slot] Unexpected Result: Toggle with Mastery. Below 25% HP, grants Strength X, +0.2 Attack Speed, +0.04 Movement Speed, +1 Swim Speed, and 15% physical auto-dodge. Mastery doubles all bonuses.

title: Unyielding
text:
Description:
Draw strength from loyal allies and survive by transferring into a prepared backup body.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[True] Unyield: Named subordinates within 30 blocks gain 1 Unyielding Point every 5s (2 mastered). When they die (to non-owners), user gains 10% of their EP per 120 points (up to 100%). At 120 points, gain their Skills/Magic (Unique requires 600 points).
Active Skills:
[Press] Backup: Spends 25% max MP to create an immobile backup body. Reactivation moves soul to backup, leaves a new body at old spot, and swaps gear. Fatal damage auto-transfers to backup. Cross-dimensional transfer requires Mastery.

title: Usurper
text:
Description:
Seize enemy energy, steal or copy abilities, and take control of summons.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll or from Hinata Sakaguchi.
Passives:
[In Slot] Usurper: Attacks have a 50% chance to steal 1% of the target's MP and restore the user's spent MP.
Active Skills:
[Press] Rob: Steals Common/Extra/Aspectual Magic from higher EP targets. Success: 25% (50% mastered). Costs 1,000 MP. (10s CD).
[Press] Copy: Copies Common/Extra/Intrinsic/Aspectual Magic. Success: 25% (50% mastered). Costs 1,000 MP. (10s CD).
[Press] Force Takeover: Requires Mastery. Robs a weaker target with 100% success. Can steal summons if owner has <=75% user's EP. Costs 5,000 MP.

title: Vainglory
text:
Description:
Rule an army of preserved shadows, merge with their power, and rewrite your own death.
How to Obtain:
from mastering Plunderer and Shadow Motion.
Passives:
[Toggle] Soulscape: Kills leave a soul for 30s to be converted into Shadow Warriors.
[True] Essence of Eclipse: Warriors gain damage/speed at night, and Armor/Toughness during day.
[In Slot] Rewrite Fate: Fatal damage is negated by consuming 25% (20% mastered) current MP and teleporting beside the attacker.
Active Skills:
[Press] Shadow Warrior: Converts lingering soul into loyal subordinate. Costs current MP equal to target's former EP.
[Press] Shadow Storage: Stores subordinate as an item.
[Press] Shadow Merge: Merges with a Shadow Warrior, adding its stats/max EP to user. Dying while merged destroys it.

title: Victorious Harbinger
text:
Description:
Overwhelm enemies through courage, relentless attacks, and an aura that announces victory.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[True] Courage of the Strong: Grants immunity to psychological effects, including Fear and Charm.
[Toggle] Relentless Barrage: Increases attack speed by 10%.
Active Skills:
[Hold] Might: Emits aura applying Fear for 10s to enemies within 10 blocks. Costs 2,000 MP/s.
[Press] Tenacious Resolve: Reduces the duration and level of negative effects caused by other entities (excluding effects already blocked by Courage of the Strong). Costs 500 MP. (60s CD).

title: Villain
text:
Description:
Embody malice, gain greater power from kills, manipulate neutral creatures, and empower allies.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[True] Villain: Dying from Magicule Poisoning offers option to become a Majin.
[Toggle] Villain: Raises EP gained from kills to 6%, grants 25% dodge negation. Mastery grants Haki Coat per tick.
[In Slot] Villain's Intimidation: User/allies gain 50% crit chance and 10% auto-dodge.
Active Skills:
[Press] Villain's Charisma: Neutral/Passive mobs within 20 blocks become allies for 120s. Costs 200 MP.
[Hold] Demon Lord's Haki: Mobs within 30 blocks with <75% of user's EP gain 2 Fear levels per 20% EP diff. Costs 50 MP per 20 ticks.

title: Witch's Envy
text:
Description:
 WIP
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll.
Passives:
[True] Witch’s Gaze: Protected skill node; cannot be duplicated or copied.

[True] Return By Death: Bypasses physical deaths and execution spells via a 1HP pseudo-regen lock. Respawns you at your last bed savepoint, subtracting the EP difference while keeping skills.
[Toggle] Learning By Death: Grants +5 Learn and Mastery points each time you die (capped at 20).

[In-Slot] Witch’s Curse: Attackers gain a stack of Curse every time they kill you (Cap: 5 / 10 mastered). Mastery gives a 10% chance to apply stacks on standard damage frames.
Active Skills:
[Press] Witch’s Wrath: Detonates Curse stacks on a target. Each stack inflicts 10 (25 mastered) Corrosion and Spiritual damage.

[In-Slot] Envious Life: Permanently maps and copies Common, Extra, or Sin Factor skills by executing their original wielder.

title: Wrath
text:
Description:
Generate energy through rage and grow stronger as Rampage builds, while risking escalating drawbacks.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll or from Milim TR:nightmare.
Active Skills:
[Hold] Breeder Reactor: Toggle Mastered. Restores 2% max MP every 5s. 3% chance per use to add 1 Rampage level for 30s (7% if above natural max MP). Hits add 3s duration.
Breeder Reactor (Cont.): Rampage caps at lvl 10 (20 mastered). Each level grants 5 Armor, 30 Attack, +0.02 Atk Spd, +0.01 Spd, +0.01 Swim, and +0.1 KB Resist.
[Hold] Enrage: Gives mobs within 15 blocks 1 Rampage level every 10s. Costs 100 MP/s.

title: Zekrom
text:
Description:
Command destructive lightning and draconic energy, with added power when paired with Reshiram.
How to Obtain:
Reincarnation/Skill Reroll or you must have either [Reshiram] or [Kyurem]. Additionally, you need at least 100k EP, eat 10 lightning essences, and eat 10 dragon essences..
Passives:
[Toggle] Teravolt: Doubles all Lightning damage (stacks with Lightning Domination).
Active Skills:
[Press] Bolt Strike: Summons lightning dealing 50 Electricity & 50 Physical DMG. (10s CD, 5s mastered)
[Hold] Fusion Bolt: Charges target for 30 Physical & 30 Electricity DMG (500 MP). Adds 40 Flame DMG with Reshiram in-slot.
[Hold] Draconic Breath: Breathes purple flame dealing 60 Magic Damage and Paralysis. Costs 240 MP/s.
[Press] Thunderbolt: Summons lightning at viewed location dealing 60 Electricity Damage. Costs 250 MP.

title: Compétence : Fusion Art
text: Allows Gobta to fuse with a Direwolf or Ranga (the fusion target must have over 1M ep)

title: Compétence : Lord of Magewolves
text: Allows one to summon and buff surrounding Direwolves.

title: Race : Half Godling
text: A fledgling being touched by divine essence — not yet a god, but no longer mere mortal. The Half Godling stands at the threshold between worlds, carrying a spark of primordial light that yearns to grow.

title: Race : Demi Godling
text: The spark within begins to kindle. The Demi Godling sheds mortal frailty and steps further from the mundane, drawing power from the edges of the divine. The heavens take notice.

title: Race : Prime Godling
text: A newborn deity awakens — a being born from the weave of primordial light and will unshaped by fate. The Prime Godling gazes upon a world of limitless possibility, its soul carrying the echo of creation itself.

title: Race : Celestial Godling
text: The godling's mortal shell has been cast aside. What remains is pure celestial essence — a being woven from star-stuff and the first breath of the cosmos. The heavens themselves grow silent in recognition.

title: Race : Ecliptic Godling
text: Twilight bends to the Ecliptic Godling's will. Neither light nor dark may claim dominion where one who walks the ecliptic stands. The boundary between day and night becomes a threshold, not a barrier.

title: Race : New God
text: Radiance given form. The New God burns with an inner sun that illuminates the unseen truths of existence. At this height, the veil between the mortal and the divine grows thin enough to step through.

title: Race : Primordial Supreme God
text: The journey ends where it began — at the source of all things. The Primordial Supreme God is no longer a being who wields power; it has become the hand that writes what power is. Existence bends, and does not break.

title: Compétence : Primordial Bloom
text: Passively regenerates magicules. Periodically spawns blooming particles. Mastery: also grants Regeneration to nearby players.

title: Compétence : Cosmic Awareness
text: Toggle: grants presence sense, detects invisible entities, and marks entities that target the bearer. Drains energy while active.

title: Compétence : Stellar Ascension
text: Toggle: boosts attack damage and maximum health with a celestial particle aura. Deals bonus magic damage on attack. Mastery: slow falling while falling.

title: Compétence : Ecliptic Mastery
text: Passively grants bonus armor and toughness. Reflects damage back to attackers and has a chance to negate incoming damage. Mastery doubles the effect.

title: Compétence : Luminarch Blessing
text: Toggle: grants Regeneration, Absorption, and highlights all living entities within 24 blocks through walls (Glowing). Mastery: 48-block range and heals nearby allies.

title: Compétence : Primordial Fortitude
text: Bestows overwhelming divine fortitude, boosting all core attributes. Grants Fire Resistance, Water Breathing, fall damage immunity, and 55-65% damage reduction. Greatly accelerates skill learning.

title: Compétence : Creation Authority
text: Ultimate Skill. Passively grants +6 Attack, +16 HP, +4 Armor, +4 Toughness. Press to call down primordial lightning that devastates the target area with a massive explosion. Grants brief damage immunity after activation. High energy cost.

title: Compétence : Divine Devour
text: Unique Skill. Press the skill key while looking at a mob to attempt to steal one of its skills. 10% chance per use. Cooldown: 10 ticks (0.5s) / 5 ticks mastered (0.25s).

title: Compétence : Divine Disruption
text: Unique Skill. Press and hold to nullify all magicules within 15 blocks, disabling enemy skills. Costs 10% magicules on activation and 5% per 10 ticks. Mastered: 5% activation, 2% per 10 ticks.

title: Compétence : Blacksmith
text: Opens a smithing bench.

title: Compétence : Keen Nose
text: Detects nearby valuables or rare materials.

title: Compétence : Beast Recall
text: A brief reawakening of the old beast instincts once lost to degeneration.

title: Compétence : Imitator
text: It allows the user to use the unique skills of bosses and otherworlders they have killed.

title: Race : Kobold
text: A race of bestial demi-humans originating from degenerated Lycanthropes. Kobolds are intelligent but lack significant fighting capabilities. They lead nomadic lifestyles as merchants, traveling through demon lord territories and trading with various races.

title: Race : Wispfolk
text: Born from the whispers of the forest and the lingering spirits of those long gone, Wispfolk are small, glowing demi-humans. Wispfolk move swiftly, gathering resources and tending to their realms.

title: Race : Gale Wisp
text: An evolved Wispfolk with enhanced speed and magical potential. Gale Wisps harness the wind and possess a stronger connection to spiritual energy.

title: Race : Zephyr Wisp
text: A master of wind and spiritual energy, Zephyr Wisps are formidable in both agility and magical power.

title: Race : Divine Wisp
text: The pinnacle of Wisp evolution, Divine Wisps are both spiritual and divine beings.

title: Race : Mystic Fox
text: Are an elusive race of demi-spiritual monsters born from the residual magicules of the World Destroying Dragon, Ivaragé. As a subspecies of Cryptids, they embody the elegance of spiritual beings and the primal cunning of magical beasts.

title: Race : Greater Giant
text: An evolved Giant whose immense body has begun accumulating the power of an ancient titan.

title: Race : Titan
text: A colossal existence that has surpassed the limits of Ancient Giants and awakened the power of Titanification.

title: Race : Divine Giant / Géant Divin
text:
A godly race born from the earth itself, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.
(FR) Une race divine née de la Terre elle-même, il possède un corps physique immortel qui ne vieillira jamais.

title: Compétence : Seismic Stomp
text: Stomp the ground to unleash a powerful shockwave that damages, slows, and knocks back nearby enemies. Mastery increases its range, reduces its cost and cooldown, and extends its slowing effect.

title: Compétence : Inheritor
text: Records eligible abilities from defeated entities. Activate Inheritor to open the Inheritance Archive and attempt to copy one ability from a recorded kill. Copying has a 25% success chance, increased to 50% when mastered.

title: Race : Chimeran
text: An unstable composite lifeform whose body contains the traits and evolutionary potential of numerous monster species.

title: Race : Feral Chimeran
text: A Chimeran that embraced its predatory instincts, developing heightened senses, speed and overwhelming physical aggression.

title: Race : Carapace Chimeran
text: A heavily protected Chimeran whose body formed dense natural armour and exceptional physical resilience.

title: Race : Mystic Chimeran
text: A magically developed Chimeran whose composite body channels immense magicule and spiritual power.

title: Race : Adaptive Chimeran
text: A versatile Chimeran capable of rapidly adjusting its senses, movement and physiology to unfamiliar environments.

title: Race : Predator Chimera
text: A highly evolved hunter whose senses, speed and physical strength are specialised for pursuing and overpowering powerful prey.

title: Race : Venom Chimera
text: A toxic Chimeran that produces deadly poisons and releases them through its breath, blood and predatory attacks.

title: Race : Adamant Chimera
text: A fortress-like Chimera whose extraordinarily dense armour and reinforced body can endure devastating physical attacks.

title: Race : Regenerator Chimera
text: A remarkably resilient Chimera whose highly evolved biology rapidly repairs even severe bodily damage.

title: Race : Ether Chimera
text: A highly magical Chimera whose mind and body have adapted to manipulate vast concentrations of magicules.

title: Race : Soul Chimera
text: A spiritually awakened Chimera whose composite soul has stabilised into a powerful and resilient existence.

title: Race : Sky Chimera
text: An aerial Chimera whose lightweight body, magical flight and command of wind allow it to dominate the skies.

title: Race : Abyss Chimera
text: A deep-sea Chimera adapted to immense pressure, unrestricted underwater movement and the manipulation of water.

title: Race : Apex Chimera
text: A supreme predator whose enhanced senses, speed and strength allow it to hunt even calamity-class prey.

title: Race : Plague Chimera
text: A virulent Chimera whose body produces corrosive toxins capable of poisoning entire battlefields.

title: Race : Siege Chimera
text: A living fortress whose immense carapace and layered barriers can withstand prolonged attacks from entire armies.

title: Race : Undying Chimera
text: A relentlessly regenerating Chimera capable of recovering from wounds that would destroy lesser lifeforms.

title: Race : Arcane Chimera
text: A living magical phenomenon capable of manipulating immense magicule reserves with exceptional speed and precision.

title: Race : Astral Chimera
text: A spiritually transcendent Chimera whose soul can reach beyond the limits of its physical body.

title: Race : Tempest Chimera
text: A sovereign of the skies whose wings and magicules command wind, lightning and violent weather.

title: Race : Leviathan Chimera
text: A colossal oceanic Chimera protected by immense scales and capable of dominating the waters around it.

title: Race : Calamity Chimera
text: A calamity-class Chimera that combines supreme predatory power with corrosive toxins capable of devastating entire battlefields.

title: Race : Eternal Colossus
text: A colossal living fortress that combines impenetrable natural defences with regeneration powerful enough to restore even catastrophic damage.

title: Race : Empyrean Chimera
text: A transcendent Chimera whose immense magical power and perfected spiritual body allow it to influence the laws governing the world.

title: Race : Primordial Chimera
text: A primordial Chimera that rules both sea and sky, commanding violent weather and the ancient power of the world's oceans.

title: Race : Chimera Overlord
text: The supreme ruler of Chimeran life, possessing overwhelming predatory power, deadly adaptations and an aura capable of subjugating lesser beings.

title: Race : Eternal Behemoth
text: An immortal behemoth whose colossal body, limitless regeneration and absolute physical defences allow it to withstand almost any attack.

title: Race : Astral Archon
text: A supreme spiritual existence whose transcendent senses and command of space allow it to observe and influence the world from beyond the physical plane.

title: Race : Tempest Leviathan
text: A supreme primordial beast that commands oceans, storms, wind and lightning as extensions of its colossal body.

title: Compétence : Composite Body
text: Reconfigures the Chimeran body into specialised aspects suited to combat, defence, magic, and environmental adaptation.

title: Compétence : Sovereign Haki
text: The Haki of a True Sovereign. Its unshaken will resists mental interference, its balanced existence strengthens recovery and defence, and its released pressure suppresses hostile power.

title: Compétence : Fortune
text: Draw an eligible ability from the world's possibilities. Owned but unmastered abilities are mastered instead. Mastery improves the odds of receiving rarer abilities and reduces the Magicule cost.

title: Compétence : Indomitable
text: Converts desperation into strength. While active, increasingly improves physical attack damage, damage resistance, movement speed, and knockback resistance as the user's health falls.

title: Compétence : Last Word
text: Marks the first hostile creature to harm the user. Personally defeating the marked target before time expires restores health and magicules.

title: Compétence : Singularity
text: Creates a gravitational anomaly at the targeted location, drawing hostile creatures inward before collapsing in a devastating magical implosion.

title: Compétence : Edict
text: Imposes one of three sovereign commands upon a targeted enemy: Halt, Silence, or Submit.

title: Compétence : Sovereign Exchange
text: Sacrifice a portion of one attribute to permanently empower another. The exchange can be reconfigured by activating the skill.

title: Compétence : Counterfeit
text: Temporarily reproduces an eligible ability possessed by the targeted existence. Mastery permits deliberate selection and extends the copied ability's duration.

title: Compétence : Horizon Walker
text: Creates a pair of linked horizons through which living beings may travel in either direction.

title: Compétence : Storyteller
text: Records feats as Story Parts that can be placed within an enchanted Story Book. While Storyteller remains toggled on, equipped pages alter the course of the user's tale.

title: Compétence : Void Lance
text: Condense spiritual void energy into a piercing lance that passes through multiple enemies.

title: Compétence : Void Step
text: Slip through the void to instantly traverse a short distance without passing through solid barriers.

title: Compétence : Void Mantle
text: Wrap yourself in spiritual void energy to temporarily reduce incoming damage.

title: Compétence : Void Severance
text: Tear open a wide spatial fracture that cuts through every enemy in its path.

title: Compétence : Timeless Mage
text: Ultimate awakening of Great Mage. Auto-learns and masters every aspectual and spirit magic; passive chant annulment. Toggle: +29 mastery gain, perfect Analytical Appraisal, magic bypasses resistances, and grants creative flight that Magic Jamming cannot interrupt. Modes: Create Tome / Zoltraak / Magic Dominate.

title: Compétence : Magicule Attunement
text: Toggle: +5% magicule regen (+10% mastered). Masters slowly while toggled on. Auto-learned once Energy Charge is mastered and Haki is acquired.

title: Compétence : Magicule Resonance
text: Toggle: +10% magicule regen (+20% mastered). Auto-learned once Magicule Attunement is mastered.

title: Compétence : Magicule Dominion
text: Toggle: +25% magicule regen (+50% mastered). Auto-learned once Magicule Resonance is mastered.

title: Compétence : Magnetized Vacuum
text: Active: pull nearby items and XP orbs to you within 8 blocks for 5s (12 blocks / 10s mastered). Costs 2000 magicule (1000 mastered). 20s cooldown (10s mastered). Obtained by using a plunderer skill on an Iron Golem.

title: Compétence : Magicule Nourishment
text: Press: refill hunger and grant saturation for 15% of max magicule (7.5% mastered). 10s cooldown (5s mastered).

title: Race : Angel
text: A winged being of holy light. The first step on the angelic path.

title: Race : Archangel
text: A higher angel commanding sacred aura and divine ki.

title: Race : Seraphim
text: The peak of angelic existence. Branches into Divine Angel (true hero) or Fallen Angel (consume 10 daemon essences).

title: Race : Divine Angel
text: A Seraphim who walked the hero's path and ascended to true divinity.

title: Race : Fallen Angel
text: A Seraphim who consumed daemonic remains and fell into corruption. Alignment shifts to Majin.

title: Race : Cosmic Deity
text: A Divine Angel ascended past divinity itself, governing the fabric of the cosmos.

title: Race : Chaotic Deity
text: A Fallen Angel ascended into a force of primordial chaos.

title: Race : Frog
text: A small amphibian with a knack for water and poison. The first step.

title: Race : Giant Frog
text: A frog grown massive — pure physical force.

title: Race : Poison Toad
text: A toad whose body secretes lethal venom.

title: Race : Swamp Sovereign
text: Ruler of the wetlands, master of water and miasma.

title: Race : Bog Ancient
text: A Named Swamp Sovereign of immense age, in tune with the earth itself.

title: Race : Venom Lord
text: A Swamp Sovereign awakened as a True Demon Lord — corruption made flesh.

title: Race : Frog Monarch
text: The pinnacle of frogkind. Combines the wisdom of the bog with the corruption of venom.

title: Race : Kitsune
text: A Named beastfolk fox spirit awakened to mystical potential.

title: Race : 3 Tailed Fox
text: A Kitsune whose power has bloomed into three tails.

title: Race : 6 Tailed Fox
text: A fox spirit of six tails, brimming with spiritual force.

title: Race : 9 Tailed Fox
text: The legendary nine-tailed fox — a true hero of fox-kind.

title: Race : Divine Kitsune
text: An Inari-tier celestial fox transcending the count of tails. Gains Mana Manipulation.

title: Race : Fledgling Bloodfiend
text: A newly turned bloodfiend, still raw and hungry.

title: Race : Kindred Bloodfiend
text: A bloodfiend who has come into their kin and their craft.

title: Race : Blood Noble
text: An aristocrat of blood and shadow — charming, near-impervious, master of the night.

title: Race : Elder Bloodfiend
text: An ancient predator who moves between shadows like a wraith.

title: Race : Progenitor Bloodfiend
text: The first and most terrible of all bloodfiends — its will rewrites the laws of death.

title: Race : Whisper Djinn
text: A newborn djinn of small stature and great magical potential.

title: Race : Trickster Djinn
text: A djinn who has mastered misdirection and trickery.

title: Race : Phantom Djinn
text: A djinn shed of corporeal limits — a phantom of flickering presence.

title: Race : Royal Djinn
text: A noble djinn blessed with divine ki.

title: Race : Wishbound Djinn
text: A djinn whose power rivals myth, bound only by the wishes they grant.

title: Race : Primordial Djinn
text: An original djinn from before civilization. Their presence alone breaks lesser wills.

title: Race : Ascended Djinn
text: A djinn crossed into divinity, commanding the laws of the world.

title: Race : Sovereign Djinn
text: Sovereign of all djinnkind, wreathed in dread majesty.

title: Race : Infinite Djinn
text: A djinn fused with element, daemon, and dragon essences. Power without ceiling.

title: Race : Omniversal Djinn
text: The pinnacle of djinn existence — authority that permeates every layer of reality.

title: Race : Cursed Mariner
text: A Wight who gave their soul to the cursed sea. Deathless and waterborne.

title: Race : Cursed Dreadnaught
text: A Cursed Mariner hardened by battle. Commands the storm and fractures into shadow.

title: Race : Phantom Corsair
text: A dread pirate dissolved into spectral darkness — slips through walls and commands the deep.

title: Race : Davy Jones
text: Lord of the deep. A True Demon Lord whose will reshapes the ocean.

title: Race : Gazer
text: A floating majin of countless eyes, born from the void.

title: Race : Spectator
text: A Gazer with sharper sight — pierces all falsehood.

title: Race : Mindwitness
text: A Spectator that fuses perception with domination.

title: Race : Gauth
text: A lesser beholder of armored body and unraveling eyestalks.

title: Race : Beholder
text: Apex of the aberrant lineage. Central eye negates magic; stalks rain devastation.

title: Race : Death Tyrant
text: A Beholder who transcended death itself — sovereign of life and void.

title: Race : Monkey
text: A clever, nimble beast brimming with potential.

title: Race : Monkey Warrior
text: A monkey hardened through battle into raw physical strength.

title: Race : Monkey Martial Artist
text: A master of unarmed combat, body forged into a weapon.

title: Race : Monkey King
text: A sovereign of beasts, claimed via Royal Blood.

title: Race : Divine King
text: A Monkey King who crossed into divinity.

title: Race : Sun Wukong
text: The Great Sage Equal to Heaven. Reshapes the laws of the world.

title: Race : Zombie
text: A risen corpse — entry to the Undead chain, branching off the Wight race. Pain Resistance and Majin alignment, but burns and weakens in sunlight.

title: Race : Skeleton
text: Bones bound by death. Faster, immune to pain/poison/pierce/paralysis. No need for food. Still burns in sunlight; splits next into Warrior or Mage.

title: Race : Skeleton Warrior
text: A skeleton tempered for war. Strengthen Body, Corrosion, Self Regen. No longer burns in sunlight.

title: Race : Death Knight
text: Armored death given purpose. Magic Resistance and command of Lesser Undead.

title: Race : Dullahan
text: The headless rider. Physical Attack Nullification and a spectral Skeleton Horse.

title: Race : Dark Lord Dullahan
text: Apex of the warrior path. Mortal Fear, Majesty, and a Multilayer Barrier wreathe the throneless king.

title: Race : Mage Skeleton
text: A skeleton schooled in arcane sciences. Magic Resistance, Thought Acceleration, Magic Sense, all four elemental Manipulations.

title: Race : Elder Lich
text: A skeletal sage of long centuries. Sage skill at Lich-tier mastery.

title: Race : Lich
text: A true necromancer. Spatial Manipulation and Magic Darkness Transform unlock.

title: Race : Lich King
text: Apex of the mage path. Spatial Domination, All-Seeing Eye, Mortal Fear and Majesty.

title: Race : Ender Dragonewt
text: A Dragonewt forever altered by the End — scales drink darkness, eyes burn ender flame.

title: Race : Void Dragonewt
