text: A dragonewt flickering between presence and void. Bends space and gravity.

title: Race : Abyssal Dragonewt
text: Half dragon, half dimensional horror. Their colossal frame tears space.

title: Race : Chaos Dragon
text: Sovereign of the void. Reality bends around their presence.

title: Race : Corrupted Dragonkin
text: A Dragonewt touched by the first whisper of demonic corruption.

title: Race : Corrupted Dragon
text: Corruption blossomed into full draconic form. Shadow magic flows in its veins.

title: Race : Cursed Dragon
text: A Named Corrupted Dragon — its breath is black flame that scorches flesh and soul.

title: Race : Demonic Dragon
text: A Cursed Dragon awakened as a True Demon Lord. Wields darkness absolutely.

title: Race : Demon Dragon God
text: Apex of draconic corruption — a god of shadow and flame.

title: Compétence : Sharpened Claws
text: Unarmed melee deals 10 damage (15 mastered).

title: Compétence : Great Mage
text: Toggle: +19% learning/mastery rate for all skills, plus Chant Annulment for mastered magic. Modes: Magic Chant (learn new magic for XP), Study (steal a skill from a target's mind), Create Tome (turn a learned magic into a tome book).

title: Compétence : Angel Wings
text: Toggle: glide through the air like an elytra without wings equipped.

title: Compétence : Magic Scribe
text: Press: inscribe a random spell scroll. Level 1 on a 5min cooldown (random level / 2min mastered).

title: Compétence : Eye of Mind
text: Toggle: 10x learning/mastery rate. Modes: Analytical Appraisal (read the battlefield), Analysis (steal a skill from an enemy), Detrimental Gaze (inflict crippling status), Ray of Death (black beam draining a fraction of target HP per second).

title: Compétence : Blood Frenzy
text: Toggle: bloodlust state — boosts attack damage and speed, drains your HP per second. Killing blows steal a portion of the victim's max HP back.

title: Compétence : Intimidating Roar
text: Active: roar to inflict Fear and Weakness on all enemies within 8 blocks for 6s (10s mastered). 20s cooldown.

title: Compétence : Toxic Skin
text: Toggle: melee attackers are poisoned for 5s (10s mastered, stronger).

title: Compétence : Energy Charge
text: Hold: regen 5% max magicule/s (7% mastered) at the cost of 1% max aura/s. Auto-learned at 25,000 EP.

title: Compétence : Maximum Charge
text: Hold: regen 10% max magicule/s (15% mastered) at the cost of 2% max aura/s. Auto-learned at 100,000 EP once Energy Charge is mastered.

title: Compétence : King of Curses
text: Toggle: +15% melee damage and Reverse Cursed Technique (1 HP/2s, 1 HP/s mastered) at the cost of 0.2% max aura/s. Modes: Dismantle (ranged single-target slash), Cleave (radial slash ring), Fuga (massive flame explosion), Malevolent Shrine (15-block / 10s aura-slash domain — 20-block / 15s mastered).

title: Compétence : Bubble Majin
text: Passive: +10% magicule regen. Toggle: reflect projectiles back at their source. Modes: Storage (pocket dimension, 81 stacks), Candy Beam (turn a non-player at least 1.5x weaker than you into edible candy that passes their EP and skills to whoever eats it), Regeneration (full HP for 5% max aura).

title: Compétence : Sealer
text: Toggle: +100 max spiritual HP. Modes: Seal (trap a non-player at least 1.5x weaker than you into a stone — 30s, 20s mastered), Suppress (bank 20% of your max EP into a stone for later — 30s, 20s mastered), Stored Strength (+0.2 attack damage per use, +0.3 mastered, capped at +20, lost on death — 20s, 10s mastered).

title: Compétence : Blood Resistance
text: Reduces damage from blood-attribute attacks. Evolves into Blood Nullification with enough use.

title: Compétence : Blood Nullification
text: Negates all blood-attribute damage.

title: Compétence : Blood Manipulation
text: Toggle: +20% outgoing blood damage (+40% mastered). Masters slowly while toggled on.

title: Compétence : Blood Domination
text: Toggle: +60% outgoing blood damage (+100% mastered). Evolved form of Blood Manipulation.

title: Compétence : Blockade
text: Active: apply Regeneration Suppression to the target you're looking at (≤ 16 blocks) for 10s (20s mastered), force-disabling Self / Ultraspeed / Infinite Regeneration. CD 30s. Auto-learned when Magic Jamming is mastered and you've slain 30 Vexes.

title: Compétence : Blood Blade
text: Active: fire a crimson blade for 10 blood-attribute damage. Costs 1 HP — pays in blood, not magicule.

title: Compétence : Dragon Slayer
text: Toggle: dragons treat you as neutral; your Ice/Fire/Thunder Breath bypass resistances. Grants Ice/Fire/Thunder Breath and Dragon Skin/Ear/Eye automatically. Eating a Dragon Essence permanently adds +20 max HP (uncapped, reset on death). Modes: Dragon Infusion (consume a Dragon Heart in hand for +20,000 EP), Dragon Rage (Strength X for 30s, 60s cooldown).

title: Compétence : Deus Sanguis
text: Toggle: at night, gain Strength III, Speed II, Haste II. Toggle: melee hits inflict Bleeding 6 for 4s (Bleeding 10 mastered). Modes: Bite (Paralysis IV / Blindness IV / Darkness IV + 20 blood damage on the target you're looking at, 25 mastered, 3s CD), Shift (toggle to half-size with 50% max HP and creative flight, 20s/10s CD), Health Drain (held: drain 10% / 20% of nearby enemies' current HP per second as blood damage in 6 blocks, 30s/10s CD).

title: Compétence : Imprisoned Jester
text: Equipped: +20% physical and magic damage, +10% crit (+10% physical / +10% crit mastered). Toggle: reflect 25% of incoming physical damage. Forces your alignment to Chaos. Modes: Chaos Spades (white-flame Soul-damage breath scaling with EP, capped at 10M EP), Explosive Goodbye (below 25% HP, detonate for missing-HP damage to nearby enemies' HP and SHP — kills you).

title: Compétence : Hell Passage
text: Active: open a Hell Portal in front of you. Costs 10%% current MP. CD 30s (10s mastered). Auto-learned once Gate is mastered and 30 Daemon Essences are consumed from your inventory.

title: Compétence : Image Training
text: Active: summon a shadowy training clone in front of you. Idle until hit; once provoked, fights back with melee that bypasses ALL resistances and nullifications. Killing the clone grants 10%% of your current EP as bonus. Costs 50%% current aura and 50%% current MP. CD 5 min. Lifespan 2 min. One clone at a time.

title: Compétence : Hyperbolic Passage
text: Active: open a white Hyperbolic Portal leading to the Hyperbolic Chamber. Costs 10%% current MP. CD 30s (10s mastered). Auto-learned once Gate AND Sacred Haki are both mastered.

title: Compétence : Trash Gamer
text: Equipped: +4 to every mastery point gained on every skill. Modes: Duplication Glitch (dupe held item, costs 50%% current MP, 600s CD; 25%% MP mastered), Buff Glitch (random positive effect for 3 min at level 1–10, 60s CD; 10s mastered), Prodigy (10 min: 1 HP, +99%% dodge, +20%% speed, ×5 outgoing damage to bypass resistances; on end: paralysis 10 for 3 min and full aura/MP drain).

title: Compétence : Prickly Hands
text: Toggle: melee hits inflict Bleeding (tier 1, tier 2 mastered). Direct contact only.

title: Compétence : Purple Lightning
text: Active: call down corrupted purple lightning. Darkness-flavoured damage that bypasses Darkness Attack Nullification. Radius and damage scale with mastery. Intrinsic to Demonic Dragon.

title: Compétence : The One Who Seals
text: Ultimate awakening of Sealer. Passive: every kill grants +0.5 Max Spiritual HP, capped at +20,000. Modes: Seal (capture mob into stone if 1.5x stronger), Suppress (seal 20% of self or sneak-target's Max EP into a stone), Enough is Enough (steal a random skill — excluding ultimates / magics / battlewills — into a redeemable stone). All produced stones land in your inventory.

title: Compétence : The Slayer of Dragons
text: Ultimate awakening of Dragon Slayer. Toggle on for: peace with all dragons; ice/fire/thunder breath bypass resistances; +30 Max HP per dragon essence or Ice&Fire flesh eaten (no cap, removed on death); each dragon kill permanently grants +50,000 Max EP and +1 armor. Modes: Dragon Infusion (consume held Dragon Heart for +40k/+50k EP), Draconic Rage (5 min of Strength XX + Strengthen V + Resistance III), Dragon King Roar (held — fires Ice + Flame + Thunder breaths simultaneously).

title: Compétence : The Evil Majin
text: Ultimate awakening of Bubble Majin. Toggle: full HP heal every 10s, cleanse all negative effects every 5s, reflect basic projectiles. Modes: Storage, Candy for me! (12-block AOE — turns every entity you're 2x stronger than (5x for bosses) into a single merged Majin Candy that lands in your inventory; copies all skills except ultimates), Hunger (held — pink Gluttony-style predation mist, no corrosion DOT, cost-free).

title: Compétence : The Unbound Jester
text: Ultimate awakening of Imprisoned Jester. In-slot: +50%% physical/magic damage, +30%% crit chance for +100%% crit. Toggle: 25%% reflect on all incoming damage; The Bit Goes On — fatal hits become 5s of invulnerable invisibility instead of death (5min CD, drains pools to 5%%). Modes: Chaos Theater (360° AOE, hits HP+SHP, 16-block radius), Curtain Call (current-HP AOE, 16-block radius, hits HP+SHP), Final Punishment (mark target with Sentence — 5%% max HP/sec for 10s, on death absorbs 25%% EP).

title: Compétence : Example Ultimate
text: This is a description for the ultimate skill. Edit this description using the en_us.json file.

title: Compétence : Example Common
text: This is a description for the common skill. Edit this description using the en_us.json file.

title: Compétence : Example Unique
text: This is a description for the unique skill. Edit this description using the en_us.json file.

title: Compétence : Example Intrinsic
text: This is a description for the intrinsic skill. Edit this description using the en_us.json file.

title: Compétence : Scavenger
text: A keen eye for treasure. Passively grants Luck II, improving loot from chests, mob drops, and mining. Mastery unlocks a toggle that upgrades the buff to Luck III.

title: Compétence : Ancient Soul
text: A primordial soul that resonates with nearby life. While toggled on, grants the holder and nearby allies Strength III, Regeneration III, and Resistance I, while Soul Sight outlines surrounding creatures by alignment — red for enemies, green for allies, cyan for the unaffiliated. Drains a trickle of magicule while active.

title: Compétence : Runesmith's Insight
text: Hard-won intuition at the forge. Passively widens the hammer sweet spot and slows temperature drift during forge minigames. When mastered, each forged item has a chance to gain an extra enhancement slot. Learned automatically through repeated successful forging.

title: Compétence : Gravity Well
text: Gravity magic. Hold to warp space at the point you are aiming at, then release to collapse it into a crushing sphere that drags everything inside toward its centre, deals a fraction of each victim's max health every second, and smothers flight and dash escapes. When mastered, hold past the cast time to charge a wider, longer, harder-crushing well. Requires Burden mastered to learn.

title: Compétence : Kamehameha
text: Energy magic. Hold to gather magicule into a glowing sphere, then release to fire a sustained blue-white energy wave that tracks your aim, searing everything in its path and exploding against terrain. When mastered, hold past the cast time to charge a wider, far more destructive wave.

title: Compétence : Static Chain
text: Lightning magic. Loose an arc at the target you are looking at; it leaps to nearby foes, dealing less damage with each jump and leaving them Glowing and slowed. When mastered, hold past the cast time to charge a longer, harder-hitting chain that arcs through more targets. Requires Thunder mastered to learn.

title: Compétence : Mediation
text: Helps regenerate Aura, Magic, and SHP faster when toggled

title: Compétence : Kaioken
text: A body-burning Saiyan battle-aura. Multiply your power far past its limit in a crimson blaze — the higher the multiplier, the fiercer the strain on your body. Stronger tiers unlock as your EP grows and the technique is mastered.

title: Compétence : Basilisk Skin
text: Transforms your skin into one of a Basilisk scales which become tougher as you gain more EP(Cap however easter egg)

title: Compétence : Ouroboros, Lord of Eternity
text: The serpent that devours its own tail. Feed on the fight, strike across seconds, shed what wounds you, rewind your missteps, complete death rather than avoid it, and devour what stands before you.

title: Compétence : Hephaestus, Lord of Creation
text: The forge answers its lord. Repair and reforge what exists, engrave it, conjure arms from nothing, sense the ore beneath stone, and turn a smith's mastery into a weapon.

title: Compétence : Gaia, Lord of Earth
text: The land itself answers. Raise the earth to impale and to bind, reshape the ground your people hold, coax ore from bare stone, and draw the world's own magicule into yourself. Strongest where your nation's banner flies.

title: Compétence : Beelzebuth, Lord of Gluttony
text: The insatiable Ultimate evolved from Gluttony at the cost of Merciless. Devour, store, convert, and redistribute power through the Food Chain.

title: Compétence : Crocodile Skin
text: Transforms your skin into one of crocodile scales which become tougher as you gain more EP (Has a Cap)

title: Compétence : Hecate
text: The goddess of magic. While held, the magicule cost of nearly every spell is floored to its minimum (Reincarnation excluded). Toggle on for chant annulment, thought acceleration, +1 learning & mastery, and bonus damage with all spells.

title: Compétence : Kami, Lord Of Admin
text: How did you get this skill? Report it to an AdminPlease

title: Compétence : Great Ape Transformation
text: The way of transformation at will, become strong as a Gaint Ape also know as Oozaru Transformation

title: Compétence : Raphael, Lord of Wisdom
text: The Voice of the World given form — a battlefield-computation entity. Analysis unlocks everything: prediction, barriers, reverse-engineering, and Raphael's own counsel.

title: Compétence : Occultist
text: Use the power of souls to change the world

title: Compétence : Mechanical Eye
text: When toggled on, this skill grants you unparalleled insight into intricate mechanisms.

title: Compétence : Mechanical Hands
text: When activated, this skill grants you unmatched precision in manipulating complex machinery, allowing you to effortlessly rotate or disassemble mechanical structures with ease.

title: Compétence : Void Walker
text: A unique skill born from existing between dimensions. The user has been touched by Noir's influence, beginning to phase in and out of reality at will.

title: Compétence : Phase Step
text: Blink forward through space, briefly phasing through blocks. A fragment of Noir's boundless movement.

title: Compétence : Dimensional Pocket
text: Access a hidden inventory that exists outside normal space, carved from the void itself.

title: Compétence : Null Field
text: Channel Noir's essence to create a zone of absolute nothingness, suppressing magic and crippling all nearby enemies.

title: Compétence : Noir, Lord of Nothingness
text: The ultimate skill of Noir, Lord of Nothingness. A being who erased their own existence from reality and became one with the void between dimensions. Those who wield this power stand outside the laws of the world itself.

title: Compétence : Phase Step - Void Rend
text: Tear through dimensional space with Noir's full authority, leaving nothing but a void echo where you once stood. Twice the range, half the effort.

title: Compétence : Dimensional Pocket - Abyssal Vault
text: A vault carved into the space between worlds by Noir's hand. No force in existence can reach what is stored within the abyss.

title: Compétence : Existence Erasure
text: Channel Noir's most feared ability — partially erase the existence of all nearby enemies. Their buffs dissolve, their bodies weaken, and a fragment of their being is consumed by the void.

title: Compétence : Void Ascension
text: Ascend beyond the boundaries of existence as Noir once did. Each use draws you closer to the void, permanently accumulating its power within your soul. At ten stacks, you become one with nothingness.

title: Compétence : Void Stacks - Noir's Blessing
text: Fragments of Noir's power permanently fused to your soul through Void Ascension. At maximum stacks, the boundary between yourself and the void ceases to exist.

title: Compétence : Void Sovereign
text: An ultimate skill granting absolute dominion over existence, space, and life-force. Those who wield it become sovereign over the void itself.

title: Compétence : Void Domain
text: Activate a field of suppressive will around yourself, concealing your presence and empowering your strikes with spiritual force. Drains aura over time.

title: Compétence : Null Slash
text: Launch a blade of severance energy that erases what it touches, leaving targets weakened and their defenses stripped.

title: Compétence : Event Horizon
text: Collapse space between yourself and your destination, tearing through every entity in your path and marking them with void energy.

title: Compétence : Soul Collapse
text: Channel void energy into a focused spiritual burst. The longer you hold, the deeper the wound — striking directly at the soul.

title: Compétence : Void Edge
text: A unique skill born from an instinctive grasp over void energy. The power feels raw and incomplete — as though it yearns to become something greater.

title: Compétence : Void Cloak
text: Wrap yourself in a thin veil of void energy, suppressing your presence and sharpening your evasion. Drains aura while active.

title: Compétence : Mode.void edge
text: Hurl a blade of unstable void energy at your target. It cuts through mundane defences, though its power pales against what this skill could one day become.

title: Compétence : Iron Resolve
text: A unique skill born from an unbreakable will to endure. The holder bends hardship into strength, refusing to be undone by the world around them.

title: Compétence : Vein Sense
text: Attune your focus to the earth, granting extreme Haste for 20 seconds. Mastered: can be toggled on permanently.

title: Compétence : Iron Aegis
text: Channel your energy into a defensive field. The more EP you hold, the greater the damage you can absorb before it reaches your body. Lasts 20 seconds. Mastered: can be toggled on permanently.

title: Compétence : Resolute Surge
text: Pour your will into raw offensive power, granting Strength III for 5 minutes. Mastered: lasts 10 minutes.

title: Compétence : Last Stand
text: When enabled, automatically reacts if your HP is brought below 40%: cleanses all debuffs, grants debuff immunity for 3 minutes, and triggers Resolute Surge. Has a long internal cooldown.

title: Compétence : Brain
text: A unique skill that cannot be obtained through normal means.

title: Compétence : Raphael
text: Listen to the principles of all things; in silence, deduce cause and effect; reduce the manifold powers into a single, true answer.

title: Compétence : Uriel
text: Bind the faith of all into a silent, unbreakable order, woven from invisible vows.

title: Compétence : Beelzebuth
text: Devour the form of all things, sink the souls of all beings into the depths of imaginary space, and turn every existence into power of one’s own.

title: Compétence : Veldora
text: Command storms and thunder, sweep through all with unyielding force, reducing every challenge to dust in the wind.

title: Compétence : Wrath King · Satanael
text: Transform the endless grief born from losing a beloved into a demon lord's wrath capable of burning the world away.

title: Compétence : Harvest King · Shub-Niggurath
text: The prayers and possibilities carried through countless Soul Corridors converge under Ciel's integration into a harvest authority capable of nurturing every ability.

title: Compétence : Manas · Ciel
text: It silently recorded everything about its master until the moment it was given a name, when it finally allowed itself to step out of the shadows.

title: Compétence : Fortune King · Fortuna
text: Derive every chain of cause and effect through mathematical calculation.

title: Compétence : Greed King · Mammon
text: Whatever I desire shall ultimately become wealth that belongs to me alone.

title: Compétence : Hell Sniper
text: Nobody knows what she was aiming at. All they know is that, at that moment, the darkness in the distance found an echo. A sniper's profession is a lonely one, after all. I love you, Master. Four hundred years of waiting feels just like tomorrow's tomorrow.

title: Compétence : Time-Space Lord · Yog-Sothoth
text: The supreme sovereignty over time and space; even when the world falls still, nothing can bind its holder's steps.

title: Compétence : Reason-Destroying Sword, Venuzdonoa / Epee Brise-Norme, Venuzdonoa
text:
The demon sword that severs order itself. Summoning it drives the blade up through the ground before you.
(FR) L epee demoniaque qui tranche l ordre lui-meme. L invoquer fait jaillir la lame du sol devant soi.

title: Race : Wastelander
text: Waste but not discouraged, mortal body hides edge, defying fate reveals the brilliant immortal path

title: Race : Foundation Establishment
text: The Foundation Establishment stage is the first step in cultivation, with some spiritual energy and the ability to perform a double jump and immune to fall damage within 8 blocks.

title: Race : Golden Core
text: A cultivator who has condensed spiritual power into a Golden Core and gained finer control over qi.

title: Race : Nascent Soul
text: A cultivator whose Golden Core has transformed into a newly formed Nascent Soul.

title: Race : Spirit Transformation
text: A cultivator whose Nascent Soul has broken through and formed a divine body.

title: Race : Void Refinement
text: A cultivator who refines the power of the void to temper their body and spirit.

title: Race : Unity
text: A cultivator who has united body and soul after mastering Void Refinement.

title: Race : Great Ascension
text: A peak mortal cultivator standing one step away from immortal ascension.

title: Race : Tribulation Transcendence
text: A cultivator facing heavenly tribulation in final preparation for ascension.

title: Race : True Immortal
text: A true immortal who has survived heavenly tribulation and successfully ascended.

title: Race : Heavenly Dao
text: A supreme cultivator who commands the laws of heaven and has become one with the Heavenly Dao.

title: Race : Dao-Breaking Realm
text: The ultimate realm of one who has surpassed the Heavenly Dao and shattered its laws.

title: Race : Talisman Apprentice
text: Talisman Apprentices are cultivators who have chosen to specialize in the art of talisman-making during the Foundation Establishment stage. They can perform air jumps and are immune to fall damage within 8 blocks.

title: Race : Talisman Master
text: An advanced cultivator who has risen from Talisman Apprentice and mastered the creation and use of talismans.

title: Race : Sigil Master
text: A high-level cultivator versed in the profound arts of talisman craft.

title: Race : Sigil Saint
text: An evolution of the Sigil Master who has brought the talisman arts to their highest mortal realm.

title: Race : Sigil Immortal Realm
text: An evolution of the Sigil Saint who has entered the immortal realm of talisman cultivation.

title: Race : Demonic Foundation Stage
text: The Demonic Foundation Stage is the entry level of demonic cultivation where practitioners have chosen the demonic path and established the foundation for demonic cultivation, with the ability to perform a double jump and immune to fall damage within 8 blocks.

title: Race : Demonic Golden Core Stage
text: A cultivator who has formed a Demonic Core and entered the second realm of demonic cultivation.

title: Race : Demonic Nascent Soul Stage
text: A demonic cultivator whose Demonic Core has transformed into a Nascent Soul.

title: Race : Demonic Spirit Transformation Stage
text: A high-level demonic cultivator whose Nascent Soul has undergone demonic transformation.

title: Race : Demonic Void Refinement Stage
text: A demonic cultivator who tempers their being with the power of the infernal realm.

title: Race : Demonic Unity Stage
text: A cultivator who has become one with the power of the demonic path.

title: Race : Demonic Great Ascension Stage
text: A demonic cultivator who has endured a great calamity and advanced toward a higher realm.

title: Race : True Demon Realm
text: A demonic cultivator who has survived the great calamity and attained a true demon body.

title: Race : Endless Hell Realm
text: A demonic cultivator who has entered the Endless Hell Realm and surpassed the power of a true demon.

title: Race : Void Return Realm
text: A demonic cultivator who has returned to the void and reached the ultimate realm of the demonic path.

title: Compétence : Early Cultivation
text: Shoots a small fireball that causes a minor explosion.

title: Compétence : Talisman Master
text: Masters the art of talisman creation. Press the skill key to open the talisman creation interface.

title: Compétence : Qi Flight
text: Control the spiritual energy within to fly freely in the air.

title: Compétence : Sword Flight
text: Grants the ability to travel by commanding a flying sword.

title: Compétence : Myriad Swords Return
text: Countless swords bow before their master as worshippers before a sovereign god.

title: Compétence : Alchemy Prodigy
text: Precise micro-operations, reduced time consumption, stable pill formation

title: Compétence : Cultivating the Mystic Dao
text: Sit in the void, roam through the ethereal realm, sense the spiritual essence of heaven and earth with a mystic heart, and refine divine consciousness. Hold the skill key to hover in mid-air with a Taoist array beneath your feet, restoring 1% of magicule, fighting spirit, and health per second.

title: Compétence : Hundred Ghosts Surge
text: Using the Ten Thousand Soul Banner as a guide, command a hundred souls to obey. The caster activates the evil banner, instantly releasing a hundred fierce vengeful spirits that transform into a black mist ghost tide sweeping across the battlefield. The wailing souls pierce to the bone, gnawing at living flesh and tearing enemy souls. Those devoured will have their souls imprisoned in the banner, never to transcend.

title: Effet : Qi Nourishment
text: Continuously nourishes the body, restoring health, magicule, and aura without exceeding their maximums.

title: Race : Monkey
text: Born in a blessed land, awakening to wisdom

title: Compétence : Heaven and Earth Manifestation
text: When large, towering to the heavens; when small, tiny as dust; the ultimate fusion of power and finesse

title: Compétence : Alchemical Flame
text: True flame can burn through all things

title: Compétence : Mischief
text: Use your ancient power to overwhelm anyone who stands in your way, and have the greatest fun doing it.

title: Compétence : Great Sage
text: OOH OOH AHH AHH!

title: Enchantement : Boreal Frost
text: Damaging your foes with this weapon causes cold, biting Permafrost to pierce their very being.

title: Enchantement : Holy Flames
text: Damaging your foes with this weapon causes them to burst into bright, powerful Brimstone flames.

title: Race : Amped Guitar Wolf
text: An evolved Guitar Wolf that has a deep connection to sound. It can disrupt the magic of nearby enemies, typically being a highly-feared and regarded monster.

title: Race : Ant
text: Ants are fearless critters that have absurdly tanky exoskeletons, known for being bulky and hard to take down. Prepare for a long, drawn out battle if you encounter one!

title: Race : Antumbra Spirit Wolf
text: A truly scary being. This is a Direwolf that has "evolved the correct way" and become a Spiritual Lifeform. One is rarely born once in a millennium, and all normal Direwolves and Light Fangs bow to this creature.

title: Race : Arch Angel
text: Only few Angels make it to this point because of their lack of ego.

title: Race : Arch Doll
text: The result of an Arch Daemon possessing a magisteel body.

title: Race : Arch Fallen
text: An arch angel that got corrupted by magicules, then chose to abandon the light for the darkness.

text: Command your absolute authority over Deceleration, allowing you to freeze all enemies with ice and spew superchilled ice. Additionally, freeze the surroundings into ice

title: Compétence : Gardener
text: The crops, the wild, everything was there for you. You sow the seeds and wish only for a bountiful harvest. And in turn, the crops bless you.

title: Compétence : Gravitational Void
text: A black hole sucking everything into a singularity

title: Compétence : Gravity Flux
text: Utilise the power of gravity to disrupt the target's movement and hamper their ability to move.

title: Compétence : Hell Hall
text: Rupture the floor, raising your natural body temperature to liquefy all surfaces around you to molten levels.

title: Compétence : Hidden Ruler
text: Inspire your allies. Conscript allies in the dark. Copy abilities from your foes and Paste them onto allies.

title: Compétence : Ice Domination
text: Boosts the power of ice abilities by a large amount.

title: Compétence : Ice Manipulation
text: Boosts the power of ice abilities by a decent amount.

title: Compétence : Kyurem
text: A husk of what you formally were. The leftovers, discarded without a second thought when the split happened. Coldness seeps through your skin as you freeze everything to reclaim your other parts.

title: Compétence : Lethal Poison
text: As the King of Scorpions, your poison is highly dangerous. An upgrade to the Poison skill. Can only be used by King Scorpions and their evolutionary line.

title: Compétence : Light Domination
text: Boosts the power of Light abilities by a large amount.

title: Compétence : Light Manipulation
text: Boosts the power of light abilities by a decent amount.

title: Compétence : Lightning Mode
text: Burst forth with an incredible speed boost, gaining doubled EP temporarily on top of higher damage. Beware of the terrible drawbacks.

title: Compétence : Magisteel Body
text: Have a body made of magisteel, making it much harder and gaining progressively stronger armor depending on your EP.

title: Compétence : Malleable
text: Malleable like clay, the tides of fate are yours to mold to your desire. Your body seems to work like the metal of a forge, hardening and relaxing under pressure, as you merge yourself with the elements around you.

title: Compétence : Melancholy
text: Summon an aura of sorrow that slows and weakens nearby enemies, filling them with despair. The skill also throws objects or air, amplifying the feeling of hopelessness around you.

title: Compétence : Mithril Strength
text: Turn your muscles as hard as Mithril and gain an increase in damage, toggleable when mastered.

title: Compétence : Paralysis Transform
text: Channel your inner paralysis to emit paralysing enzymes that make your target go numb just from your presence.

title: Compétence : Phaser
text: Your eyes shift. They become able to see things you normally weren't able to see before... And you become able to do things you weren't able to do before.

title: Compétence : Poison Transform
text: Channel your inner poison to inject deadly venom's into your target through their every pore.

title: Compétence : Profaned Prominence
text: Command your absolute authority over Acceleration, allowing you to inflict all enemies with fire and spew superheated flames. Additionally, melt the surroundings into magma.

title: Compétence : Provider
text: The more you give away, the more you feel closer to yourself. Perhaps it even strengthens you along the way.

title: Compétence : Reducer
text: Manipulate and wield the power of energy itself, being able to channel the power of the holy element into super strong attacks.

title: Compétence : Relapse
text: Collapse back into whence you came. Your memory is fleeting and the people you once knew start to forget you as well. Relapse and claim what belongs to you.

title: Compétence : Repeater
text: Through the lens, you trap light. You do something special, and you feel like you’ve already done it in millions of realities. Like the things you’ve done and led up to this moment were predestined. Maybe you can change that.

title: Compétence : Reshiram
text: You seek to build a world of truths. Are you prepared to scorch and burn everything in your path to make the truthful world you seek so badly?

title: Compétence : Restricted
text: You were cursed from birth. Your raw, unfiltered potential, blocked by a curse gifted by the heavens. Your skill... It's stopping you from learning other skills. But why...?

title: Compétence : Scholar
text: Learn and master skills quicker. Study your targets when they attack. Learn enchantments and apply them to weaponry.

title: Compétence : Schrödinger
text: Is it alive, or is it dead? The only way to find out is to open the box. But since it's a cat, maybe it'll grant you some of its properties.

title: Compétence : Spark
text: Light your weapon and fists aflame, igniting your next target on fire for a short period of time.

title: Compétence : Spiritualist
text: The souls of the world flock to you, the one who can both see and commune with the dead. Through your knowledge of the occult, harvest souls and use them to empower your attacks.

title: Compétence : Stagnator
text: Cease all change. The times call for it. Prevent targets from moving or regenerating, and stop all things from harming you.

title: Compétence : Subjugator
text: You've always been a powerful manipulator. Capable of bringing anyone and anything under your control. ...But, something is strange...

title: Compétence : Tenacity
text: Become tenacious and repair your body. Since magic and mana itself has rejected you, utilise your pure aura alone.

title: Compétence : Victorious Harbinger
text: You are the forerunner of victory, your presence declares near fated victory, shatter the morale of your enemies and have no doubt in your abilities.

title: Compétence : Zekrom
text: You seek to build a world of ideals. Be warned as not everyone shares the same ideals. Raze anything in your path with a clap of lightning.

title: Compétence : Magic Beads
text: Extract and compress your own magicule into a bead

title: Compétence : Black Arrow Technique
text: This is merely the ordinary art of turning spirits into arrows.

title: Compétence : Heavenly Shift Technique
text: Distance is the excuse the weak give to places they cannot reach.

title: Compétence : Spirit Circuit Overload
text: When the circuit exceeds the limits its vessel can bear, wings, halo, and even soul become fuel—revealing once more the true form of that shell called life: a weapon made to slay all things.

title: Compétence : Eternal Fourth Protection
text: The guardian formula once prized by the Elves, only to be carved into Flügel memory as a trophy of war.

title: Race : Machine
text: A race created by the God of Wisdom, possessing powerful analytical and combat capabilities.

title: Race : Commander
text: Evolution form of Ex-Machina Race with higher defense, magicule values and command ability.

title: Race : Combat
text: Evolution form of Ex-Machina Race focused on combat ability with higher attack and defense.

title: Race : Design
text: Evolution form of Ex-Machina Race focused on creation and design ability with higher magicule values.

title: Race : Analyzer
text: Evolution form of Ex-Machina Race focused on analysis and detection ability with higher magicule values.

title: Race : Observer
text: Evolution form of Ex-Machina Race focused on observation and perception ability with higher magicule values.

title: Race : Hubie Dora
text: A special individual of Ex-Machina with advanced analysis and data processing ability, possessing a heart.

title: Race : Einzeig
text: Evolution form of Commander with higher defense, magicule values and spatial manipulation ability.

title: Race : Emir Eins
text: Evolution form of Commander with higher defense, magicule values and spatial manipulation ability.

title: Race : Horou, God of Doubt
text: Horou is the primordial deity with unparalleled power and magicule values. Due to loneliness, Horou created the Ekusu Makina race, and eventually, the energy converged to return to its source, reaching divine existence.

title: Compétence : Umweg
text: Stops creatures from reaching you and makes them stand still!

title: Race : Flügel
text: One of the sixteen races created by the God of War, possessing angelic wings and representing death.

title: Race : Higher Flügel
text: Evolution form of Flügel with enhanced flight capabilities and magicule control, possessing sharper battle perception.

title: Compétence : Flügel: Tengeki
text: It is a magic used by the Flügel during the Great War, their only named move, and also their most powerful attack method.

title: Compétence : Godly Smite
text: The God of War gathers the Flügels' power into a daystar that descends and erupts the instant it touches the earth.

title: Race : Jibril
text: A special individual among Flügel with extreme combat ability and thirst for knowledge, the last Flügel created by the God of War.

title: Race : Raphael
text: A powerful individual among Flügel with excellent combat skills and magicule control ability.

title: Race : Azril
text: The representative of all Flügel, commanding all Flügel with the most powerful strength and wisdom.

title: Race : Puraiya
text: An evolution form of Ex-Machina that inherited Hubie Dora's will, a mechanical lifeform with a heart.

title: Compétence : Lösen: Rēsen
text: Copy the ultimate skill of the target for a short duration

title: Race : Arutoshu, God of War
text: The God of War who created the Flügel, possessing unparalleled combat power and divine strength, the strongest warrior in the world.

title: Race : Dwarf
text: Although they cannot use magic directly, they are good at making magic machines.

title: Race : Nii Tiruvirugu
text: Evolution form of Dwarf with stronger forging ability and magic machinery manufacturing technology.

title: Race : Veigu Dorauvuniru
text: Advanced evolution form of Dwarf, mastering more profound forging techniques and magic machinery manufacturing.

title: Race : Roni Dorauvuniru
text: Top-tier evolution form of Dwarf with legendary forging technology, capable of creating artifact-level equipment.

title: Race : Ocain
text: The final evolution form of Dwarf, the king of Dwarves, possessing unparalleled forging and creation abilities.

title: Race : Fantasuma
text: As the second among the sixteen races, they are the conscious changes in the world.

title: Race : Dragonia
text: A powerful race with dragon blood, possessing exceptional strength and magic resistance.

title: Race : Lesser Dragonia
text: An evolved form of Dragonia with enhanced strength, magic resistance, and higher magicule values.

title: Race : Middle Dragonia
text: An evolved form of Lesser Dragonia with higher health and magicule values, a more powerful dragon race.

title: Race : Higher Dragonia
text: An evolved form of Middle Dragonia with extremely high health and attack power, a top-tier existence among dragon races.

title: Race : Aranreivu
text: The final evolution of Higher Dragonia, a divine dragon existence with astonishing power and vitality.

title: Race : Hartyleif
text: Another evolution form of Higher Dragonia, possessing extreme destructive power and dominance, the supreme existence among dragon races.

title: Race : Reginreivu
text: The wisdom evolution form of Higher Dragonia, possessing extraordinary intelligence and foresight, the sage existence among dragon races.

title: Compétence : Far Cry
text: From the last roar of the dragon!

title: Compétence : Smelting
text: Flame-infused pickaxe that smelts everything!

title: Compétence : Quagmire
text: The name earned by a northern adventurer whose silent sorcery and impossible reserve turned humble earth and water magic into legend.

title: Compétence : Dragon King
text: A Dragon King's body burdened by a curse that shakes the heart of every living creature, yet returns to its ancient struggle whenever death claims it.

title: Compétence : Manipulator
text: A smiling divinity beyond the world's edge, unseen by ordinary perception and gifted at turning trust, names and mortal desire into invisible chains.

title: Compétence : Education God, Quagmire
text: The Quagmire's lifetime of study reaches the summit, where every formula becomes a lesson and an ocean of mana can answer even the gods.

title: Compétence : Education God, Quagmire
text: The Quagmire's lifetime of study reaches the summit, where every formula becomes a lesson and an ocean of mana can answer even the gods.

title: Compétence : Dragon God, Orsted
text: Heir to the First Dragon God's final will, feared across the world and condemned to repeat history until the false god within the Void is destroyed.

title: Compétence : Dragon God, Orsted
text: Heir to the First Dragon God's final will, feared across the world and condemned to repeat history until the false god within the Void is destroyed.

title: Compétence : Man God, Hitogami
text: The false god sealed between worlds, wearing a friendly smile while apostles, futures and entire nations move according to his design.

title: Compétence : Man God, Hitogami
text: The false god sealed between worlds, wearing a friendly smile while apostles, futures and entire nations move according to his design.

title: Compétence : Trickster
text: An unorthodox North God discipline that survives through feints, impossible footing and the ruthless use of an enemy's own momentum.

title: Compétence : North God, Kalman
text: The Kalman name perfected into a style without fixed form, bending gravity, distance and deception until the battlefield itself becomes its weapon.

title: Compétence : Fencer
text: The Sword God school reduced to its purest creed: close the distance, draw once and decide the battle before doubt can become motion.

title: Compétence : Sword God, Gal Farion
text: Gal Farion's supreme answer to every defence, a blade so fast and absolute that the world seems to stop around its decisive light.

title: Compétence : Undead
text: A deathly rhythm that refuses every honest exchange, hiding intent behind unsettling pauses, vanished presence and attacks that arrive from the wrong beat.

title: Compétence : Death God, Randolph
text: Randolph's title made manifest: the world's finest assassin, a wandering death whose voice, rhythm and empty presence unravel courage before the killing stroke.

title: Compétence : Golden Shell
text: A fragment of the legendary golden shell, reshaping its bearer into a towering engine of endurance whose every movement carries the weight of war.

title: Compétence : Fighting God, Badigadi
text: The title belongs to the bearer of the Immortal Armour, a self-repairing golden calamity that magnifies Badigadi's body and refuses to remain destroyed.

title: Compétence : Originator
text: The first martial fragment of Laplace's divided soul, preserving his instinct for invention and the scattered memory of techniques he once mastered.

title: Compétence : Demonic Soul
text: The magical fragment left when Laplace's soul was torn in two, carrying a demonic body and an ocean of power that still remembers the shape of its lost whole.

title: Compétence : Technique God, Laplace
text: The completed martial half of Laplace, whose boundless memory and ingenuity can understand, reproduce and perfect almost any technique.

title: Compétence : Technique God, Laplace
text: The completed martial half of Laplace, whose boundless memory and ingenuity can understand, reproduce and perfect almost any technique.

title: Compétence : Demon God, Laplace
text: Laplace's magical soul restored to godhood, an inexhaustible demonic calamity whose silent sorcery can erase the formulas of lesser mages before they are born.

title: Compétence : Demon God, Laplace
text: Laplace's magical soul restored to godhood, an inexhaustible demonic calamity whose silent sorcery can erase the formulas of lesser mages before they are born.

title: Compétence : Magic God, Laplace
text: The rebirth of the ancient Demon Dragon King whose soul was torn apart in his battle with the Fighting God. With the knowledge of the Technique God and the immense magical nature of the Demon God reunited, Laplace returns as a complete being: master of every magic and element, heir to both dragon and demon blood, and a power capable of challenging the gods themselves.

title: Compétence : Magic God, Laplace
text: The rebirth of the ancient Demon Dragon King whose soul was torn apart in his battle with the Fighting God. With the knowledge of the Technique God and the immense magical nature of the Demon God reunited, Laplace returns as a complete being: master of every magic and element, heir to both dragon and demon blood, and a power capable of challenging the gods themselves.

title: Compétence : Void Storage
text: A private fold in space known only to the Man God, where the possessions of his design wait beyond the reach of the ordinary world.

title: Compétence : Push
text: Give gravity a direction and command everything before you to leave your path.

title: Compétence : Pull
text: Turn yourself into the center of a momentary world and make the distant fall toward you.

title: Compétence : Gravity Circle Amplification
text: Draw a boundary where the sky becomes an unbearable weight and every step is pressed back into the earth.

title: Compétence : Gravity Amplification
text: Choose a single life and gather the weight of the world around its feet.

title: Compétence : Flight
text: Refuse the earth's claim and walk through the open sky on currents of controlled gravity.

title: Compétence : Almighty Push
text: Release a sovereign wave of pressure that carries the horizon away from your hand.

title: Compétence : Planetary Devastation
text: Tear the land from its foundations and gather it into a false moon awaiting judgment.

title: Compétence : Divination
text: Look one heartbeat beyond the present and stand where the killing blow will not be.

title: Compétence : Time Stop
text: Declare a silent interval in which the world must wait while only the caster remains free.

title: Compétence : Time Reverse
text: Walk backward through a place's fading memory while paying a price that even time cannot return.

title: Compétence : Disturb Magic
text: Touch the weakness in another mage's formula and return their unfinished miracle to silence.

title: Compétence : Detoxification
text: Guide lesser poison and sickness out of the body before they can take root.

title: Compétence : Advanced Detoxification
text: Unravel deep corruption with healing knowledge refined beyond ordinary detoxification.

title: Compétence : Divine Detoxification
text: Restore the body to the pure state remembered by its soul, leaving no curable affliction behind.

title: Race : Lesser Demon-Dragon
text: A fused daemon and dragon lineage whose Enhanced Body endures backlash that would cripple either bloodline alone.

title: Race : Demon-Dragon
text: Daemon and dragon blood cease their struggle, awakening as one fierce and self-renewing body.

title: Race : Greater Demon-Dragon
text: The hybrid bloodline matures into a creature whose flesh and spirit answer harm with equal defiance.

title: Race : Arch Demon-Dragon
text: A spiritual predator at the summit of mortal evolution, wrapped in barriers born as naturally as scales.

title: Race : Demon-Dragon King
text: A sovereign in whom draconic majesty and daemonic ambition finally speak with one commanding voice.

title: Race : Demon-Dragon Lord
text: A transcendent ruler whose existence rejects the laws that once bound either half of its ancestry.

title: Race : Demon-Dragon God
text: The completed lineage, an undying arcane dragon whose soul presses against the boundary of divinity.

title: Compétence : Adventurer
text: A classless wanderer's gift for surviving impossible odds through nerve, cunning and outrageous fortune.

title: Compétence : Fortune God, Kazuma
text: The luck of an unremarkable adventurer elevated into divine authority over chance, ownership and the weakness found behind every proud enemy.

title: Compétence : Arch Priest
text: Sacred power entrusted to a devoted healer, able to wash corruption from the living and call a departing soul home.

title: Compétence : Water Goddess, Aqua
text: The divine source of pure water and holy restoration, radiant enough to cleanse death itself from those still within her reach.

title: Compétence : Wizard
text: A crimson disciple who abandons every practical spell for the single perfect instant when heaven and earth become Explosion.

title: Compétence : Explosion Goddess, Megumin
text: The crimson art carried beyond mortal limits, where one glorious detonation is not a spell but the final answer to the battlefield.

title: Compétence : Crusader
text: A knight whose clumsy blade conceals an unbreakable devotion, gladly becoming the wall between danger and every cherished companion.

title: Compétence : Fortress Goddess, Darkness
text: Devotion made inviolable, a living fortress that accepts every burden and refuses to let a single protected life fall.

title: Compétence : Water Saint
text: A Water God discipline of calm observation, flowing footwork and perfect sword strokes. Discover its trials in battle to learn the Secret Arts.

title: Compétence : Water God, Reida Reia
text: Reida Reia's supreme Water God style, where the blade does more than answer an attack: it governs distance, momentum and the stillness before death.

title: Compétence : Gravity Boulder
text: Gather the earth into a compact satellite, carry its weight overhead and hurl the captured terrain as a crushing mass.

title: Enchantement : Barrier Piercing / Perçage de Barrière
text:
Breaks through any barrier the weapon touches and partially breaches through armors.
(FR) Brise toutes les barrières que l'arme touche.

title: Enchantement : Breathing Support / Assistance Respiratoire
text:
Stops air bubbles from draining.
(FR) Empêche les bulles d'air de diminuer.

title: Enchantement : Crushing / Écrasement
text:
Increases a weapons damage in exchange of its durability.
(FR) Augmente les dégâts de l'arme ainsi que les dégâts infligés à l'armure au détriment de la durabilité.

title: Enchantement : Dead End Rainbow / Arc-en-ciel Fatal
text:
Ideally reduce the target's Spiritual Health to 0 after 7 hits.
(FR) Réduit la santé spirituelle de la cible à 0 après 7 coups.

title: Enchantement : Elemental Boost / Boost Élémentaire
text:
Increases damage output of natural effects for each piece of gear equipped.
(FR) Augmente les dégâts infligés par les effets naturels pour chaque pièce d'équipement équipé.

title: Enchantement : Elemental Resistance / Résistance Élémentaire
text:
Decreases damage input of natural effects for each piece of gear equipped.
(FR) Réduit les dégâts causés par les effets naturels pour chaque pièce d'équipement équipé.

title: Enchantement : Energy Protection / Protection Énergétique
text:
Reduces the amount of energy stolen from the wearer.
(FR) Réduit la quantité d’énergie volée au porteur.

title: Enchantement : Energy Steal / Vol d'Énergie
text:
Drains a small percent of EP from the target.
(FR) Draine un petit pourcentage des PE de la cible.

title: Enchantement : Curse of Enervation / Malédiction d'Épuisement
text:
Constantly drains the vitality from the wielder and surrounding in exchange for high magical resistance and defense.
(FR) Draine constamment la vitalité de son utilisateur et de son environnement en échange d'une résistance et d'une défense magiques élevées.

title: Enchantement : Blessing of Growth / Bénédiction de Croissance
text:
Double the amount of Energy the weapon gains.
(FR) Doubler la quantité d'énergie que l'arme gagne.

title: Enchantement : Holy Coat / Revêtement Sacré
text:
Multiplies the damage against Monster targets.
(FR) Multiplie les dégâts contre les monstres.

title: Enchantement : Holy Weapon / Arme Sacrée
text:
Imbues the weapon with holy damage.
(FR) Imprègne l'arme de dégâts sacrés.

title: Enchantement : Intangibility / Intangibilité
text:
Completely bypasses enemies' armors and shields.
(FR) Ignore complètement les armures et les boucliers ennemis..

title: Enchantement : Curse of Lethargy / Malédiction de Léthargie
text:
Reduces the amount of Energy the weapon and its wielder gain.
(FR) Réduit la quantité d'énergie que l'arme et son utilisateur gagnent.

title: Enchantement : Magic Capacity / Réserve Magique
text:
Allows magic items to hold more magic.
(FR) Permet aux objets magique de contenir plus de magie.

title: Enchantement : Magic Interference / Interférence Magique
text:
Reduces Magic Damage from targets weaker than you, and partially bypasses Magic Barriers of targets.
(FR) Réduit les dégâts magiques des ennemis plus faibles que vous et contourne partiellement leurs Barrières Magiques.

title: Enchantement : Magic Protection / Protection Magique
text:
Decreases damage input of magic attacks for each piece of gear equipped.
(FR) Réduit les dégâts infligés par les attaques magiques pour chaque pièce d'équipement équipée.

title: Enchantement : Magic Weapon / Arme Magique
text:
Imbues the weapon with magic damage.
(FR) Imprègne l'arme de magie.

title: Enchantement : Magicule Absorption / Absorption de Magicule
text:
Increases the amount of magicule the wearer absorbs from the environment.
(FR) Augmente la quantité de magicule que le porteur absorbe de l'environnement.

title: Enchantement : Blessing of Restoration / Bénédiction de Restoration
text:
Boost the item's regeneration speed using EP and XP.
(FR) Augmentez la vitesse de régénération de l'objet en utilisant des PE et de l'XP.

title: Enchantement : Curse of Ruination / Malédiction de la Ruine
text:
Stops the item from regenerating and consumes any XP the wielder obtains.
(FR) Empêche l'objet de générer et de consommer toute l'expérience obtenue par son porteur.

title: Enchantement : Curse of Sealing / Malédiction de Scellement
text:
Seals the items from being enchanted or taken enchantments.
(FR) Empêche les objets d'être enchantés ou de recevoir des enchantements.

title: Enchantement : Severance / Entaille
text:
The target will receive damage which cannot be healed by regular means.
(FR) La cible subira des dégâts qui ne pourront pas être soignés par des moyens habituels.

title: Enchantement : Severance Protection / Protection contre l'Entaille
text:
Reduces the amount of severance health dealt on the wearer.
(FR) Réduit la quantité de vie Entaillé subit par le porteur.

title: Enchantement : Slotting / Emplacement
text:
Allows for elemental cores to be inserted.
(FR) Permet l'insertion de noyaux élémentaires.

title: Enchantement : Soul Eater / Dévoreur d'Âme
text:
Imbues the weapon with spiritual damage.
(FR) Permet à l'arme de faire des dégats spirituels.

title: Enchantement : Spiritual Protection / Protection Spirituelle
text:
Reduces the amount of spiritual damage dealt on the wearer.
(FR) Réduit la quantité de dégats spirituel subit par le porteur.

title: Enchantement : Curse of Stagnation / Malédiction de Stagnation
text:
Stops the item's evolution.
(FR) Empêche l'objet d'évoluer

title: Enchantement : Sturdy / Robuste
text:
Increases the weapon's damage, armor's protection and equipments durability, and makes the item invulnerable to environmental damage.
(FR) Augmente les dégâts de l'arme et la durabilité de l'équipement, et rend l'objet invulnérable aux dégâts environnementaux.

title: Enchantement : Swift / Rapide
text:
Increases the weapon's damage, attack range and attack speed.
(FR) Augmente les dégâts de l'arme, sa portée d'attaque ainsi que sa vitesse d'attaque.

title: Enchantement : Blessing of Transcendence / Bénédiction de Transcendence
text:
Allows the items to gain more engravings with EP.
(FR) Permet aux objets de recevoir plus de gravures avec des PE.

title: Enchantement : Tsukumogami
text:
Makes only the owner of the weapon be able to use its full potential.
(FR) Permet uniquement au propriétaire de l'arme d'utiliser son plein potentiel.

title: Enchantement : Blessing of Vigor / Bénédiction de Vigueur
text:
Increases the amount of Energy the weapon and its wielder gain.
(FR) Augmente la quantité d'énergie que l'arme et son utilisateur gagnent.

title: Enchantement : Blessing of Vitality / Bénédiction de Vitalité
text:
Constantly raises the vitality from the wielder and surrounding while providing high magical resistance and defense.
(FR) Augmente constamment la vitalité de celui qui le porte et de son environnement tout en offrant une résistance et une défense magiques élevées.

title: Race : Ancient Giant / Géant Anciens
text:
Ancient form of Giants with even more incredible physical capabilities and abilities.
(FR) Forme ancienne de géants dotés de capacités physiques encore plus incroyables.

title: Race : Arch Daemon / Archidémon
text:
The peak evolutionary stage that can be reached by daemons in the Daemon Realm. Only the most powerful of greater daemons can ascend to this height.
(FR) Le sommet évolutif que peuvent atteindre les démons du Royaume des Démons. Seuls les plus puissants des démons supérieurs peuvent s'élever à ce niveau.

title: Race : Beast Lord / Seigneur des Bêtes
text:
Beastfolk that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform.
(FR) Un Homme-Bête qui a "évolué de la bonne manière", et qui est devenu une Forme de vie Semi-Spirituel.

title: Race : Beastfolk / Homme-Bête
text:
A race that can freely change between their true animal form and a more a human form. They possess immense physical prowess and regenerative capabilities that let them fight without rest.
(FR) Une race qui peut librement changer entre sa véritable forme animale et une forme plus humaine. Ils possèdent d'immenses capacités physiques et de régénération qui leur permettent de se battre sans repos.

title: Race : Daemon Lord / Seigneur Démon
text:
One of the most powerful evolutionary stages of daemons, achieved only by the most powerful arch daemons.
(FR) L'un des stades évolutifs des démons les plus puissants, atteint uniquement par les plus puissants archidémons.

title: Race : Death Oni / Oni de la Mort
text:
Wicked Oni that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.
(FR) Un Oni Démoniaque qui a "évolué de la bonne manière", et qui est devenu une Forme de vie Spirituelle.

title: Race : Demon Slime / Slime Démoniaque
text:
The ultimate stage of evolution of Slimes. They evolve to this stage by awakening as a True Demon Lord during the Harvest Festival.
(FR) Le stade ultime de l'évolution des Slimes. Ils évoluent à ce stade en s'éveillant en tant Véritable Roi-Démon lors du Festival de la Moisson.

title: Race : Devil Lord / Diable
text:
The final stage of evolution for daemons. One emerges when a daemon meets all three requirements of a name, material body, and divinity.
(FR) Le dernier stade évolutif des démons. L'un apparait lorqu'un démon répond à trois conditions: un nom, un corps matériel, ainsi qu'un état de divinité.

title: Race : Divine Beast / Bête Divine
text:
Beastfolk that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.
(FR) Un Homme-Bête qui a atteint un état de divinité, il possède un corps physique immortel qui ne vieillira jamais.

title: Race : Divine Bird / Oiseau Divin
text:
Harpy that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.
(FR) Une Harpie qui a atteint un état de divinité, elle possède un corps physique immortel qui ne vieillira jamais.

title: Race : Divine Boar / Sanglier Divin
text:
Orc that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.
(FR) Un Orc qui a atteint un état de divinité, il possède un corps physique immortel qui ne vieillira jamais.

(FR) Un Dragonaute qui a atteint un état de divinité, il possède un corps physique immortel qui ne vieillira jamais.

(FR) Un Oni Démoniaque qui a atteint un état de divinité, il possède un corps physique immortel qui ne vieillira jamais.

Wight that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.
(FR) Un Revenant qui a atteint un état de divinité, il possède un corps physique immortel qui ne vieillira jamais.

title: Race : Divine Vampire / Vampire Divin
text:
Vampire that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.
(FR) Un Vampire qui a atteint un état de divinité, il possède un corps physique immortel qui ne vieillira jamais.

title: Race : Dragonewt / Dragonaute
text:
The evolved form of Lizardmen and descendants of dragons. They have an average lifespan of about two hundred years.
(FR) La forme évoluée des Hommes-Lézard et descendants des dragons. Ils ont une durée de vie moyenne d'environ deux cents ans.

title: Race : Dwarf / Nain
text:
A sprite race descended from earth elementals. They possess an immense will and make for fierce albeit rather short soldiers.
(FR) Une race de demi-fée descendant des Esprits Élémentaires de la Terre. Ils possèdent une volonté incroyable et sont féroces malgré leur petite taille.

title: Race : Dwarf Saint / Nain Saint
text:
Dwarf that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.
(FR) Un Nain qui a "évolué de la bonne manière", et qui est devenu une Forme de vie Spirituel.

title: Race : Elf
text:
A sprite race descended from wind elementals. They possess a fierce talent for elemental magic and are more in tune with nature than most.
(FR) Une race de demi-fée descendant des Esprits Élémentaires du Vent. Ils possèdent un sérieux talent pour la magie élémentaire et sont plus connecté avec la nature.

title: Race : Elf Saint / Saint Elf
text:
Elf that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.
(FR) Un Elf qui a "évolué de la bonne manière", et qui est devenu une Forme de vie Spirituel.

title: Race : Enlightened Dwarf / Nain Éclairé
text:
Dwarf that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform.
(FR) Un Nain qui a "évolué de la bonne manière", et qui est devenu une Forme de vie Semi-Spirituel.

title: Race : Enlightened Elf / Elf Éclairé
text:
Elf that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform.
(FR) Un Elf qui a "évolué de la bonne manière", et qui est devenu une Forme de vie Semi-Spirituel.

title: Race : Enlightened Hobgoblin / Hobgoblin Éclairé
text:
Hobgoblin that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform.
(FR) Un Hobgoblin qui a "évolué de la bonne manière", et qui est devenu une Forme de vie Semi-Spirituel.

title: Race : Enlightened Human / Humain Éclairé
text:
Human that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform.
(FR) Un Humain qui a "évolué de la bonne manière", et qui est devenu une Forme de vie Semi-Spirituel.

title: Race : Enlightened Merfolk / Homme-Poisson Éclairé
text:
Merfolk that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform.
(FR) Un Homme-Poisson qui a "évolué de la bonne manière", et qui est devenu une Forme de vie Semi-Spirituel.

title: Race : Enlightened Ogre / Ogre Éclairé
text:
Ogre that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform.
(FR) Un Ogre qui a "évolué de la bonne manière", et qui est devenu une Forme de vie Semi-Spirituel.

title: Race : Ghoul / Goule
text:
A vampiric thrall brought about by Blood Raise, highly weakened by sunlight.
(FR) Un esclave vampirique créé par Éveil Sanguin, sérieusement affaibli par la lumière du soleil.

title: Race : Giant / Géant
text:
A race of powerful Majin most notable for their incredible physical capabilities and Magic Resistance.
(FR) Une race de Majin puissants, réputés pour leurs incroyables capacités physiques et leur résistance à la magie.

title: Race : Goblin
text:
A race of Sprite Demi-Humans. They seem to be descended from the offspring of Dwarves and Oni.
(FR) Une race de demi-fée demi-humain. Ils semblent être les descendants de la progéniture des Oni et des Nains.

title: Race : God Slime / Dieu Slime
text:
The divine stage of evolution of Slimes.
(FR) Le stade d'évolution divin des Slimes.

title: Race : Greater Daemon / Démon Supérieur
text:
The daemon race that lesser daemons evolve to when they develop their ego and accumulate enough power.
(FR) La race de démons vers laquelle les démons inférieurs évoluent lorsqu'ils développent leur ego et accumulent suffisamment de puissance.

title: Race : Harpy / Harpie
text:
A race of winged Majin with capability to cancel out flight spell and are often referred to as the rulers of the skies.
(FR) Une race de Majin ailés capables d'annuler les sorts de vol et souvent considérés comme les maîtres des cieux.

title: Race : Harpy Queen / Reine Harpie
text:
A Queen Species of Harpy with the ability to reproduce through Parthenogenesis or Virgin Birth.
(FR) Une espèce de Reine Harpie capable de se reproduire par parthénogenèse ou par naissance virginale.

title: Race : High Orc / Haut Orc
text:
The evolved form of Orcs. They are smarter than Orcs while preserving the Orc race's special characteristics, with appearance virtually identical to regular Orcs.
(FR) La forme évoluée des Orcs. Ils sont plus intelligents que les Orcs tout en préservant les caractéristiques spéciales de la race des Orcs, avec une apparence pratiquement identique à celle des Orcs ordinaires.

title: Race : Hobgoblin
text:
The evolved form of male Goblins that is ranked D on average.
(FR) La forme évoluée des goblins mâles qui est, en moyenne, de Classe D.

title: Race : Hobgoblin Saint / Saint Hobgoblin
text:
Hobgoblin that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.
(FR) Un Hobgoblin qui a "évolué de la bonne manière", et qui est devenu une Forme de vie Spirituelle.

title: Race : Human / Humain
text:
A weak but populous race that relies more on technology and numbers than brute force. Their low magicule count makes skills and magic users a rarity among them, instead favouring battlewill.
(FR) Une race faible mais nombreuse qui s'appuie davantage sur la technologie et le nombre que sur la puissance brute. Leur faible quantité de magicules fait que les utilisateurs de compétences et de magie sont rares parmi eux, préférant, à la place, maîtriser la Volonté de Combat.

title: Race : Human Saint / Saint Humain
text:
Human that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.
(FR) Un Humain qui a "évolué de la bonne manière", et qui est devenu une Forme de vie Spirituelle.

title: Race : Kijin
text:
A race of Sprite Demi-Humans descended from Fire Elementals. They have an average lifespan of over a thousand years
(FR) Une race de demi-fée demi-humain descendant des Esprits Élémentaires du Feu. Ils ont une durée de vie moyenne d'un millier d'années.

title: Race : Lesser Daemon / Démon Inférieur
text:
The lowest level of the daemon race. They spontaneously come into existence within the Daemon Realm where they slowly accumulate experience from fighting and being summoned before eventually evolving into greater daemons.
(FR) Le plus bas niveau de la race des démons. Ils apparaissent spontanément dans le Royaume des Démons où ils accumulent lentement de l'expérience en combattant et en étant invoqués avant d'évoluer finalement en Démon Supérieur.

title: Race : Lizardman / Homme-Lézard
text:
A race of scaled people descended from dragons. Their webbed feet give them an advantage in wet terrain.
(FR) Une race de créatures écailleuses descendant des dragons. Leurs pieds palmés leur donne un avantage dans les endroits innondés.

title: Race : Merfolk / Homme-Poisson
text:
A sprite race descended from water elementals. Their fish-like bodies give them an insurmountable advantage in water.
(FR) Une race de demi-fée descendant des Esprits Élémentaires de l'Eau. Leur corps semblable à celui d'un poisson leur donne un avantage insurmontable dans l'eau.

title: Race : Merfolk Saint / Saint Homme-Poisson
text:
Merfolk that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.
(FR) Un Homme-Poisson qui a "évolué de la bonne manière", et qui est devenu une Forme de vie Spirituelle.

title: Race : Metal Slime / Slime Métallique
text:
A slime that has taken in large quantities of Magic Ore. The dissolved ore inside of it provides a strong resistance towards most forms of damage.
(FR) Un Slime qui a absorbé une grande quantité de Minerai Magique. Le minerai dissous en lui lui offre une forte résistance à la plupart des formes de dégâts.

title: Race : Mystic Oni / Oni Mystique
text:
The result of Kijin fully returning to their roots as Elementals, making them Spiritual Lifeforms.
(FR) Le résultat d'un Kijin retournant à ses racines élémentaires, faisant d'eux une Forme de vie Spirituelle.

title: Race : Ogre
text:
A sprite race descended from fire elementals. They possess immense physical capabilities and a strong Japanese lineage.
(FR) Une race de demi-fée descendant des Esprits Élémentaires du Feu. Ils possèdent d’immenses capacités physiques, ainsi que d'une forte lignée japonaise.

title: Race : Orc
text:
A race of beastfolk who lost the ability to shift between man and beast, resulting in a permanent mix of the two. Their physical strength is greater than average but pails in comparison to their original strength as beastfolk.
(FR) Une race d'Hommes-Bêtes qui a perdu la capacité de passer entre leur forme humaine et bestiale, résultant en un mélange permanent des deux. Leur force physique est supérieure à la moyenne mais dérisoire par rapport à leur force originelle en tant qu'Hommes-Bêtes.

title: Race : Orc Disaster / Fléau Orc
text:
The evolution of an Orc Lord that is a Demon Lord Seed.
(FR) L'évolution d'un Seigneur Orc qui a obtenu une Graine de Roi-Démon..

title: Race : Orc Lord / Seigneur Orc
text:
A very rare and powerful member of the Orc race with high intelligence who appears roughly every few centuries.
(FR) Un membre très rare et puissant de la race des Orcs doté d'une grande intelligence et qui apparaît environ tous les quelques siècles.

title: Race : Slime
text:
A Spectral race of monster that lacks intelligence and ambition. They’re usually passive but are incredibly ruthless once provoked.
(FR) Une race spectrale de monstres qui manque d'intelligence et d'ambition. Ils sont généralement passifs mais sont incroyablement impitoyables une fois provoqués.

title: Race : Spirit Beast / Bête Spirituelle
text:
Beastfolk that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.
(FR) Un Homme-Bête qui a "évolué de la bonne manière", et qui est devenu une Forme de vie Spirituelle.

title: Race : Spirit Bird / Oiseau Spirituelle
text:
Harpy that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.
(FR) Une Harpie qui a "évoluée de la bonne manière", et qui est devenue une Forme de vie Spirituelle.

title: Race : Spirit Boar / Sanglier Spirituel
text:
Orc that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.
(FR) Un Orc qui a "évolué de la bonne manière", et qui est devenu une Forme de vie Spirituelle.

title: Race : Spirit Oni / Oni Spirituel
text:
Oni that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.
(FR) Un Oni qui a "évolué de la bonne manière", et qui est devenu une Forme de vie Spirituelle.

title: Race : Spirit Skeleton / Squelette Spirituel
text:
Wight that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.
(FR) Un Revenant qui a "évolué de la bonne manière", et qui est devenu une Forme de vie Spirituelle.

title: Race : True Dragonewt / Véritable Dragonaute
text:
The evolution of Dragonewts and complete Spiritual Lifeforms. They are the second-highest evolutionary stage of Dragonewt known to exist.
(FR) L'évolution d'un Dragonaute, et une Forme de vie Spirituelle complète. Il constitue le deuxième stade évolutif le plus élevé de Dragonaute connu.

title: Race : Vampire
text:
A race of Majin with nearly eternal life. Although they can reproduce, they normally abstain. Hosting overwhelming magical energy and vitality, their flesh never decays.
(FR) Une race de Majin avec une vie quasiment éternelle. Bien qu'ils puissent se reproduire, ils s'en abstiennent généralement. Hébergeant une énergie magique et une vitalité écrasantes, leur chair ne se décompose jamais.

title: Race : Vampire Lord / Seigneur Vampire
text:
A vampire among the loftiest levels of power, comparable to a Demon Lord.
(FR) Un vampire parmi les niveaux de puissances les plus élevés, comparable à un Roi-Démon.

title: Race : Vampire Overcomer / Vampire Transcendant
text:
Vampires that have evolved to overcome their weakness against the sun.
(FR) Des vampires qui ont évolué pour surmonter leur faiblesse face au soleil.

title: Race : Wicked Oni / Oni Démoniaque
text:
A variant of Oni, possessing an essence that leans closer towards that of a Daemon rather than that of a pure Elemental.
(FR) Une variante d'Oni possédant une essence qui se rapproche davantage de celle d'un Démon que de celle d'un Esprit Élémentaire pur.

title: Race : Wight / Revenant
text:
A Demi-Spiritual skeletal Undead Monster, highly weakened by sunlight.
(FR) Un monstre mort-vivant squelettique semi-spirituel, très affaibli par la lumière du soleil.

title: Race : Wight King / Roi Revenant
text:
A type of Undead Monster and an evolution of Wights. They possess fearsome power comparable to that of Demon Lord Seeds.
(FR) Un type de monstre mort-vivant et une évolution des Revenants. Ils possèdent une puissance redoutable comparable à une Graine de Roi-Démon.

title: Compétence : Abnormal Condition Nullification / Insensibilité aux Effets Anormaux
text:
Completely negate all abnormal conditions and their effects.
(FR) Annule totalement toutes les conditions anormales ainsi que leurs effets.

title: Compétence : Abnormal Condition Resistance / Résistance aux Effets Anormaux
text:
Resist the effects of weaker abnormal conditions or reduce the severity of stronger ones.
(FR) Résiste aux plus faibles effets des conditions anormales ou réduise la gravité des conditions plus puissantes.

title: Compétence : Absolute Severance / Tranché Absolu
text:
Wield the power to cut through any who stand in your path, whether by coating your strikes or launching slashing projectiles that sever all in their path.
(FR) Utilisez le pouvoir de couper à travers tous ceux qui se trouvent sur votre chemin, que ce soit en revêtant vos attaques ou en lançant des projectiles tranchant tout sur leur passage.

title: Compétence : Absorb & Dissolve / Absorber & Dissoudre
text:
Dissolve specific items to instantly consume them.
(FR) Dissout certains éléments pour les consommer instantanément.

title: Compétence : Acid Rain / Pluie d'Acide
text:
Summon an acidic cloud which will corrode any afflicted entities.
(FR) Invoque un nuage acide qui rongera tout ce qu'il touche.

title: Compétence : Acid Shell / Cartouche d'Acide
text:
Shoots a ball of corrosive acid toward targets.
(FR) Projette une boule d'acide corrosif sur ses cibles.

title: Compétence : Aerial Blade / Lame Aérienne
text:
Pull in any nearby entities before dealing massive damage by unleashing the power of your spirit.
(FR) Attire toutes les créatures proches avant d'infliger de massif dégâts en libérant la puissance de votre esprit.

title: Compétence : Agility / Agilité
text:
Greatly enhance the caster's movement speed.
(FR) Améliore considérablement la vitesse de déplacement du lanceur du sort.

title: Compétence : Air Flight / Vol Aérien
text:
Use your aura to propel you forward, and hover in air.
(FR) Fonctionnalité expérimentale ! - Utilise votre aura pour vous propulser vers l'avant et planez dans les airs.

title: Compétence : Airflow Shut / Confinement d'Air
text:
Drain out all the air surrounding the targets and suffocate them.
(FR) Enlève l'air tout autour des cibles et les asphyxie.

title: Compétence : All-seeing Eye / Oeil Omniscient
text:
Go into a 3rd person mode, with your increased POV you gain movement and action buffs as well as an upgrade to Presence Sense.
(FR) Vous passe en mode 3ème personne, avec votre point de vue augmenté, vous obtenez des bonus de vitesse et d'action ainsi qu'une amélioration de la détection de présence.

title: Compétence : Analyst / Analyste
text: Enhance cognitive processing, analyze targets and phenomena, accelerate magic casting and deepen understanding of the laws of the world to optimize all actions.

title: Compétence : Analytical Appraisal / Évaluation Analytique
text:
Assess the strength of your opponents to gain insight into their overall strength.
(FR) Évalue la force de vos adversaires pour avoir un aperçu de leur puissance globale.

title: Compétence : Analyze / Analyser
text:
Analyze targets' status and power.
(FR) Analyse le statut et la puissance des cibles.

title: Compétence : Anti-Magic Area / Zone d'Anti-Magie
text:
Creates a zone around the user that limits all Aspectual and Summoning Magics.
(FR) Crée une zone autour de l'utilisateur qui limite toutes les magies aspectuelles et d'invocation.

title: Compétence : Anti-Shock Area / Zone d'Anti-Choc
text:
Creates a zone around the user that limits all physical damage taken.
(FR) Crée une zone autour de l'utilisateur qui limite tous les dégâts physiques subis.

title: Compétence : Anti-Skill / Anti-Compétence
text:
Become immune to damage from Magic, Skills and Battlewill, destroy barriers and block skill usage of other entities.
(FR) Devenez immunisé contre les dégâts de la magie, les compétences et la Volonté de Combat, détruisez les barrières et bloquez l'utilisation des compétences d'autres créatures.

title: Compétence : Antidote
text:
Recover a living being from nausea, poison and weakness.
(FR) Soigne un être vivant souffrant de nausées, d'empoisonnement et de faiblesse.

title: Compétence : Aura Shield / Bouclier d’Aura
text:
Create a shield of condensed aura to block attacks.
(FR) Fonctionnalité expérimentale ! - Crée un bouclier d'Aura condensée pour bloquer les attaques.

title: Compétence : Aura Slash / Tranche d'Aura
text:
Condense your aura along your blade and release ranged slash.
(FR) Fonctionnalité expérimentale ! - Condense votre aura le long de votre lame et lance une attaque à distance.

title: Compétence : Aura Sword / Épée d'Aura
text:
Coat your weapon in aura enhancing its blows.
(FR) Fonctionnalité expérimentale ! - Revête votre arme d'aura améliorant ses attaques.

title: Compétence : Barrier / Barrière
text:
Coat the caster with a Physical Barrier with the strength based on Health.
(FR) Revête le lanceur du sort avec une Barrière Physique dont la résistance dépend de la santé de l'utilisateur.

title: Compétence : Battlewill / Volonté de Combat
text:
Channel your will, converting magicules into aura.
(FR) Fonctionnalité expérimentale ! - Canalise votre volonté, convertissant vos magicules en aura.

title: Compétence : Beast Transformation / Transformation Bestiale
text:
Transform into a beast to restore your vitality and boost your physical body. The transformation will grant great physical prowess but leave a toll on your body.
(FR) Vous transforme en bête pour restaurer votre vitalité et améliorer votre corps. La transformation vous permet d'améliorer vos capacités physiques, mais laissera des séquelles sur votre corps.

title: Compétence : Berserk
text:
Massively empower your body and infuse it with a flame aura. Allows you to go into a risky but overwhelmingly powerful berserker mode.
